fdroid:com.odiousapps.z2mdash.name: Z2M Dash
fdroid:com.odiousapps.z2mdash.summary: A Zigbee2MQTT dashboard that talks directly to your own MQTT broker
fdroid:com.odiousapps.z2mdash.description:
Z2M Dash is a free, open-source Android dashboard for Zigbee2MQTT. It talks directly to your own MQTT broker, so there's no cloud account and no lock-in. Your whole setup can be saved to a single file, or shared between phones through the broker itself.
Dashboard
• Groups of clusters, each cluster holding the tiles for one device: sensor readings, on/off switches and one-press buttons (such as a blind's STOP).
• Sensor tiles with your own units and decimal places, and an optional ideal range that colours the tile when a reading is too low or too high.
• Switches show the device's real state, not just the last command sent.
• Presence and occupancy sensors show as Detected or Clear.
• Drag and drop to reorder groups, clusters and tiles, with undo. Lock Layout (on by default) stops accidental moves.
• Clusters are outlined when a device hasn't reported for over an hour (red), has a low battery (blue) or has a weak Zigbee signal (yellow). Clusters on rechargeable NiMH batteries only count as low at 5%.
• A filter menu shows only devices with a low battery or weak signal, or moisture sensors below or above their ideal range.
• Works on phones and Android TV.
Setup and sync
• Devices can describe their own tiles in a retained "/app" config message, so every phone on the same broker shows the same layout, and changes made on one phone reach the others.
• Discover Sensors scans a broker for readings and builds tiles for devices that don't have an "/app" config.
• A Permit Join bar lets new Zigbee devices join through any router, with a countdown.
• Multiple brokers over TCP, SSL, WS or WSS, including self-signed certificates.
• An optional background connection keeps readings and alerts live while the app is closed.
Alerts
• Smoke alerts from any device reporting smoke, with an optional loud alarm sound.
• Watering alerts, with a chime and vibration, when a moisture sensor rises through the middle of its ideal range.
• Low battery alerts showing the battery percentage.
Backup and debugging
• Export the whole configuration, or just the brokers, as a compressed file. Backups are encrypted (AES-256-GCM) by default.
• Restore everything, or merge in just the brokers.
• Or publish and restore a backup through a retained MQTT message, with no file to move.
• A live, filterable Terminal shows every MQTT message, for checking payloads and topics.
Optional online service
The "Import via code" button on the Add Broker screen uses sync.odiousapps.com, a credential relay run by the developer. You log in to that site and pick a saved credential, and the broker's hostname, username and password are passed back to the app through that server. Nothing is sent unless you tap the button and agree to continue, and brokers can always be entered by hand or imported from a file instead. The relay's source code is free software (Unlicense): https://github.com/evilbunny2008/MX3Launcher/tree/main/website

fdroid:io.element.android.x.name: Element X - Secure Chat & Call
fdroid:io.element.android.x.description:
Freedom to communicate on your own terms
For individuals and communities - private communication between family, friends, hobby groups, clubs, etc.
Element X gives you fast, secure and private instant messaging and video calls built on Matrix, the open standard for real-time communication. This is a free and open-source app maintained at https://github.com/element-hq/element-x-android.
Stay in touch with friends, family and communities with:
 • Real time messaging & video calls
 • Public rooms for open group communication
 • Private rooms for closed group communication
 • Rich messaging features: emoji reactions, replies, polls, pinned messages and more.

 Privacy-first

fdroid:io.loopstring.readme.name: Read Me Offline
fdroid:io.loopstring.readme.summary: Share an article or text, trim it, and hear it read aloud on-device
fdroid:io.loopstring.readme.description:
Read Me Offline reads articles and text aloud with the text-to-speech voice already on your phone. Share a link from your browser or selected text from any app, cut the parts you don't want, and listen with the screen off.
 Share it, trim it, listen to it 
 Share a link and Read Me Offline fetches the page once and keeps only the article.
 Share selected text from any app and it is ready to read straight away.
 Trim before you listen: tap a paragraph to cut it (a newsletter plug, a comment section), or cut everything before or after a point. Cuts are never destructive; tap again to restore.
 The sentence being read is highlighted, and playback keeps going with the screen off. Media buttons and headset controls work.
 Speed from 0.5x to 4x. Your place is saved as you go, and finished items move to the Archive.
 Private by design 
 Speech is made on your phone by Android's text-to-speech engine. Voices that need a network connection are never offered or used.
 The only network request is fetching a link you shared, or retrying one when you ask. No accounts, analytics, crash reporting, ads or update checks.
 What you save stays in the app's private storage and is never written to logs. Deleting an item deletes its text.
 A voice for Obsidian on Android 
Obsidian on Android gives plugins no way to use the phone's speech engine. Read Me Offline can run a small speech service, reachable only from the phone itself, that the local-tts-reader Obsidian plugin uses to read your notes aloud with the same on-device voices. It is off until you turn it on in Settings.
Read Me Offline needs a text-to-speech engine with at least one offline voice. Most phones have one; if yours doesn't, the app tells you and links to Android's speech settings.

apple-itunes:924620788.name: Google Classroom
apple-itunes:924620788.description:
Classroom is a free service for schools, non-profits, and anyone with a personal Google account. Classroom makes it easy for learners and instructors to connect—inside and outside of schools. Classroom saves time and paper, and makes it easy to create classes, distribute assignments, communicate, and stay organized.
Classroom is designed to help teachers create, collect, and grade assignments paperlessly, including time-saving features like the ability to automatically make a copy of a Google Document for each student. It also creates Drive folders for each assignment and for each student to help keep everyone organized.
Students can keep track of what’s due on the Assignments page and begin working with just a click. Teachers can quickly see who has or hasn't completed the work, and provide direct, real-time feedback and grades right in Classroom.
With the mobile app for iOS, students and teachers can view their classes and communicate with their classmates in real time. Students can open their assignments and work on them right from their iPhone or iPad. Teachers can keep track of who has turned in work and grade the assignment - at school or on the go. Students and teachers receive notifications when they have new content in Classroom, so they are always up to date.
There are many benefits of using Classroom:
Easy to set up
Teachers can add students directly or share a code with their class to join. It takes just minutes to set up.
Saves time
The simple, paperless assignment workflow allows teachers to create, review, and grade assignments quickly, all in one place.
Improves organization
Students can see all of their assignments on an assignments page, and all class materials (e.g., documents, photos, and videos) are automatically filed into folders in Google Drive.
Enhances communication
Classroom allows teachers to send announcements and start class discussions instantly. Students can share resources with each other or provide answers to questions on the stream.
Secure
Like the rest of Google Workspace for Education services, Classroom contains no ads, never uses your content or student data for advertising purposes.
Permissions Notice:
Camera: Needed to allow the user to take photos or videos and post them to Classroom.
Microphone: Needed to enable audio capture for recording videos to be posted to Classroom.
Photos: Needed to allow the user to attach photos or videos to Classroom. Photos or videos posted to Classroom will be stored on Google servers in order to show them in Classroom.

apple-macos:6476572500.name: Bulletin: RSS News Reader
apple-macos:6476572500.description:
Bulletin is a modern RSS news reader with summaries built in, so you can get through everything you follow in less time.
You choose every source, and no algorithm decides what surfaces.
Use the summary to decide what to read, then open the article in a distraction-free reader with no ads.
SMART SUMMARY, POWERED BY REAL ARTICLE CONTENT
Bulletin extracts the article before building its summary, rather than relying on the short text in an RSS feed. The result reflects what the article actually says, so you're not judging a story by its headline.
• Read a concise summary in bullet points or one sentence
• Switch to Quotes mode to read the article's key quotes, word for word
• Improve unclear or clickbait headlines with a clearer, more accurate one
• Summarise a whole feed or category, with each point citing the publication behind it. Tap to open the story
• Copy, select, or share summaries
Bulletin uses AI to summarise article content.
YOU PICK EVERY SOURCE
Start reading straight away with useful starter categories, then make Bulletin yours. Add the publications, independent writers, blogs, and specialist sites you trust. Nothing is inserted because an algorithm thinks it should be there.
• Add an RSS feed from any supported site or feed URL
• Import an existing collection with OPML, or export it when you need to
• Create, rename, hide, and organise categories around the way you follow news
• Enable, disable, or rename individual sources at any time
• Mute phrases you do not want to see in your feeds
A FOR YOU FEED, ON YOUR TERMS
For You brings your chosen categories together in one personalised feed. Nothing is ranked or promoted: it is all from sources you added.
Sort a combined feed purely by time and the sites that post twenty times a day bury the ones that post twice a week. Weaved mode keeps For You close to newest first, but never lets one source run more than twice before another gets a turn. Busy sites still appear as often, just spread out, so everything you follow gets seen.
• Weaved mode, so no single source takes over the feed
• Switch to chronological ordering whenever you prefer
• Choose which categories appear together in For You
READ THE WAY YOU WANT
A summary is a starting point. When an article deserves your attention, open it in a clean reading view that keeps the text and images while removing page ads and newsletter prompts. You can also switch to the original page at any time.
• Choose a serif or sans-serif reading font and adjust text size
• Use light, dark, or extra-dark reading styles
• Change article card size to make feeds compact or visual
• Sort feeds, show or hide unread counts, and mark articles as read in batches
SAVE IT FOR LATER
Save an article to Read Later with one action, then return when the time is right. Your sources, reading history, preferences, and Read Later list stay in sync with iCloud across iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
TRANSLATE AS YOU READ
When a source is written in another language, translate its headlines, full articles and summaries entirely on your device.
WIDGETS, SIRI AND SHORTCUTS
• See recent headlines in Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Open Bulletin actions from Control Center or Siri
• Follow the latest headlines in a Live Activity
CLEAR ABOUT YOUR DATA
Bulletin removes tracking parameters from article URLs. Anonymous usage analytics can be turned off, and article content is not collected for analytics. Your source list remains yours.
TRY BULLETIN FREE
The free tier includes 20 opens of the distraction-free reader and 5 shared Smart Summary or headline-improvement uses. Bulletin Pro unlocks unlimited reader opens, unlimited summaries, headline improvements, and alternate app icons.
Monthly, Yearly, and Lifetime options are available, with pricing shown before purchase.
Choose your sources, read the summary, and open what matters.
Terms of Service: https://www.pixelfolio.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://www.pixelfolio.app/privacy.html

apple-macos:507659816.name: Network Radar
apple-macos:507659816.description:
See what’s connected. Know when something changes.
Network Radar turns your Mac into a practical network scanner and monitoring tool. Find unfamiliar devices, troubleshoot connection problems and keep a clear record of your network—at home or at work.
Click Scan to get started, then explore the devices Network Radar discovers. From a quick check of your Wi-Fi network to ongoing server monitoring, the tools you need are in one place.
DISCOVER YOUR DEVICES
View IP, IPv6 and MAC addresses, manufacturer and model details, DNS, Bonjour (mDNS) and NetBIOS names, open ports and response times. See when a device was last detected, and use the Bonjour browser to explore advertised services.
MONITOR AND RESPOND
Monitor devices for changes in availability and keep a history of observations. Set up rules to show a notification, send an email or play a sound—for example, when an important server stops responding. Choose how much ping and log history to retain.
KEEP YOUR NETWORK ORGANIZED
Give devices meaningful names, custom icons, types, vendor names and notes. Use folders and smart folders to organize your network. The grouped All Hosts view brings together matching devices from different scans while keeping each entry’s status, settings and history separate. Missing discovery details can come from matching entries in other scans.
PUT NETWORK TOOLS TO WORK
Run Ping, Port Scan, Traceroute and Whois without switching apps. Wake compatible devices with Wake on LAN, or put configured Macs to sleep, restart them or shut them down.
MORE WAYS TO WORK
• Create scans with custom IP ranges.
• Associate scans with networks and refresh or monitor multiple scans.
• Open a device’s configured service by double-clicking its entry.
• Build workflows with actions for the Shortcuts app.
• Import CSV files to add hosts or update device details edited in a spreadsheet.
• Transfer saved scans and custom icons between Macs with NETRADR exports.
• Export to NETRADR, XML, CSV, TXT or PDF; import NETRADR, XML and CSV files.
The information available depends on your network and the devices’ responses. Wake on LAN and remote commands require compatible devices and suitable network settings. Sleep, restart and shutdown commands for Macs require Remote Login (SSH) and configured credentials.

apple-macos:6511220823.name: Varta Keyboard
apple-macos:6511220823.description:
Introducing the Varta Keyboard (Vārtā Keyboard) - a versatile and intuitive multi-modal and multilingual keyboard. Built on phonemic principles, the Varta Keyboard is designed to ensure accurate and efficient text input through Slide and Voice typing in additional to regular tap input. Varta currently supports Bengali, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Sanskrit, Tamil and Telugu alongside an English keyboard as well.
The Varta Keyboard does not include separate keys for vowel signs or modifiers in Indian languages. Most other keyboards will have separate keys for such vowel signs, which leads to typos or incorrect characters getting typed in those keyboards. With the Varta Keyboard, the appropriate modifier is automatically generated, when the user inputs the corresponding vowel after the consonant. This allows you to type in your language without mistakes.
Varta Keyboard offers the following features:
* Slide typing feature in Bengali, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Sanskrit, Tamil and Telugu
* Word predictions from over 1 lakh words in each language
* Custom dictionary for user preferred words
* Three language variants for Tamil: IN, MY and LK
Stay tuned for more languages to be added soon!

apple-macos:6825567849.name: Dishlight: Food Photo Editor
apple-macos:6825567849.description:
Make your food look as good as it tastes.
Dishlight fixes food photos the way a pro would: the yellow cast from kitchen lights, flat or murky light, a dark side away from the window, dull or overcooked colors. Open a photo and it picks the best look and the right tweaks for you, in one step you can undo.
KNOW WHAT TO FIX
• Appeal score: a 0–100 rating of light, shadows, color, sharpness and framing, before and after.
• Clear tips that name the control to use. Blurry shots score low, honestly: editing can't fix blur.
• "Improve Automatically" applies the changes the tips suggest.
COLOR AND LIGHT, FOR FOOD
• White balance taken from your plates and napkins, not from the food, so a yellow curry stays yellow.
• Neutral shadows with no color cast, and even light across the dish.
• Bright areas keep their detail: no more blank egg whites or blown cream.
• Vibrance that boosts sauces, crusts and herbs without tinting the plate.
LOOKS AND EFFECTS
• 12 looks, from Natural and Bright & Airy to Dark & Moody, Golden Hour, Film and Noir, each scored on your photo.
• Vignette, edge or background blur, grain, and your own saved looks for a consistent feed.
READY TO POST
• Crops for Instagram (4:5), Pinterest (2:3), your blog and headers, with zoom and rotate.
• Export sizes for blog, Instagram and Pinterest, with file-size limits for fast pages.
• Titles, alt text and file names written by Apple Intelligence, on your device.
• Your watermark or logo on every photo.
EDIT A WHOLE SHOOT (PRO)
• One look on every photo of a recipe shoot; each photo still gets its own color correction.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything happens on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Photos are never uploaded.
• Saved copies carry no location. No account, no tracking, no ads.
DISHLIGHT PRO
A one-time purchase for iPhone, iPad and Mac, no subscription: batch editing, watermark, unlimited saved looks and full-size saves. Every look, adjustment, effect, the appeal score and all web export sizes are free.
FROM THE LAKI MAIKA‘I KITCHEN
Dishlight was made by the cooks behind Laki Maika‘i (lakimaikai.com), the travel and recipe site, for their own recipe photos. Developed by Videre Research.

flathub:com.zandronum.Zandronum.description:
Zandronum is a multiplayer oriented port, based off Skulltag, for Doom and Doom II by id Software.
 Zandronum brings classic Doom into the 21st century, maintaining the essence of what has made Doom
 great for so many years and, at the same time, adding new features to modernize it, creating a
 fresh, fun new experience. Here's why you should kill your time with Zandronum, versus vanilla

 Client/server architecture: play and switch between games with ease
 Supports up to 64 players
 Wide array of gameplay modes
 Competitive: Team DM, Duel, CTF, Possession, LMS, Terminator, Skulltag
 Cooperative: Survival, Invasion (or both!)
 Modifiers, like Instagib and Buckshot, can be used to spice up any game
 Modern and beautiful
 Support for large number of ZDoom and GZDoom mods
 Choose between GZDoom's OpenGL renderer, or Doom's Software renderer
 Useful features like a console, Quake-style key bindings, freelooking, and jumping
 Support for many Doom engine based games including Heretic, Hexen, and Strife
 Supports modern versions of Windows, Mac OS X, and Linux
 In some scenarios, commercial data files are required to run the supported games. In other cases,
 it's possibly to automatically use Freedoom as a drop-in replacement. This package comes bundled
 with Doomseeker for easy installation and server browsing.

flathub:de.sesu8642.feudaltactics.name: Feudal Tactics
flathub:de.sesu8642.feudaltactics.summary: Strategy game with countless unique and challenging levels.
flathub:de.sesu8642.feudaltactics.description:
A medieval strategy game with countless unique and challenging levels.
 You play on a randomly generated island made of hexagons. Your goal is to conquer all of it.
 To do so, you attack the enemy with your units while trying to protect your own kingdoms.

flathub:io.github.lawstorant.boxflat.name: Boxflat
flathub:io.github.lawstorant.boxflat.description:
Boxflat enables you to change your Moza Racing hardware settings with ease as well
 as adding SDL/Proton detection fixes for any of your devices (pedals, shifters, handbrakes etc.) from other brands.
 Settings and their values are a 1:1 match with Pit House. This makes it possible to use presets shared by the community.
 The table of supported settings compared to Pit House can be found on the project website. This project has no official ties to Moza
 and/or their software. It's 100% independent work based largely on hours of reverse engineering the protocol.
 Boxflat supports saving/loading presets and automatic per-game application.
 If a device misses an axis an/or a button, an automatic game detection fix will be applied. No need for other software/SDL hints to make them work.
 Supported devices:
 Wheelbases
 Wheels
 Pedals
 Handbrake
 Sequential shifter
 H-Pattern shifter
 Multi-function stalks
 E-Stop
 Universal Hub
 Digital Dash v2
 Generic joysticks (only detection fix)
 Note: The udev rules found in the GitHub repository need to be installed for the application to work properly.
 Boxflat will remind you of this in case of no rw access to the serial devices.

flathub:net.epson.epsonscan2.name: Epson Scan 2
flathub:net.epson.epsonscan2.summary: Software for Epson scanners & multifunction printer
flathub:net.epson.epsonscan2.description:
Epson Scan 2 is a scanning application for Epson scanner. It
 allows to set various scanner settings with graphical user
 interface and save the scanned images to the various file
 type.
 It supports USB, and network connection for the network capable
 scanners.
 Scanners can also be controlled with the command line.
 While the application is Free Software, the scanner drivers
 contains Proprietary components.
 This build is not supported by Epson Seiko Corporation, and is provided as is.

flathub:net.openhabittracker.OpenHabitTr.name: OpenHabitTracker
flathub:net.openhabittracker.OpenHabitTr.summary: Take notes, plan tasks, track habits
flathub:net.openhabittracker.OpenHabitTr.description:
Take notes, plan tasks, and track habits - native apps on all your devices, plus a web app.
 Free, ad-free, and open source. No account needed: all your data stays on your device.
 Notes with full Markdown support
 Tasks with planned dates, duration and time tracking
 Habits with flexible repeat intervals - track repetitions, time or quantity
 Checklist sub-items on both tasks and habits
 Categories, colors, priorities, search, filters and sorting - for notes, tasks and habits
 Optional notifications: one daily summary of what is due, and a reminder before a task's
 planned time
 Charts for every habit: progress toward the target, history, a year calendar, best streaks
 and weekday frequency
 All data is stored locally on your device
 Export and import: Markdown, JSON, YAML, TSV
 Import from Google Keep, Loop Habit Tracker, HabitNow, Habitica and Habitify
 Optional sync for multiple users: host the Docker image on your own server and every app,
 desktop or mobile, can log in and sync
 26 themes with dark and light mode
 Customizable UI - show or hide almost every element
 Available in 20 languages
 Keyboard navigation and screen reader support

flathub:org.kde.kget.name: KGet
flathub:org.kde.kget.description:
KGet is a versatile and user-friendly download manager.
 Features:
 Downloading files from FTP and HTTP(S) sources.
 Pausing and resuming of downloading files, as well as the ability to restart a download.
 Tells lots of information about current and pending downloads.
 Embedding into system tray.
 Integration with the Konqueror web browser.
 Metalink support which contain multiple URLs for downloads, along with checksums and other
 information.

flathub:org.kde.palapeli.name: Palapeli
flathub:org.kde.palapeli.description:
Palapeli is a single-player jigsaw puzzle game. Unlike other games in that genre, you are not
 limited to aligning pieces on imaginary grids. The pieces are freely moveable. Also, Palapeli features
 real persistency, i.e. everything you do is saved on your disk immediately.
 Features:
 Create and play puzzles ranging from 4 to 10,000 pieces
 Piece-holders for helping solve large puzzles

flathub:org.kicad.KiCad.name: KiCad
flathub:org.kicad.KiCad.summary: An EDA suite for schematic and circuit board design
flathub:org.kicad.KiCad.description: KiCad is a free and open-source electronics design automation (EDA) suite. It features schematic capture, integrated circuit simulation, printed circuit board (PCB) layout, 3D rendering, and plotting/data export to numerous formats. KiCad also includes a high-quality component library featuring thousands of symbols, footprints, and 3D models. KiCad has minimal system requirements and runs on Linux, Windows, and macOS.

fedora-packages:ceres-solver/ceres-solve.description: Ceres Solver is an open source C++ library for modeling and solving large, complicated optimization problems. It is a feature rich, mature and performant library which has been used in production at Google since 2010. Notable use of Ceres Solver is for the image alignment in Google Maps and for vehicle pose in Google Street View. Ceres Solver can solve two kinds of problems. 1. Non-linear Least Squares problems with bounds constraints. 2. General unconstrained optimization problems. Features include: - A friendly API: build your objective function one term at a time - Automatic and numeric differentiation - Robust loss functions - Local parameterizations - Threaded Jacobian evaluators and linear solvers - Trust region solvers with non-monotonic steps (Levenberg-Marquardt and Dogleg (Powell & Subspace)) - Line search solvers (L-BFGS and Nonlinear CG) - Dense QR and Cholesky factorization (using Eigen) for small problems - Sparse Cholesky factorization (using SuiteSparse) for large sparse problems - Specialized solvers for bundle adjustment problems in computer vision - Iterative linear solvers for general sparse and bundle adjustment problems - Runs on Linux, Windows, Mac OS X, Android, and iOS

fedora-packages:golang-github-theupdatef.summary: Project that allows anyone to have trust over arbitrary collections of data
fedora-packages:golang-github-theupdatef.description: The Notary project comprises a server and a client for running and interacting with trusted collections. See the service architecture documentation for more information. Notary aims to make the internet more secure by making it easy for people to publish and verify content. We often rely on TLS to secure our communications with a web server, which is inherently flawed, as any compromise of the server enables malicious content to be substituted for the legitimate content. With Notary, publishers can sign their content offline using keys kept highly secure. Once the publisher is ready to make the content available, they can push their signed trusted collection to a Notary Server. Consumers, having acquired the publisher's public key through a secure channel, can then communicate with any Notary server or (insecure) mirror, relying only on the publisher's key to determine the validity and integrity of the received content. This package contains the source code needed for building packages that reference the following Go import paths: – github.com/theupdateframework/notary

fedora-packages:i3blocks/i3blocks.description: A feed generator for text based status bars i3blocks executes your command lines and generates a status line from their output. Commands are scheduled at configured time intervals, upon signal reception or on clicks. The generated line is meant to be displayed by the i3 window manager through its i3bar component, as an alternative to i3status. i3blocks is meant to be highly flexible but intuitive. No library package is required, just output what your status bar expects, from your favorite programming language and your preferred format.

fedora-packages:keepassxc/keepassxc.name: keepassxc
fedora-packages:keepassxc/keepassxc.description: KeePassXC is a community fork of KeePassX KeePassXC is an application for people with extremely high demands on secure personal data management. KeePassXC saves many different information e.g. user names, passwords, urls, attachments and comments in one single database. For a better management user-defined titles and icons can be specified for each single entry. Furthermore the entries are sorted in groups, which are customizable as well. The integrated search function allows to search in a single group or the complete database. KeePassXC offers a little utility for secure password generation. The password generator is very customizable, fast and easy to use. Especially someone who generates passwords frequently will appreciate this feature. The complete database is always encrypted either with AES (alias Rijndael) or Twofish encryption algorithm using a 256 bit key. Therefore the saved information can be considered as quite safe.

fedora-packages:ladspa-autotalent-plugin.description: Autotalent is a real-time pitch correction plugin. You specify the notes that a singer is allowed to hit, and Autotalent makes sure that they do. You can also use Autotalent for more exotic effects, making your voice sound like a chiptune, adding artificial vibrato, or messing with your formants. fedora-packages:mingw-rest/mingw64-rest-.description: This library was designed to make it easier to access web services that claim to be "RESTful". A RESTful service should have urls that represent remote objects, which methods can then be called on. The majority of services don't actually adhere to this strict definition. fedora-packages:perl-Crypt-PBKDF2/perl-C.name: perl-Crypt-PBKDF2
fedora-packages:perl-Crypt-PBKDF2/perl-C.description: PBKDF2 is a secure password hashing algorithm that uses the techniques of "key strengthening" to make the complexity of a brute-force attack arbitrarily high. PBKDF2 uses any other cryptographic hash or cipher (by convention, usually HMAC-SHA2, but Crypt::PBKDF2 is fully pluggable), and allows for an arbitrary number of iterations of the hashing function, and a nearly unlimited output hash size (up to 2**32-1 times the size of the output of the backend hash). The hash is salted, as any password hash should be, and the salt may also be of arbitrary size.

fedora-packages:perl-Crypt-RC4/perl-Cryp.name: perl-Crypt-RC4
fedora-packages:perl-Crypt-RC4/perl-Cryp.summary: Perl implementation of the RC4 encryption algorithm
fedora-packages:perl-Crypt-RC4/perl-Cryp.description: A simple implementation of the RC4 algorithm, developed by RSA Security, Inc. Here is the description from RSA's website: RC4 is a stream cipher designed by Rivest for RSA Data Security (now RSA Security). It is a variable key-size stream cipher with byte-oriented operations. The algorithm is based on the use of a random permutation. Analysis shows that the period of the cipher is overwhelmingly likely to be greater than 10100. Eight to sixteen machine operations are required per output byte, and the cipher can be expected to run very quickly in software. Independent analysts have scrutinized the algorithm and it is considered secure.

fedora-packages:perl-Encode-HanExtra/per.name: perl-Encode-HanExtra
fedora-packages:perl-Encode-HanExtra/per.description: Perl 5.7.3 and later ships with an adequate set of Chinese encodings, including the commonly used CP950, CP936 (also known as GBK), Big5 (alias for Big5-Eten), Big5-HKSCS, EUC-CN, HZ, and ISO-IR-165. However, the numbers of Chinese encodings are staggering, and a complete coverage will easily increase the size of perl distribution by several megabytes; hence, this CPAN module tries to provide the rest of them. If you are using Perl 5.8 or later, Encode::CN and Encode::TW will automatically load the extra encodings for you, so there's no need to explicitly write use Encode::HanExtra if you are using one of them already.

fedora-packages:perl-autovivification/pe.name: perl-autovivification
fedora-packages:perl-autovivification/pe.description: When an undefined variable is dereferenced, it gets silently upgraded to an array or hash reference (depending of the type of the dereferencing). This behavior is called autovivification and usually does what you mean (e.g. when you store a value) but it's sometimes unnatural or surprising because your variables gets populated behind your back. This is especially true when several levels of dereferencing are involved, in which case all levels are vivified up to the last, or when it happens in intuitively read-only constructs like exists.

firefox-addons:751101.name: Reverse Image Search
firefox-addons:751101.summary: Adds an option to the context menu to search with an image on Google, Bing, Yandex, TinEye, SauceNAO, IQDB or custom search engines. You can also choose more than one and they will be shown in a submenu!
firefox-addons:751101.description:
Adds an option to the context menu to search with an image on Google, Bing, Yandex, TinEye, SauceNAO, IQDB, or custom search engines with your own URL and icon. Also supports POST requests!
 If you choose more than one search engine, they will all be shown in a handy submenu! 
If more than one search engine is selected, a new entry "Open All" will also be shown. You can even choose the tab behaviour that suits your needs!

firefox-addons:3038610.name: Chat Privacy – Hide AI Chats
firefox-addons:3038610.summary: Hide AI chat-history sidebars during screen sharing, meetings, demos and recordings. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and more.
firefox-addons:3038610.description:
Chat Privacy automatically hides your AI chat history sidebar so conversation titles stay off-screen during screen sharing, online meetings, presentations, recordings, live streams, pair programming, and public or office computer use.
It works on ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot, Poe, DeepSeek, Grok, Tencent Yuanbao, and GitHub Copilot.
Key features:
 Hides chat history before the page finishes rendering, preventing titles from briefly flashing on screen.
 Lets you show or hide chats on demand with a small sidebar button.
 Provides an optional draggable page bubble as a backup toggle.
 Remembers your preferences using Firefox extension storage.
 Runs locally with no analytics, tracking, advertising, or collection or transmission of personal data.
Chat Privacy does not read, upload, analyze, sell, or share chat content. It only controls the local display state of chat-history lists on supported sites.

firefox-addons:2752566.description:

firefox-addons:3056474.name: Manga Translator for Manhwa & Webtoon — Sumi
firefox-addons:3056474.summary: Translate manga, manhwa and webtoons on the page you are reading. Sumi redraws translated text inside speech bubbles.
firefox-addons:3056474.description:
Sumi translates manga, manhwa, manhua, and webtoons in place — on the page you are already reading. 3,000+ people read with Sumi every week, in 120+ countries and regions.
Open the Sumi popup on any page with comic images, pick your target language, and translate the visible images — or right-click a single image and choose "Translate this image". Sumi detects each speech bubble, caption, and sound effect separately, then redraws the translation back inside the artwork, so the page still reads like a comic. Click again to compare with the original.
Why it looks right
- Per-bubble detection, not one blurry pass over the whole page — fewer missed lines.
- The translation is drawn into the bubble and fits its shape, including vertical CJK text. It is not a text box pasted over the art.
- Click any translated image to flip back to the original.
Works on sites that block image downloads
Some manga sites refuse plain image requests. Sumi fetches the exact image bytes the page is already showing you, using a temporary, host-scoped header rule. Nothing is blocked, redirected, or collected.
Language support
Translate Japanese, Korean and Chinese comics into any of the 134 target languages available in the popup.
Auto-translate the sites you choose
- Turn auto-translate on per site from the popup; new pages translate as you read.
- Chrome asks for its optional all-sites access only when you enable this, and Sumi acts only on the sites you turned on.
Optional floating button
Off by default. Switch it on from the popup and a slim dock along the edge of the page (a draggable button on narrower windows and touch devices) puts Sumi one tap away, no popup required.
Free plan and Sumi Pro
Your first page is free with no account. A free account adds 5 pages, plus 5 more every day you claim them. Sumi Pro is $6.99/month with a fair-use ceiling of 1,500 pages per rolling 30 days.
We test it in the open
We run fixed official free-chapter pages through Sumi and other tools and publish the outputs — including where Sumi loses points — at mangasumi.com/best-manga-translator .
Also on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Safari
The same translation engine ships as a native app and a Safari extension, so your reading carries across devices.
What Sumi never does
- It never hosts, crawls, indexes, or links to manga.
- It only translates images on pages you open yourself, from chapters you have the right to read.
- Your browsing history is never collected or uploaded. Sumi keeps a local list of the sites you switch it on for, and sends one site's domain only if you press "Report this site".

firefox-addons:1006769.name: Switch to audible tab
firefox-addons:1006769.summary: Focus on tab that is currently making sound (Alt+Shift+A).
firefox-addons:1006769.description:
This WebExtension allows the user to switch to the tab that is currently making sound.
If there are multiple audible tabs, the addon will cycle through them and then return to the initial tab (the latter can be opted off at the settings page).
If there are no audible tabs, the addon will do nothing. Tabs that are muted by the user are also considered audible (this can be changed at the settings page).
If there are audible tabs belonging to other windows, these windows will be switched too (this can be opted off as well).
It is also possible to control the order in which the tabs will be visited: available options are 'left-to-right' and 'right-to-left'. This will only make difference if there are more than two tabs in a cycle.
 Alt+Shift+A is the hotkey that can be used instead of the toolbar button.
Refer to the guide if you want to change it (the default hotkey is known not to work on Mac).
Source code is available here - feel free to report a bug or request an improvement.

firefox-addons:417674.name: Duplicate Tabs Closer
firefox-addons:417674.summary: Detects and automatically closes duplicate tabs.
firefox-addons:417674.description:
Duplicate Tabs Closer detects and closes duplicate tabs automatically, or displays them in a panel for manual review.
WHAT IT DOES
When you open a URL that is already open in another tab, Duplicate Tabs Closer can close it immediately or show it in the panel so you decide. A badge on the extension icon always tells you how many duplicate tabs are currently open.
TWO WAYS TO WORK
Auto-close mode: the duplicate tab is closed the moment it is detected. The original tab can be activated automatically, moved to the position of the closed tab, or left as-is.
Manual mode: duplicate tabs are listed in the panel. You close them individually or all at once.
SMART DETECTION
The extension compares tabs based on their URL, but you can adjust what counts as a match:
Ignore case in the URL
Ignore the www prefix in the domain
Ignore the hash part of the URL
Ignore the query string
Ignore the entire path (compare only the domain)
Choose how titles affect matching: URL only (default), treat a matching title or URL as a duplicate, or require both URL and title to match
Set a title similarity threshold for fuzzy title matching
Define URL pattern rules: any two tabs matching the same wildcard or regex pattern are treated as duplicates, even if their full URLs differ
Define title pattern rules: same idea, applied to page titles. Wildcard and regex patterns both supported
PRIORITY RULES
When a duplicate is detected, you control which tab is kept:
Keep the older tab (default) or the newer tab
Keep the active (focused) tab: in the same window, the tab you are currently viewing is kept regardless of age
Keep the tab with HTTPS when one is HTTP and one is HTTPS
Always keep the pinned tab
Prioritize the active window: when duplicates span multiple windows, keep the tab in the currently focused window even if age-based priority would close it (requires Scope set to All windows)
Keep and reload the older tab with the newer URL (useful for redirects)
WHITELISTED URLs
Tabs matching a whitelist pattern are never auto-closed. They still appear in the duplicate list with an indicator, but the extension leaves them open.
SCOPE
Search for duplicates only in the active window, or across all open windows. On Firefox with Multi-Account Containers, you can also limit detection to tabs in the same container.
POPUP PANEL
The popup shows the current list of duplicate tabs. Click a tab to jump to it. Close individual tabs or all at once. Toggle a grouped view to see duplicate tabs organized by URL. The panel can be collapsed to show only the duplicate list, and sections can be pinned to stay visible in compact mode.
CUSTOMIZATION
Visual themes: Sky, Sage, Rose, Amber, Slate, Violet, Ocean Night, Charcoal, Midnight Purple, Dark Teal, OLED Black
Custom badge colors for duplicate and no-duplicate states
Option to open the popup automatically when a new duplicate is detected
Option to close the popup after clicking Close All
KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS
No default shortcuts are set to avoid conflicts with browser built-ins. You can assign shortcuts for:
Close all duplicate tabs
Toggle between auto-close and manual mode
Pause or resume duplicate tab monitoring
INTENTIONAL DUPLICATES
Tabs opened on purpose using the browser's built-in Duplicate Tab command are never auto-closed.
PRIVACY
The extension operates entirely locally. No data is collected, transmitted, or stored outside your browser.
RELEASE NOTES
 https://github.com/Peuj/duplicate-tabs-closer/releases 
BUG REPORTS AND FEATURE REQUESTS
 https://github.com/Peuj/duplicate-tabs-closer/issues

Welcome to Wood Inc. Idle Lumber Chopper, Create Your Ultimate Wood Harvest Empire!
Enjoy idle games, harvesting simulators, or management challenges? Cut Trees & Collect Wood:
Start your adventure by chopping trees by hand, then unlock advanced tools and machines to automate your work. Explore different tree varieties, each offering unique values and benefits. Some trees grow quickly, while others produce higher-value wood. Watch workers clear forests and pile logs into your storage yard as your stock steadily increases.

Construct additional buildings such as warehouses, supply centers, and advanced mills to support expansion. Watch your small operation transform into a large, multi-area Wood empire.
Ready to Become a Chopper Legend?
Idle Lumber Chopper delivers more depth than typical idle games, combining strategy, management, and satisfying progression. Every upgrade, worker, and tree you cut plays a role in your success. It’s free to play, works offline, and is perfect whether you want a quick session or deep management gameplay.
Download "Wood Inc. Idle Lumber Chopper" today and start building your path to success. Chop trees, grow your business, and manage your way to becoming the ultimate wood tycoon. Your Wood empire starts now!

Unlock new regions as your business grows, from green forests to icy landscapes. Each zone introduces new challenges and rewards. Discover rare tree types that yield valuable resources. Construct additional buildings such as warehouses, supply centers, and advanced mills to support expansion. Watch your small operation transform into a large, multi-area Wood empire.


Ready to Become a Chopper Legend?


Idle Lumber Chopper delivers more depth than typical idle games, combining strategy, management, and satisfying progression. Every upgrade, worker, and tree you cut plays a role in your success. It’s free to play, works offline, and is perfect whether you want a quick session or deep management gameplay.

Download "Wood Inc. Idle Lumber Chopper" today and start building your path to success. Chop trees, grow your business, and manage your way to becoming the ultimate wood tycoon. Your Wood empire starts now!

Valete Plus: O Aplicativo Que Reúne Conhecimento e Cultura em Um Só Lugar
O Valete é o seu novo hub de conhecimento e interação. Desenvolvido para quem busca profundidade e não se contenta com o superficial, nosso aplicativo reúne o melhor do pensamento contemporâneo em um só lugar.
Tenha acesso a uma curadoria exclusiva de conteúdos que elevam o debate e expandem sua visão de mundo, onde quer que você esteja.

Artigos Exclusivos: Textos de análise profunda sobre cultura, política, comportamento e filosofia, escritos por quem entende do assunto.

Ambiente Seguro: Uma comunidade focada no crescimento intelectual e na troca de experiências reais.
Atualização Constante: Novos materiais adicionados regularmente para garantir que você esteja sempre à frente.
Junte-se à nossa comunidade e transforme sua maneira de consumir informação.

bluejetty:00137715:ios.name: RxSS: Rx Savings Solutions
bluejetty:00137715:ios.summary: If your employer or health insurance company works with Rx Savings Solutions (RxSS), we’re here to help you save money on prescription drugs. We'll show lower-cost options available for your prescriptions and how much you can expect to pay.
bluejetty:00137715:ios.description:
If your employer or health insurance company works with Rx Savings Solutions (RxSS), we’re here to help you save money on prescription drugs. We'll show lower-cost options available for your prescriptions and how much you can expect to pay. 
Managing your prescriptions can be hard, so let the RxSS app do it for you. 
HOW RxSS WORKS 
RxSS helps you take control of your prescription drug expenses. 
• The app is connected to your individual health plan, so you’ll see any medications you’re taking and lower-cost alternatives. 
• Easily search and compare drug prices with your doctor before they write a prescription. 
• Switch to a lower-cost option and certified pharmacy technicians at RxSS will take care of everything else—even getting your doctor’s approval when needed. 
KNOW YOUR OPTIONS 
RxSS pharmacists find more affordable options to treat your condition. You and your doctor decide what’s best for your health and budget. Here are just a few ways you might be able to save money: 
• Generic forms of name-brand drugs. 
• Better prices at different pharmacies near you or through delivery services. 
• Medications that treat the same condition but cost less than your current prescription. 
TALK WITH Rx EXPERTS 
One tap from the app and you’ll have access to an entire team of certified pharmacy technicians ready to answer your questions. Connect live with a pharmacy expert who will help you: 
• Switch to a lower-cost prescription. 
• Transfer a prescription to a pharmacy offering a lower price. 
• Understand your out-of-pocket costs and deductibles. 
MANAGE YOUR PRESCRIPTIONS FROM ONE PLACE 
The RxSS app makes it easy to stay organized by showing all your current prescriptions on one screen for easy tracking, scheduling and budgeting. 
• View your medication names, strengths, dosages and quantities automatically—no manual entry. 
• See Rx information and savings opportunities for dependents on your health plan. 
• Set text or push notifications reminding you to take medications on schedule.

bluejetty:00062470:ios.description:
Mouse Timer is a cute VISUALIZED TIMER for everyone who wants to measure and/or visualize the time, especially for kids who have hard time understanding the length of time.
The app expresses the length of time with a cute little, greedy mouse gnawing on apples!
Mouse Timer was developed from the request from teachers and parents of kids who attend LITALICO classrooms.
 *LITALICO classrooms are run by teachers and professors who specialize in kids development and education. 
Characteristics of this app:
• This timer can be used not only as an educational tool but also as a normal timer for daily life.
• You can use it for FREE.
• NO Advertisements are displayed so there is no visual destruction and kids can use it safely.
 Main function:
• Alarm can be set only by choosing the displayed time.
• Choices of time can be reduced.
• You can pause and resume the timer.
• This app notifies you when the time comes even when you're not using the app.
• White mouse will appear by in-app purchases.
Please feel free to notify us!

bluejetty:00177514:ios.summary:

This app works with any BLE (Bluetooth Low E
bluejetty:00177514:ios.description:
Lost your Bluetooth Headphone, Earbud, Phone, or Device? If you want to find it, install this app! It'll help you find your lost device in seconds! Take action now, before the battery runs out! 
This app works with any BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy 4.0) Headphone, Earbud, Phone, or Device, including AirPods, Apple, Beats, Bose, Samsung, B&O, JBL, Sony, Jabra, and many other Bluetooth devices. Use it whenever you or your family misplace a device – and save the money you'd otherwise need to spend on a new one!
"ALARMING" THE LOST HEADPHONE:
When the signal strength is high, but you still can't see your headphone, you can use the app to play a sound alarm on your lost headphone so you can follow the sound. This help you find your lost headphone faster and more easily than just randomly looking around. 
To play a sound on your lost headphone, please tap "Change Audio Output" on the Radar screen and select your lost headphone as the audio output. Increase the volume to maximum, then tap the radar to play the alarm sound on your lost headphone. 
RADAR OPTIMIZED FOR DETECTING HEADPHONES: 
Some small headphones may radiate a weaker Bluetooth BLE signal compared to normal Bluetooth devices. To better detect these headphones and find them more easily, turn ON the "Optimize the sensitivity" option in the Settings screen. This will increase the sensitivity of the signal detection, so the reported signal strength will be more accurate. 
TRACKING FUNCTION: 
You can enable tracking for devices in the background by turning on the switch next to the device on the list, the application will then ping the tracked devices from time to time and remember the last location and time the device was seen. This is very useful when you’re travelling and want to keep your devices safe. You will receive a notification when your tracked device is disconnected or lost. When you tap the notification message on the Lock screen, it will open the app and shows the last known location and time of your lost device on a map.
MORE APP FEATURES: 
• Find your lost device using our exclusively designed radar. It's fun! No need to read a manual. 
• Show hints, signal strength, and the estimated distance between you and your lost device to help you find it quickly. 
• Show the last seen (detected) time and last known location of your lost device on a map.
• Show your device's BLE details such as UUID, RSSI, Services, etc.
• The following Bluetooth devices can be found/tracked by this app: 
- AirPods, AirTag, iPhone, iPad, MacBook, Apple Watch, etc.
- Beats Solo (Buds), Powerbeats Pro, Beats Studio Pro (Buds), Beats Fit Pro, Beats Fit Pro, Pill, etc. 
- Bose Noise Cancelling Earbuds & Headphones, QuietComfort, SoundLink, Sport, QuietControl, etc.
- Sony Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones, Truly Wireless, WF-1000XM, WH-1000XM, LinkBuds, etc. 
- Jabra Elite, Active, Evolve, Move, Classic, Storm, Extreme, PRO, etc. 
- Many other Bluetooth headphones, earbuds, and speakers (e.g., Audio-Technica, B&O, Google, Jaybird, JBL, Samsung, Sennheiser, etc.). 
NOTE: The app can locate any Bluetooth device that is broadcasting a BLE signal.
FAQ: 
What is the difference between "Bluetooth BLE Device Finder" app and this "Find My Phone & Device" app?
This app provides more functions (e.g. Alarming Headphone, New Radar). Also, it is optimized for detecting small headphones/earbuds/devices that radiates a weaker Bluetooth signal compared to normal Bluetooth devices. To better detect these headphones/earbuds/devices and help users find them more easily, users can turn ON the "Optimize the sensitivity" option in the Settings screen. This will increase the sensitivity of the signal detection, so the reported signal strength will be more accurate for small Bluetooth devices with a weak BLE signal.
Privacy Policy: 
http://www.99mobileapp.com/pp.html
Terms:
http://www.99mobileapp.com/terms/index.html

ORDER DIGIAL PHOTO PRINTS EASILY:
The Ted's Photo Prints app makes it easy to order photo prints straight from your phone. Order photos to print from the comfort of your lounge. No kiosk photo transfer app is needed. No credit card needed or delivery address for pick up orders. Pictures are printed straight from your phone. A Ted's PhotoLounge or Print & Create account is not required. Teds Photo Prints, free to download, makes it super simple to order prints for pickup throughout Australia. Instantly deliver photos to your local Ted's. Print photos and shop for photo gifts with ease.
LOW PRICES:
Order prints and photo gifts and enjoy low prices – with no post or delivery costs when you pick up instore! 6x4" high quality photo prints are just 20 cents each and your photo print order will be ready for pickup in 1 hour. Ted's Photo Prints app, available for free prints photos instantly. Bring your photo prints to life with hand crafted high quality digital photo prints and enlargements straight from the Teds Photo Prints app.
ONLINE PHOTO PRINTING:
Ted's Photo Prints includes easy online photo printing:
• Print Google Photos: Easily connect and order Google Photos prints instantly.
• Print Instagram Photos: Select from your Instagram account and print square photos.
• Print Facebook Photos: Choose your favourite Facebook photos to print.
• Print Flickr & Twitter: Search by hashtag. Print your favourite memes!
PICKUP NEAR YOU OR HOME DELIVERED ACROSS AUSTRALIA:

Search for a photo lab nearby or find the photo printing store that suits you best. Its super simple to print photos near you. With one tap you can find your nearest photo printing store and pay pickup. Choose from your nearest Ted's across Australia, and enjoy photo printing with local pickup and photo print delivery costs are a thing of the past when you print photos direct from the Teds Photo Prints app. Alternatively you can order digital prints and photo gifts home delivered anywhere in Australia.
1 HOUR PHOTO PRINTS:
Your photo print order will usually be ready in 1-hour. We don't like to brag but your orders are often printed even quicker! 1 hour ready time is during opening hours and at peak times and for poster printing & canvas print orders can take a little longer. We'll keep you up to date via email and you to let you know as soon as your order's ready.
HIGH QUALITY PRINTS:
Your Teds photo order will be lovingly produced using high quality photo print paper. Ted's Cameras offers high quality prints for low prices when you use the Ted's Photo Prints app.
PHOTO GIFTS & MORE:
The Ted's Photo Prints app offers enlargements, large format posters and more. Design home décor in the app & print photos straight from your phone.
MORE INFORMATION: Ted's and Ted's Cameras are trademarks of Ted's Camera Stores (Vic.) Pty Ltd.
CUSTOMER SERVICE:
At Ted's Cameras we are dedicated to helping you enjoy your cherished memories in print. Our customer support team is here to help. Get in touch about your photo prints free call 1300 768 833, online at https://www.teds.com.au/contacts/ or at your nearest Ted's store.

Scoreboard is a simple, clean, and easy-to-use app for tracking scores in sports, recreational activities, and family-friendly games.
Whether you’re keeping score during a sports match, a training session, a school activity, or a casual board game, Scoreboard helps you stay focused without pen and paper.
Key features
• Effortless score tracking for two teams or players
• Custom player or team names
• Optional profile images for easy identification
• Adjustable point increments and winning score
• Theme color customization
• Font style and size adjustments
• Increase points with a tap or swipe up, decrease with a swipe down
• Automatic game saving
• Dark Mode support
• Control the scoreboard from your Apple Watch
• Update scores hands-free using Siri Shortcuts
Designed for a wide range of sports and activities, including basketball, soccer, pickleball, tennis, table tennis, badminton, volleyball, hockey, golf, baseball, bowling, cricket, and board games. Scoreboard is designed for general audiences and focuses on sports, training, education, and recreational use.
Unlock additional customization and features with an auto-renewing yearly subscription for $17.99 USD per year.

bluejetty:00116537:android.name: Car Racing:Drive Simulator 3D
bluejetty:00116537:android.summary: "Are you ready to take the wheel and dominate the roads? Welcome to Real Car Racing: Drive Simulator 3D – the ultimate car driving experience for racing lovers! Whether you're craving high-speed highway races, realistic city driving, or smo
bluejetty:00116537:android.description:
"Are you ready to take the wheel and dominate the roads? Welcome to Real Car Racing: Drive Simulator 3D – the ultimate car driving experience for racing lovers! Whether you're craving high-speed highway races, realistic city driving, or smooth drifting challenges, this game has everything you need to become a real car racing master.
Get behind the wheel of high-performance cars, test your driving skills in various environments, and explore an immersive 3D world packed with detail. From city traffic missions to intense race tracks, you’ll feel the rush of real racing in the palm of your hand!
 Game Features:
 Realistic Driving Physics
Enjoy smooth and accurate driving mechanics. Feel the difference between sports cars, SUVs, and supercars with unique handling and performance for each vehicle.
Massive Collection of Cars
Unlock a wide range of realistic vehicles, each designed with authentic interiors, engine sounds, and detailed 3D models. Upgrade your cars to improve speed, handling, and acceleration.
Multiple Driving Modes
Choose your favorite way to play:
Career Mode – Complete challenging missions and racing tasks.
Free Drive Mode – Explore open-world maps with no limits.
Traffic Mode – Navigate real traffic like a pro driver.
Time Trial – Beat the clock and set new records.
Stunning 3D Graphics & Environments
Drive through beautifully rendered locations including highways, cities, deserts, and mountains. Dynamic lighting and realistic weather effects make the experience even more immersive.
Smooth & Customizable Controls
Choose from tilt, button, or steering controls. Adjust sensitivity and camera views to suit your driving style.
Garage & Car Customization
Personalize your car with custom paint colors, rims, and decals. Upgrade the engine, brakes, and nitro boost for max performance.
Offline Gameplay Supported
No internet? No problem! You can enjoy the full driving simulator experience offline, anytime, anywhere.
Why Real Car Racing: Drive Simulator 3D is a Must-Try
Whether you love realistic driving or fast-paced street racing, this game offers the perfect balance of simulation and excitement. Ideal for both beginners and skilled drivers, it's designed to be accessible, fun, and endlessly replayable.
Perfect for car racing fans and simulation enthusiasts.
Free to play with optional in-game purchases.
Regular updates with new cars, maps, and features.
Get Ready to Race!
Start your engine and explore the open road in Real Car Racing: Drive Simulator 3D. From realistic parking challenges to drifting on the highway, this game brings the excitement of car driving to your fingertips.
Download now and become the ultimate driving legend!
Ready. Set. Drive!
"

bluejetty:00164728:ios.summary: Welcome to lit.it, a community-driven platform that values and rewards creators and users for their creativity and dedication. Whether you're an artist or a fan, you can earn points by crafting, viewing, and sharing short-form videos and va
bluejetty:00164728:ios.description:
Welcome to lit.it, a community-driven platform that values and rewards creators and users for their creativity and dedication. Whether you're an artist or a fan, you can earn points by crafting, viewing, and sharing short-form videos and various other creative content.
These earned points can be later exchanged for a range of in-app features and tools that enhance your creative potential, level up your experience, and expand your capabilities.
As you engage with content and share it, your points will continuously accumulate. If you happen to be an influencer or content creator with a following, you can also earn points by introducing your audience to the platform's advantages and by sharing your unique referral link, which can be posted on your social media profiles. It's worth noting that every piece of content you share on the app, whether it's pictures, videos, or music, has the potential to enhance the communities creativity and earn.
Lit.it thrives as a dynamic community driven by content creators, audiences, and the content itself, with each of these components holding inherent value. The platform leverages this community and benefits its members by fostering a collective effort where everyone shares a common goal: attracting more users and content to the platform. This shared endeavor directly enhances the value of the points you accumulate.
Additionally, you can easily send invitations through your unique link using the messaging apps you already use, as well as to your smartphone contacts. We'll track your referrals through this link, and you'll receive immediate rewards for every person who joins the platform through your referral link.
There is no financial investment required, and you can keep accruing points without any risk.

bluejetty:00088395:ios.description:
Fairy Flowers Match : Discover Enchanting Wilderness!
Explore the magical realm of Fairy Flowers Match, a captivating match 2 game designed for flower enthusiasts and nature lovers alike. Step into our breathtaking flower forest, where tranquility and beauty await, melting away all your stress. Let the enchanting world of flowers guide you through this soothing puzzle adventure.
HOW TO PLAY: 
In Fairy Flowers Match, your goal is to match three or more identical flower tiles to clear them from the board and earn valuable points. Swift and strategic moves are crucial as you race against the clock to clear all tiles within a limited time. Master challenging levels by utilizing boosters, granting you an extra edge. Unlock new and captivating flower varieties as you progress, revealing over 50 different types to explore. Easy to learn, yet satisfyingly challenging to master, let the calming atmosphere and soothing music embrace you in relaxation and serenity.
FEATURES
Wide Variety of Flower Tiles: Fairy Flowers Match showcases a collection of over 50 different flower tiles. Progress through levels to unveil captivating varieties, ensuring a visually diverse experience.
Easy-to-Learn, Challenging-to-Master: Enjoy a simple yet engaging gameplay mechanic accessible to players of all skill levels. As you advance, the challenges escalate, demanding strategic thinking and careful planning for victory.
Boosters: Overcome obstacles with four unique boosters at your disposal, assisting you in clearing levels and achieving high scores.
Lucky Wheel: Spin the wheel for fantastic rewards, including boosters, extra moves, and special flower tiles. Test your luck on this mystical wheel of fortune!
Smart Level Design: Engage in intelligent level design, minimizing repetitiveness and keeping you excited as you progress.
Relaxing and Stress-Relieving: Find solace in Fairy Flowers Match's soothing ambiance and captivating music, offering a delightful escape to unwind and sharpen your skills.

bluejetty:00037060:ios.description:
Be prepared to become a champion by doing push ups!
Introducing Idle Push Up, the ultimate clicker game for gym tycoons and fitness enthusiasts. Become the ultimate push up master as you build your strength and muscle rush through a series of challenging levels.
You'll start with small weights on your back and do push ups to get stronger and beat the boss. But as you progress, the weight gets bigger, making it even more challenging. Keep clicking and clicking and clicking and lifting faster to develop your muscles and see if you can be no.1 and beat the final boss.
Why do you need the muscles? 
For the ultimate fighting challenge. You'll attend a fighting competition and compete against other players to see who is the strongest. Your timing skills and strength will be put to the test as you try to hit your opponent with the knockout blow. Can you unlock your special power, the Golden Fire Fist, and become the true Fighting King?
Idle Push Up will provide you with hours of entertainment. Fun characters like the twerk master are just asking to be slapped in the face. Whether you're a lifting hero or a gym tycoon, you'll love the addictive gameplay of this clicker game.
So what are you waiting for? It's time to become the ultimate master of the gym and take on the ultimate challenge of Idle Push Up!

Iniciamos nuestro viaje como #PasajeBus y ahora con todo #ElPoderDeLaTecnología pasamos desde buses interurbanos hasta servicios especiales de transporte, viajes compartidos en autos, transfer al aeropuerto, viajes en tren y mucho más.
¿Viajas desde o hacia Santiago?, ¿buscas pasajes a Concepción, Viña, La Serena, Temuco, Puerto Montt, pasajes a Puerto Natales o incluso hasta Mendoza o Buenos Aires? Cualquiera sea el destino que elijas en Chile y Argentina, ¡en kupos.com lo encuentras todo!

bluejetty:00170114:ios.description:
Bracketology brings the thrill of fantasy sports to all your favorite reality TV shows, in one place.
Play free, season-long fantasy games for 30+ shows, including Dancing with the Stars, Survivor, The Traitors, Big Brother, The Challenge, The Amazing Race, MasterChef, Love Island, RuPaul's Drag Race, The Bachelor, Top Chef, and more. Compete with friends in a private league or jump into a public one and climb the leaderboard.
New this Fall, Prize Mode lets you play for a shot at real prizes. It's still 100% free to play; no purchase or payment is needed to enter or win.
Pick the game type(s) to compete in. Confidence Pools let you rank your picks by how sure you are. First Impression brackets are all about locking in your standouts early. Advanced mode adds more depth for the diehards. And for awards shows like the Oscars, Emmys, and Golden Globes, play our Ballot format and predict the winners category by category.
Features:
EASY TO SET UP Create an account in one click, with multiple single-sign-on options.
100% FREE TO PLAY Every game is free. Prize Mode gives you a shot at real winnings without ever needing to pay to play.
UNLIMITED LEAGUE SIZES Compete against your significant other, an entire group chat, or every Bracketology user out there.
CUSTOMIZABLE SETTINGS League Commissioners choose game types, when picks lock, and more to make each league their own.
AUTOMATED SCORING No spreadsheets needed - we track it all for you.
BY FANS, FOR FANS We built Bracketology because we wanted this to exist. We're playing right alongside you.
New seasons of Dancing with the Stars, Survivor, The Traitors, & more all premiere this September. Download now and get your watch party into the league before the season starts.

bluejetty:00023979:ios.name: Beatleap by Lightricks
bluejetty:00023979:ios.summary: There’s video editing, and then there’s Beatleap. We’re here to make the impossibly time consuming task of editing a video accessible in a few taps, and always at the tips of your fingers. Through vivid interactions and a playful editing ex
bluejetty:00023979:ios.description:
There’s video editing, and then there’s Beatleap. We’re here to make the impossibly time consuming task of editing a video accessible in a few taps, and always at the tips of your fingers. Through vivid interactions and a playful editing experience, the game begins - and only you will determine your end destination. 
Whether you’re mixing your next workout instruction video, boomeranging your last trip, enjoying the scenery, or just dancing it out with friends - we’re setting the rhythm of your life to video, and for the first time ever, it’s also intuitive.
With video editing driven by the music, the audio you choose determines the right moments for effects, styles, slowing down your video, or speeding it up. Beatleap delivers a new, powerful video editing experience, raising the bar of what anyone can create. 
Make engaging, memorable videos in seconds and preserve your favorite moments in ways that fuel your creativity. 
No more struggles to sort and find the best clips - you choose what you want to show, throw it in with the music you choose, and we’ll mix it up. Out comes a video a step above what you imagined, that tells your story - the funny ones, the adventurous ones, and all the bloopers in between. So what are you waiting for? Your next clip awaits!
SET VIDEOS TO MUSIC EFFORTLESSLY
- Pick the content you want in your video - the sky is the limit
- Watch your clip come alive as it syncs to the beat
- Tap around in a playground of mesmerizing effects
MAKE YOUR MEMORIES UNFORGETTABLE 
 - Create incredible videos in just a few taps – no editing experience needed!
 - Turn the best moments of your life into videos that you’ll never want to stop watching
 - Immerse yourself in powerful video editing straight from your phone 
 - Have fun creating something funky!
DECORATE AND STYLIZE WITH A VARIETY OF FILTERS
 - Add finishing touches with your filter of choice, from VCR and Glitch to Film
 - Enhance the light in your video for an added wow-factor
 - Explore and experiment – there’s no limit to the combinations of effects and styles you can use
---------
- Terms of use: https://static.lightricks.com/legal/terms-of-use.pdf
- Privacy policy: https://static.lightricks.com/legal/privacy-policy.pdf

bluejetty:00130297:ios.description:
Are you tired of wasting precious hours scrolling through social media apps? Do you want to break free from the cycle of constant distractions? Barrier is here to help.
Our app acts as a blocker for social media apps, limiting your access and promoting healthier digital habits. With Barrier, you can only open your social media apps if you watch an ad or wait our 30 second load times, creating an incentive to reduce the amount of time you spend scrolling mindlessly.
But Barrier is more than just a blocker. It's a digital wellness assistant, helping you take control of your digital life Don't let social media control your life. Take back control with Barrier!

bluejetty:00025878:android.description:
Welcome to OJI: your new favorite app for AI-powered art, avatars, and custom sticker creation. With the latest AI technology at your fingertips, you can effortlessly explore and redefine yourself to be anything your heart desires. Looking for a new profile pic? Exploring some new vibes? Want a custom sticker pack for any messenger? Look no further. With dozens of styles and features to choose from, the possibilities are as limitless as your imagination.
What makes OJI stand out?
► Create and share sticker packs for any messenger: Turn your photos into fun, expressive cartoon stickers in various styles. Make personalized sticker packs to quickly add a unique touch to your conversations across all messengers, and what’s more, they’re so easy to export!
► AI-powered realistic edits: Ever wondered how you'd look in a latex costume, as a character from a sitcom, or in vintage look? OJI's advanced AI styles—including Latex, Sitcom, Retro, Vintage, and Muscle styles—transform your appearance while keeping your identity intact. 
► Anime and cartoon styles: Become an anime or cartoon character with our wide array of specialized styles, including 90's Anime, Anime School, Fairytale, Anime Akira, Miyazaki, Kawaii, Manga, and many more. OJI always ensures your true self shines through, giving you the confidence that your digital avatar is as authentic as you are. Plus, with our video2video feature, you can apply our vast range of styles to your videos as well! 
► Photo time travel: Travel through time with just a tap! See yourself in the iconic 60's, the vibrant 2000's, the classic Sitcom era of the 70-90s, or leap into 2049. That's right—thanks to OJI, time travel is now not only possible, but also accessible and completely effortless.
Join the OJI community and embark on a journey of self-discovery and digital creativity. Whether you're looking to cartoonify yourself, explore avant-garde fashion styles, or make your own sticker pack, OJI is your all-in-one platform for experimenting with your digital image.
Download OJI now and trust AI to let you explore and create like never before!
Read our Terms of Use here: https://oji.ai/term-of-use
Read our Privacy Policy here: https://oji.ai/privacy-policy
Have ideas of features we should introduce in future versions of our app? Feel free to reach out at support@ojiapp.com

bluejetty:00129679:ios.summary:

• Capture mult
bluejetty:00129679:ios.description:
Scan documents and receipts, extract text with on-device OCR, and add saved signatures to your pages. Beyond Scan brings scanning, editing and sharing together on iPhone and iPad, with 32 interface languages.
SCAN AND IMPORT
• Capture multi-page documents with your camera and automatic edge detection.
• Import photos and existing PDFs to work with their pages.
• Crop, rotate, adjust contrast and apply filters to make scans clearer.
RECOGNIZE AND EDIT TEXT
• Use Apple Vision OCR to extract text from a page; text recognition runs on your device.
• Copy recognized text or review and edit it before exporting a TXT file.
• With Pro, recognize text from all pages of a document in one operation.
SAVE AND REUSE SIGNATURES
• Draw a handwritten signature and save it in your signature library.
• Reuse, rename or delete saved signatures, then position them on your pages.
• With Pro, extract a signature from a photo or your camera, remove its background and erase unwanted marks.
PREVIEW, EXPORT AND PRINT
• Preview PDF, JPG and ZIP exports before sharing. Review and edit text in the TXT export preview.
• Adjust export resolution and compression to balance image quality and file size.
• Choose original page size, A4, A5 or Letter for PDF exports. Your export settings are remembered for later use.
• Share PDF, JPG, TXT or ZIP files with other apps, or print with AirPrint.
• Export selected documents together. Pro adds folder exports, batches of more than five documents and long-image export.
KEEP DOCUMENTS ORGANIZED
• Arrange documents in folders, add tags and pin items for easy access.
• Find documents by name or tag and reorder pages within a document.
• Tap a document's title to rename it, or restore items from Recently Deleted.
• Choose your interface language with a searchable language picker.
OPTIONAL BEYOND SCAN PRO
Free tools are available alongside optional auto-renewing subscriptions. Pro unlocks:
• iCloud Sync across your devices.
• Text recognition and applying edits across all pages of a document.
• Signature extraction from photos or the camera.
• Long-image export, folder export and batch export of more than five documents.
Available plans, trial eligibility and duration, billing periods and local prices are shown before purchase. OCR processing takes place on your device; enabling iCloud Sync stores and syncs documents using iCloud.
Terms of Use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy:
https://zzsoftservice.github.io/beyondscan/static/privacy_policy.html
Subscription Terms:
https://zzsoftservice.github.io/beyondscan/static/SubscriptionTerms_AppStore.html

One app. Two levels of support. Real results.
Cofit combines clinician-informed AI with optional 1-on-1 coaching from real nutritionists. Whether you prefer to go solo or want expert support, you’re covered.

Ask your nutrition AI anything.
Not sure what to order? Wondering if a food fits your goals?
Cofit AI—built on registered dietitian expertise—answers your nutrition questions in real time.

- Snap a grocery item and compare it with similar options

bluejetty:00131523:ios.description:
iScape is the No. 1 app for landscape design. We are here to help you create beautiful outdoor living areas. Whether you’re an Industry Professional, or a DIY Homeowner, iScape has you covered.
As featured in Forbes, HGTV, HBO, The New York Times, USA Today, Fox, and many more!
“If you’re DIY’ing it, iScape makes it easy to plan out what to buy and how to put it all together. If you’re hiring a landscaper, the app can help you explore ideas and share your vision.” - Forbes
"It is user friendly and has features that include a virtual pen, the ability to insert objects and more. This is considered one of the best landscape design apps." - Borst Landscape Design
"Wish you could see how your home would look with professional landscaping? With iScape, you can create a digital model of your home's yard. Feature your favorite plants, so you can see the design before digging at all." - HGTV
Check out just some of the great iScape benefits:
Landscape Business Tools - iScape pro subscription provides the ability to create a proposal directly from the app in real time. Whip up a design, output a proposal, set pricing, modify descriptions and create a professional PDF with your quote and custom business info in minutes!
Visualize the Finished Project - Whether you’re going to do-it-yourself or hire a pro to help, you’ll know how it should look before the project even starts.
Design in Your Own Space - Seamlessly blend your physical and digital living spaces using augmented reality (3D) or traditional designs (2D).
Share with Others - Collaborate with a landscape pro, your customers or your spouse and use iScape to share your vision and make it a reality.
Complete the Project - We inventory all the products and items within your iScape design to make purchasing smooth and easy.
Around the globe, more than 5 million designs have been created with iScape helping both Industry Professionals and Homeowners save time, energy and money.
What else is the world saying about iScape?
“If you’re looking to tackle a landscaping project, check out iScape, which allows you to overlay virtual flowerbeds, trees and shrubs on top of photos of your home so that you can test out your landscaping ideas before you ever head to the garden supply store.” - Fox News
“To plan the perfect patch, look no further than iScape.” - Wall Street Journal
“If you’re looking to ramp up your curb appeal, we recommend the iScape app to create virtual landscaping." - The Washington Post
“When you’re planning a new garden or considering a change to an established one, it can be difficult to visualize the results. This is where iScape comes in handy.” - The NY Times
