bluejetty:00200143:ios.description: This Opioid Calculator Application is a tool for the calculation of total oral Morphine Equivalent Daily Dose (oMEDD). A particular design feature of the app is that it simplifies the calculation of oMEDD in cases where combinations of opioids are used. It is designed to provide easy accessibility and consistency to facilitate research, improve education and fill a void in the availability of reference conversion data in clinical practice. This opioid calculator is produced by the Faculty of Pain Medicine of the Australian and New Zealand College of Anaesthetists (FPM ANZCA) which is the peak body responsible for the education, training, continuing professional development and maintenance of standards of clinical practice for specialist pain medicine physicians in Australia and New Zealand.

It features 35 different games including the card games Hearts, Spades, Cribbage, Euchre, Gin Rummy, Rummy, Pinochle, Thirteen (Tien Len), Crazy Eights and Go Fish, the solitaires Klondike (classic solitaire), FreeCell, Spider, Clock, Pyramid, and puzzle and board games like Backgammon, Reversi, Checkers, Chess and Yatzy.

You might have played them before on our website, https://cardgames.io , but using the app lets you keep your statistics forever, gives you full screen mode for all the games and lets you use extra player faces that are not in the web version. You can also play many of the games in multiplayer mode against your friends, including in Hearts, Spades, Euchre, Whist, Lockup, Chess, Checkers, Reversi and Backgammon.

Enjoy the app and let us know if you have any problems, we can be reached on Twitter, Facebook or through our website, https://cardgames.io .

bluejetty:00082689:ios.description:
Fun and exciting game for a party: guess words and phrases by holding the phone to your forehead
FEATURES:
● Hold the phone to forehead and guess the words that your friends explain to you
● Correct answer - tilt the phone screen down, pass - tilt the phone screen up
● Over 43 000 words in the game
● 53 different categories: students, party, love, games, horror, cinema and TV, celebrities and much more

● Add new players or teams and track the scores
● Set the time for the game: 30, 60, 90 or 120 seconds

● Hold your phone up to your forehead
● Your friends should explain to you the word on the screen
● If you guessed the word, tilt the phone screen downwards
● If you can't figure out the answer, tilt the phone upwards and go to the next word
All rules and settings are described in detail in our app.
Play with friends and cheer up your party!

bluejetty:00135476:ios.description:
ICG® TRAINING APP - YOUR MORE COLORFUL, POWERFUL PERSONAL TRAINER!
The ICG® Training App is perfect for anyone training at home, on the gym cardio floor or during a cycling class. With our unique Coach By Color® System we’ve got you covered - it’s for everyone & all fitness levels! Get fit & motivated with our expertly designed free workouts from our world-class ICG® Master Trainer team. 
You can select, customize and even share workouts between friends or with your customers while also exchanging your workout data with external apps such as Strava®
Here just to name a few great features we offer - for FREE:
Get Connected - View it now or save it for later, but always on track – with great training comes a lot of generated useful data. 
Just pair your device with any of the ICG® Indoor Cycles to view, save & track your workout history as you pedal your way to greater heights.
Color Match with Coach By Color® - Why only numbers when you can also do colors! Intuitive, fun and easy, just match your bike´s computer 
to the workout´s color & data shown in the app to be in the right training zone - get fitter, faster. 
Achieve your fitness goals - Kick some serious goals with over 200 different workouts created by our ICG® experts and regular new releases. 
Just select ready-to-go workouts by fitness goals such as Get Stronger, Get Fitter, Get Powerful…. ready when you are?
Create your own workout - Be the motivator and the motivated by customizing workouts and sharing with friends and clients. It just got a whole lot harder to create a bad training.
Measure your success - All the detail you need, staring right at ya - view your performance status and a wealth of data directly on your personal dashboard. 
Are you losing power? Burnt those extra cookies? The truth won’t always be sugar coated, but the facts and figures on your home-screen will keep you on track with reality 
and up to date with the latest official ICG® workouts releases. So… no more excuses…
Keep on track and share - Proud of a workout? Got results you want to brag about? Keep track of every single workout in your personal training calendar and celebrate 
your success by sharing the data you want with your friends via social media and get cheered on!
Transfer data to external apps - Your perfect cycling partner. The ICG® App also transfers data to external apps like Apple Health, Google Fit and Strava.
The other good stuff:
• Apple Watch integration for Heart Rate Tracking
• Training data is transferred in real time via Bluetooth
• Includes an FTP test warm up routine
• Workout selection filter by intensity, duration and outcomes
• Motivational Heat animations
Unlock a whole new world & benefit from our ICG® Training App PREMIUM features: 
Ride with amazing instructors from around the world, get motivated by immersive scenic video footage from around the globe, and enjoy more than 500 guided music workouts. Set your individual goals and view and compare your Coach By Color® heart rate and power zones in real time. 
Become a Pro in indoor cycling!
You’re already an indoor cycling instructor or maybe want to become one? 
Then join our Global ICG® Instructor Club and get access to a unique set of benefits that will help deepen your understanding and technical expertise in planning and delivering your indoor cycling sessions. We will support you with high-quality music, with pre-designed class profiles and choreography for commercial use and much more!
An app that’s all Pro. The ICG® Training App. Colorful workouts with Powerful results.

bluejetty:00179741:ios.description:
The ZVV app provides you with real-time timetable information throughout Switzerland and allows you to buy travelcards and tickets in seconds. All ZVV and Z-Pass travelcards, multicards and tickets as well as tickets and day passes for the whole of Switzerland (national long-distance connections and regional fare networks) are available.
The key features at a glance:
• Real-time connection search
• Table with the next departures for each stop
• Area map for orientation from the current location
• Overview of current incidents and disruptions in the ZVV area
• Save planned journeys and commuter routes on the home tab
• Purchase tickets with two clicks in the shop or directly after a timetable request
• Check-in ticket as alternative - simply check in and start travelling
• Easy ticket purchase also for fellow travellers, dogs and bikes
• Purchase of e-multicards with up to 10% discount
• Purchase and renewal of ZVV and Z-Pass travelcards with just a few clicks
• Quick access to all valid tickets via homepage
• Digital presentation of travelcards and discounts with SwissPass Mobile
• Refund of unused tickets directly in the app
• Download of sales and refund receipts
• Easy access to personal settings and customer service
Payment options: 
TWINT, credit cards (Mastercard, VISA, American Express), debit cards, Apple Pay, PostFinance, REKA, purchase on account (several payment methods can be entered)
Available languages: German / English
Contact: If you have any questions about the app, ZVV-Contact is available daily from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. on the free number 0800 988 988 or contact@zvv.ch.

Soultime is designed to help every Christian with their emotional and spiritual gr
bluejetty:00041145:ios.description:
** Archbishop Justin Welby **
"Soultime is a beautiful, quiet and accessible way of drawing close to God in Jesus day by day. I warmly recommend it to you."
Soultime is designed to help every Christian with their emotional and spiritual growth. We offer more than 250 meditations for:
* Anxiety
* Sleep
* Stress etc
Imagine getting a call from a close friend when you’re having a bad day. Soultime is designed to help us support each other. Through "Soultime with Friends", invite up to 5 people, and we can detect when you could do with a call, through your mood checker. This feature is completely free.
Soultime provides innovative tools to help you understand your moods and personality. We provide easy to read stats from mood checker results so that you can keep track of how you're doing over time. If you're looking for the right scripture, using AI, Soultime can provide empathetic Bible verses and guided meditations tailored to your mood.
Christian meditation is an ancient biblical practice (Gen 24:63; Ps 19:14; Phil 4:8). Through its prayerful approach it helps people connect to God in a deeper, more intimate and vulnerable way. Deeply therapeutic yet gentle in its method it invites you to explore in a safe and secure place.
Soultime is a fresh way to connect with God and understand more about yourself. Whether you have three minutes or hours, in our unique library of meditations, scripture, music and stories for sleep you'll find something just right for you. At the heart of the app we are all about connection, with yourself, others and with God.
***** "If you're a Christian, no other meditation app comes close."
***** "The peace I've learned to achieve with this app is more than I can describe in words."
Meditations include:
* An original meditation every day
* Chasing away anxiety
* Help for sleep
* Stress
* Hope in hard times
* Hope in the storm
* Being kind to yourself
* Forgiving yourself
* Your true identity
* Managing stress in your families
* Living your powerful life
* Finding your why
* Hope in disappointment
* Valuing your imperfections
* Understanding yourself 
* Managing anger
* Hope in failure
* And so much more...
Also Featuring:
* A tool to alert people you nominate who are closest to you on days when you could do with a call
* A mood checker to track your daily moods
* Empathetic recommendations based on your mood
* Detailed personality test report unique to Soultime
* 100+ music tracks for meditation and sleep
* Beautiful stories for sleep
* A journal to record your moods and thoughts
* A complete Bible
* Gentle scripture readings of favourite psalms and much more
Soultime can save your meditation activity to your Apple Health app.
Subscription pricing and terms:
The Soultime free guided meditation app offers an auto-renewing annual subscription options. 
Payments will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Recurring subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period for the original subscription price. You can cancel anytime with your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
Find copies of our terms and conditions here: https://soultime.com/terms and privacy policy here: https://soultime.com/privacy

"Soultime is a beautiful, quiet and accessible way of drawing close to God in Jesus day by day. I warmly recommend it to you."

Soultime is designed to help every Christian with their emotional and spiritual growth. We offer more than 250 meditations for:

* Anxiety
* Sleep
* Stress etc

Imagine getting a call from a close friend when you’re having a bad day. Soultime is designed to help us support each other. Through "Soultime with Friends", invite up to 5 people, and we can detect when you could do with a call, through your mood checker. This feature is completely free.

Soultime provides innovative tools to help you understand your moods and personality. We provide easy to read stats from mood checker results so that you can keep track of how you're doing over time. If you're looking for the right scripture, using AI, Soultime can provide empathetic Bible verses and guided meditations tailored to your mood.

Christian meditation is an ancient biblical practice (Gen 24:63; Ps 19:14; Phil 4:8). Through its prayerful approach it helps people connect to God in a deeper, more intimate and vulnerable way. Deeply therapeutic yet gentle in its method it invites you to explore in a safe and secure place.

Soultime is a fresh way to connect with God and understand more about yourself. Whether you have three minutes or hours, in our unique library of meditations, scripture, music and stories for sleep you'll find something just right for you. At the heart of the app we are all about connection, with yourself, others and with God.

***** "If you're a Christian, no other meditation app comes close."

***** "The peace I've learned to achieve with this app is more than I can describe in words."

Meditations include:
* An original meditation every day
* Chasing away anxiety
* Help for sleep
* Stress
* Hope in hard times
* Hope in the storm
* Being kind to yourself
* Forgiving yourself
* Your true identity
* Managing stress in your families
* Living your powerful life
* Finding your why
* Hope in disappointment
* Valuing your imperfections
* Understanding yourself 
* Managing anger
* Hope in failure
* And so much more...

Also Featuring:
* A tool to alert people you nominate who are closest to you on days when you could do with a call
* A mood checker to track your daily moods
* Empathetic recommendations based on your mood
* Detailed personality test report unique to Soultime
* 100+ music tracks for meditation and sleep
* Beautiful stories for sleep
* A journal to record your moods and thoughts
* A complete Bible
* Gentle scripture readings of favourite psalms and much more

Soultime can save your meditation activity to your Apple Health app.

Subscription pricing and terms:
The Soultime free guided meditation app offers an auto-renewing annual subscription options. 
Payments will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Recurring subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period for the original subscription price. You can cancel anytime with your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.

Find copies of our terms and conditions here: https://soultime.com/terms and privacy policy here: https://soultime.com/privacy

bluejetty:00155579:ios.description:
Welcome to the Worcester 311 App! Worcester, Massachusetts, known best as the “Heart of the Commonwealth,” introduces its free, easy to use app for residents, businesses and visitors. The Worcester 311 App is a quick and easy way to submit non-emergency requests for assistance with issues you see around the City.
See a broken street sign? Snap a picture to submit with the location, and let us fix the problem! Spot a street light pole that’s in need of repair? Don’t wait until you get home to let us know – use the handy Worcester 311 mobile app to report the issue and add your own comments. All reports are routed through the Worcester 311 customer service center and assigned to the appropriate city department to be addressed in a timely manner. Accessing your City’s services has never been easier thanks to the Worcester 311 app.
Download and start using this free app today. Thank you for helping make “the Heart of the Commonwealth” a better place to live, work and play!

bluejetty:00159247:ios.description:
Platnova is your all-in-one finance and lifestyle app, offering seamless money transfers, secure savings, bill payments, and more across 80+ countries and 25+ currencies. 
Easy Setup
Sign up effortlessly with just your name and email to start transferring payments. No bank account or credit card is required to begin transacting.
Global Money Transfers
Send and receive money instantly to over 80 countries in 25+ currencies, including AED, AUD, USD, GBP, CHF, EUR, NGN, and more. Enjoy competitive exchange rates and multiple payment methods for a hassle-free experience. 
Multi-Currency Wallet
Hold and manage funds in various currencies such as USD, GBP, EUR, and NGN. Easily swap between currencies at favorable rates to suit your needs. 
Virtual and Physical Cards
Create and fund virtual or physical cards for secure online and in-store purchases. Enjoy fast and easy withdrawals via POS and manage your transactions through the Platnova app. 
Bill Payments and Top-Ups
Conveniently pay bills, recharge airtime, and purchase data bundles for various service providers worldwide, all from the comfort of your home or on the go. 
Gift Cards
Purchase and send a wide range of gift cards to friends and family at the best rates. Choose from popular options like PlayStation, Apple, Amazon, and more.
Tuition Payments
Pay your tuition fees, accommodation, and other bills in any country with no extra fees, ensuring a hassle-free educational experience. 
Vault Savings
Save in your preferred currency with flexible terms and earn competitive interest rates. Choose from short, medium, or long-term savings plans to grow your wealth securely. 
Lifestyle Services
Book flights, hotels, and more with ease. Access over 300 airlines and hotels, and enjoy the convenience of booking now and paying later. 
Secure and Reliable
Your security is our priority. With multi-sig wallets, One-Time Pins (OTPs), and industry-standard authenticators, we ensure your funds are always safe and secure. 
24/7 Support
Our dedicated support team is always available to assist you. Chat with us directly through the Platnova app for immediate help with any questions or concerns.
Experience the future of finance and lifestyle management with Platnova. Download the app today and take control of your financial journey.
For more information, visit our website: platnova.com
Connect with us on social media:
- Facebook: @getplatnova
- Twitter: @getplatnova
- Instagram: @getplatnova

• With The Glaucoma Community app, you’ll receive a continuous stream of updated, Glaucoma-related article summaries on every important topic, including research, treatments, and living tips - all reviewed and vetted by our C
bluejetty:00160544:ios.description:
Key Features:
• With The Glaucoma Community app, you’ll receive a continuous stream of updated, Glaucoma-related article summaries on every important topic, including research, treatments, and living tips - all reviewed and vetted by our Content Advisory Council members at Prevent Blindness.
• Connect with other patients like you and join a growing patient community to share stories, advice, and experiences.
• Keep everything in one place with our Patient One-Sheet, a secure, printable, and shareable form that allows you to easily store and maintain all your basic information – doctors, insurance info, medications, and other key data.
• Find access to useful resources such as clinical trials, financial assistance, and patient support groups.

bluejetty:00169004:ios.description:
“Happy Dessert Cafe” is a relaxing, casual café management simulator, allowing you to micromanage all aspects from recipes to employees as build a successful café. Create your own delicious desserts and coffee, and work towards earning the title of “Best Dessert Café”! 
Create dessert ! 
Provide your customers with a range of delicious foods such as coffee, cakes, desserts, sandwiches, and more. Continue playing to unlock even more dishes for you to make! As your café empire gets bigger and bigger, more and more funny dishes will be unlocked!
Satisfy customers to reap bountiful rewards! 
Obtain high-end ingredients, create seasonal products, and offer a variety of dishes to attract customers and satisfy everyone’s “cup of tea”!
Build and expand your café! 
Expand and design a top-notch café! Choose flooring, wallpaper, and furniture to spruce up your café and make it the talk of the town!
Host competitions to entice customers! 
Select suitable dishes according to competition rules to gain a competitive edge and earn extra points for originality! After winning competitions, customers will surely be lining up around the block! 
[Game Features]
-A relaxing, therapeutic game
Enjoy the warm art style and relaxing music 
Eat delicious food and interact with your companions at home, restaurants or on the go!
Kick up your feet and enjoy a brief escape from your troubles!
New day new game, So fresh so clean （ ^▽^）
- Super easy and relaxing for players of all skill levels!
Whether you’re eating at the dining table, riding the bus, or taking a break from work, fun is just a few presses away~
Your cute companions can automatically operate restaurants themselves. They sure are amazing! 
Take orders, make food, and bring it to the customers. Viola~
If you have ever played a business or cooking simulator, you will definitely love this game!
Also, if you’re one of the following, we’re sure you’ll want to download our game:
1、 People who love DIY food!
2、People who love coffee, dessert, sweets, and even sushi!
3、ASMR fans!
4、People looking for a relaxing building simulator!
5、People who want to put their super-fast fingers to the test!
6、 People looking for an offline idle game!
7、People who love console and free-to-play games!

bluejetty:00034998:ios.description:
Trying to learn a language but still struggling to speak confidently? Can’t find someone to practice with or tired of expensive tutors?
Meet Vocha, the AI-powered language learning app designed for effective, convenient, and affordable speaking practice in over 35 languages, including English, Spanish, French, Chinese, and Korean.
Practice Speaking Anytime, Anywhere
Vocha offers AI tutors that are available 24/7, so you can start a conversation whenever you want. Build your confidence through real-life speaking scenarios tailored to your needs—whether it’s ordering food, job interviews, or casual conversations. No matter your level, Vocha’s personalized approach helps you improve pronunciation, fluency, and speaking skills in a natural, supportive setting. Vocha provides personalized lessons and real-time feedback to help you progress—anytime, anywhere. Practice at your own pace, with the flexibility and convenience of 24/7 access.
Flexible, Personalized AI Tutors
With Vocha, you’re in control. Choose from a variety of AI tutors that adapt to your unique learning style and language goals. Set up your own speaking buddy and practice conversations designed just for you. Vocha makes it easy to focus on the areas you want to improve, providing real-time feedback on pronunciation and fluency to help you speak more confidently.
Immersive, Real-Life Scenarios
Language learning becomes more engaging and relevant when you’re immersed in real-world contexts. With Vocha, you can practice realistic conversations in different scenarios—whether you’re speaking English, Spanish, French, or any other language. Master essential interactions like ordering food at a restaurant, checking into a hotel, navigating airport conversations, making small talk with new friends, or even presenting in a work meeting. Vocha lets you create your own custom scenarios too, so you’re always preparing for situations that matter most to you.
Wide Range of Languages
From beginners to advanced speakers, Vocha supports 35+ languages with in-depth guidance to help you become fluent. Practice speaking confidently in the world’s most popular languages, including English, Spanish, Mandarin Chinese, French, Turkish, German, Japanese, Portuguese, Arabic, Russian, and Korean. Whether you’re preparing for travel, advancing in your career, or achieving personal growth, Vocha has you covered in the languages that matter most.
Supportive, Pressure-Free Environment
Enjoy a comfortable, judgment-free space to build your speaking skills at your own pace. Vocha’s AI tutors provide a supportive environment where you can practice speaking without pressure, helping you improve pronunciation and gain fluency naturally. Relax and focus on speaking confidently in real conversations, knowing you’re in a safe place to make mistakes and grow.
Real-Time Feedback
Get instant, actionable feedback to refine your pronunciation and conversation skills as you speak. With Vocha’s real-time guidance, you’ll gain the tools to speak more confidently, naturally, and fluently. Practice, adjust, and improve in the moment to achieve your language goals faster.
Start Your Language Journey with Vocha Today
Join thousands of users who are using Vocha to practice speaking and achieve fluency in their chosen language. Unlock the power of AI tutoring and start building the skills you need to speak naturally and confidently. Download Vocha now and take the first step toward mastering any language.
We’re constantly improving Vocha based on your feedback. For suggestions, ideas, or features you’d like to see, email us at vochatalk@gmail.com. For details and our Terms of Use, visit: https://www.vocha.ai/terms_of_use.

bluejetty:00186220:ios.description:
O novo SIGAA Mobile é um aplicativo direcionado aos discentes e docentes das instituições que utilizam o Sistema Integrado de Gestão de Atividades Acadêmicas (SIGAA), e que desejam utiliza-lo em dispositivos com iOS. O aplicativo permite o rápido acesso às principais funcionalidades disponíveis no sistema, caso sua instituição utilize o SIGAA mas ainda não esteja no aplicativo, solicite a sua diretoria que entre em contato com a STI/UFRN.
RAZÕES PARA USAR O SIGAA MOBILE:
- FACILIDADE E PRATICIDADE: Acesse informações importantes sobre suas turmas e atividades acadêmicas de forma simples, rápida e sempre ao alcance da mão.
- ACESSO OFFLINE: A partir do primeiro acesso, suas informações são armazenadas pelo aplicativo, que permite a visualização e consulta de dados no aplicativo mesmo sem acesso à internet.
- TÓPICOS DE AULAS E NOTÍCIAS: Acompanhe os assuntos das suas aulas e as últimas notícias cadastradas em tempo real.
- ACESSO ÀS INFORMAÇÕES DAS BIBLIOTECAS: Consulte o acervo das bibliotecas da Instituição e acompanhe, em poucos cliques, seus empréstimos ativos.
- FÓRUM DO CURSO: Acompanhe as discussões e mensagens enviadas no fórum do curso ao qual está vinculado.
- ACOMPANHAMENTO DE BOLSAS: Confira as oportunidades de bolsas de pesquisa, extensão, integradas, apoio técnico e monitoria ofertadas no SIGAA.
- DOCENTES: Agora o docente pode cadastrar e editar frequências dos alunos, bem como cadastrar, editar e excluir notícias para as turmas que ministra.
- DOWNLOAD DE ARQUIVOS: Os materiais didáticos disponíveis na turma poderão ser baixados e acessados de forma prática para qualquer dispositivo onde o aplicativo está instalado.
- E MUITO MAIS! O SIGAA Mobile permite o acesso a diversas outras informações e funcionalidades que facilitarão a rotina acadêmica de discentes e docentes. Baixe o aplicativo e confira.

bluejetty:00061455:ios.description:
The Navisphere load board app enables you to find, book, track, and upload documents for truckloads instantly, making life easier for carrier owners, dispatchers, and drivers. 
With Navisphere, it’s simple for contract carriers to manage their businesses and for drivers to submit load updates. One-touch functionality means it’s easy to manage business on the go; drivers submit stop and in-transit updates and upload paperwork—no phone call or email required! – while carriers find available freight loads with map and list views on the free load board so quickly it’s almost effortless. 
This ltl freight load board app is available 24/7, enabling near-real-time visibility for all C.H. Robinson loads when on the road. The app automatically connects to our Navisphere technology platform, eliminating the time and cost to complete required stop and in-transit updates. Drivers can also scan and submit load paperwork in the app using their phone’s cameras to get the payment process started right away. 
Top features of Navisphere from C.H. Robinson include: 
- Find available freight loads and view load details that make trip decisions easy 
- Set preferences and filters to search loads matching your equipment and business 
- See the details you want in the format you prefer with multiple views, including map and list 
- Book loads immediately from the app. Now available on regular loads coordinated with your carrier representative. 
- View load details on your phone as soon as they’re booked—no desktop required 
- Reduce surprises for carriers and drivers with up-to-the minute notifications 
- Eliminate check calls and gain visibility with automated status updates 
- Upload documents, including bills of lading (BOL) for faster processing to get paid quickly and have visibility into your payment status 
- Access more loads than anywhere else. We have thousands of loads available for you to bid on every day 
And because Navisphere is offered from C.H. Robinson, carriers can access the most loads, receive unbeatable service, and get paid quickly. 
Improve your cash flow and keep your trucks moving with the Carrier Advantage Program. Carriers that commit to tracking success and the highest level of on-time pick-up and delivery will get access to the most freight along with better and faster payment terms. Your commitment to tracking automation also cuts down on visibility calls. 
New to C.H. Robinson? Become a contract carrier today! Visit www.chrobinson.com/carriers to learn more about the benefits of hauling for us.

Chez Monabanq, nous nous engageons à faciliter votre gestion bancaire au quotidien, où que vous soyez.

Comment ouv
bluejetty:00122963:ios.description:
Chez Monabanq, nous nous engageons à faciliter votre gestion bancaire au quotidien, où que vous soyez. 
Depuis votre téléphone, accédez à l’essentiel de vos comptes en un coup d’œil et réalisez vos opérations en toute sérénité.
Comment ouvrir un compte Monabanq ?
L’ouverture d’un compte est rapide, 100 % en ligne et sans condition de revenus.
Comment ajouter ma carte Monabanq sur mon mobile ?
Ajoutez votre carte Monabanq à Apple Pay et profitez d’un service sécurisé sur vos appareils Apple : iPhone, Apple Watch, iPad ou Mac*.
Apple Pay simplifie vos achats et protège vos données à chaque transaction.
Comment assurons-nous votre sécurité ?
Chez Monabanq, nous mettons l’accent sur la sécurité de vos données bancaires. 
Accédez à votre espace client à tout moment depuis votre mobile en vous connectant à l’aide : 
- de votre identifiant et de votre mot de passe, 
- ou bien encore avec votre empreinte digitale,
- ou reconnaissance faciale.
Comment valider les opérations sensibles ?
Pour plus de tranquillité, le service Confirmation Mobile vous permet de valider vos opérations dites sensibles (paiements en ligne et virements) rapidement et en toute sécurité !
Dès votre première connexion à l’application, vous êtes invité à activer ce service.
Quels services offre l’application mobile ?
Notre application propose tous les services essentiels à votre gestion quotidienne :
• Consultez le code de votre carte en toute sécurité,
• Bloquez temporairement votre carte ou faites opposition instantanément en cas de perte ou de vol,
• Facilitez vos démarches de transfert de compte grâce à la mobilité bancaire,
• Profitez des services Monabanq Pay (Wero) pour vos transactions en ligne ou entre amis,
• Effectuez vos paiements en ligne en toute sûreté avec Payweb Card,
• Modifiez la limite autorisée des paiements ou des retraits de votre carte,
• Echangez avec un assistant virtuel et nos conseillers en direct,
• Retrouvez tous les numéros utiles en cas de pépin, même depuis l’étranger,
• Effectuez des virements instantanés entre vos comptes ou vers vos bénéficiaires enregistrés,
• Catégorisez vos dépenses pour mieux suivre votre budget,
• Trouvez les guichets CIC, Crédit Mutuel (hors Bretagne et sud-ouest) et Cash Services pour y déposer vos chèques et espèces,
• Optez pour le service Monabudget afin d’éviter les risques de découvert,
• Calculez l’empreinte carbone de vos achats,
• Accédez et partagez facilement votre RIB (Relevé d’Identité Bancaire) et vos documents,
• Bénéficiez de nos offres de parrainage.
Quelles fonctionnalités pour gérer vos projets ?
• Suivez vos opérations, votre épargne, vos assurances et vos crédits,
• Surveillez le cours de la bourse et gérez vos portefeuilles titres,
• Réalisez vos projets grâce à nos solutions de crédit,
• Souscrivez à nos assurances Auto, Habitation et autres pour protéger vos biens.
Comment contacter le service client ?
Nos conseillers sont disponibles du lundi au vendredi de 8h à 21h, et le samedi de 8h à 16h30.
Reconnus pour leur excellence relationnelle*, ils vous accompagnent par téléphone, par mail ou encore via notre chat instantané.
Suivez nos actualités et découvrez nos offres toute l’année sur votre application ou encore sur nos réseaux sociaux (X, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn).
En conclusion 
Chez Monabanq, les gens avant l’argent, ce n’est pas qu’une promesse : c’est notre façon d’être à vos côtés, chaque jour.
Mentions légales
*Pour obtenir la liste des appareils compatibles avec Apple Pay, consultez support.apple.com/km207105
*Elu Service Client de l’Année dans la catégorie Banque en ligne pour les particuliers

bluejetty:00126870:ios.name: Planny • Daily Planner
bluejetty:00126870:ios.summary:
There are countless apps that let you write down your tasks and then forget about them. Planny is different because it helps you remember tasks and actually get them done.
Unlike other apps, Planny is designed to help you get the tasks don
bluejetty:00126870:ios.description:
There are countless apps that let you write down your tasks and then forget about them. Planny is different because it helps you remember tasks and actually get them done.
Unlike other apps, Planny is designed to help you get the tasks done that you need to get done. It does that by making organizing tasks into lists quick and easy, but it goes far beyond that. Smart scheduling features mean you can plan your day in a way that wasn't possible before. Not only will no task ever fall by the wayside again - you'll know exactly what's on the schedule today, tomorrow, and the day after.
By combining your tasks with your calendar, Planny gives you a unique view of everything that needs to happen and when it needs to happen. You'll never be surprised by a deadline or deadline again!
Planny's growing list of features includes:
- Support for multiple lists as well as an inbox for quick task collection.
- Tags and priorities that can be assigned to tasks to make them easier to filter and schedule.
- Attachments that ensure all related materials are linked to tasks and ready to be retrieved at any time.
- Time and location-based smart reminders so you always know what needs to be done.
- A comprehensive calendar view that includes appointments as well as your tasks.
- Planning tools like Daily Briefing and Planner modes that help you prepare for the day ahead. Planny makes suggestions for tasks that should be added to the daily planner.
- Cloud syncing of tasks across all devices on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV and Apple Watch.
- Productivity statistics help those who like to see stats on how good they are at the thing we are all here for - getting things done!
Planny is available as a free download. Some features require a quarterly or annual subscription to Planny Premium. This also ensures the continuous development of Planny so that new and improved features can be added over time and Apple's latest iOS, iPadOS, macOS and watchOS features are implemented from day one.
Planny does not collect personal data and the developer does not have access to the tasks you store in Planny. Planny does not track its users and there are no ads in the app.
Privacy Policy: https://appsbykevinreutter.com/privacy-planny
Terms and conditions: https://appsbykevinreutter.com/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00026799:ios.description:
FltPlan Go is the essential companion to FltPlan.com. Because FltPlan Go is integrated with FltPlan.com, flight plans and NavLogs are automatically synced to your device along with Weight & Balance profiles, eLogbook profiles, and Checklists for offline and in-flight use.
• Create and file your flight plan on FltPlan.com, and it will sync to FltPlan Go to allow you to responsively edit the flight plan on the map
• NavLogs are automatically synced and downloaded for offline use
• Create and file your flight plan on FltPlan Go to sync to FltPlan.com
FltPlan Go delivers powerful routing, weather, mapping features, and comprehensive aviation information including:
AIRPORTS: 
• Airport & FBO Information including current fuel prices
• Geo-Referenced approach plates & airport diagrams (U.S & Canada)
• Weather, including METARs, TAFs, PIREPs, & MOS
• NOTAMs & Remarks
MAPS:
• Sync FltPlan.com flight plans and interactively edit on the map
• File a flight plan from within FltPlan Go
• Moving maps with sectionals, enroute charts, & more
• Overlay approach plates & procedures on the map
• Layers including SUAs, TFRs, State Outline, Airports, Fuel Prices, CAP Grid, Stadiums, and Customs
• Display METARs, Winds, SIGMETs, and animated Weather on the map
• Display MOS weather forecasts (up to 4 days out) on the map
• Breadcrumbs with enhanced playback & option to open in Google Earth
• Split Screen to view information simultaneously, including airports, Flight Instruments (AHRS), 
 procedures, NavLogs, Howgozit, Checklists, & More
• Display Search & Rescue patterns
• Course Deviation Indicator (CDI)
• View Howgozit to track real time progress of your flight
• Create or import Custom Waypoints in KML or CSV format
• Overlay in-flight ADS-B traffic & weather or XM Weather*
NAVLOGS:
• NavLogs automatically sync and download for offline use
• Email or print NavLogs from within FltPlan Go
ADDITIONAL FEATURES:
• Weight & Balance - create computations with the option to email
• eLogbook - create logbook entries to sync to our eLogbook program
• Checklists - synced from FltPlan.com for your specific aircraft
• Binders - create flight specific binders with documents or procedures, airports, NavLogs, weather briefs, & more
• Weather - search airport or route weather
• Tracking - view live tracking
• PDCs
• Cloud Tops
• Aviation Calculators
• Access to FltPlan.com
EXTERNAL:
 AVIONICS
 • Garmin
 • Dynon SkyView
 • Advanced Flight Systems
 • Avidyne IFD Series
 • DAC International GDC64
 ADS-B
 • Garmin
 • Stratus 3
 • Dual XGPS 170/190
 • Dynon D2
 • FreeFlight
 • Pathfinder
 • iLevil SW
 • L-3 Lynx
 • SkyGuard
 • Stratux
 • FlightBox
 • pingBuddy
 • Clarity
 • Custom Unit
 GPS
 • Garmin GDL 51 & GLO
 • Dual XGPS 150
 • Bad Elf
 APP-TO-APP
 • Garmin Pilot
 • Satcom Direct
 • Jeppesen Mobile FD 2.7
 SIMULATORS
 • X-Plane Simulator
 • FSX & Prepar3D
 *Subscription/Unit Required
 *Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
FltPlan has grown into the largest flight planning company in North America. FltPlan covers the U.S., Canada, Mexico, Central America, the Caribbean, Panama, and parts of Venezuela and Columbia. FltPlan’s 165,000-plus active, registered users file more than 55% of all N#-registered flight plans. FltPlan Go is a part of FltPlan's comprehensive system that includes free, web-based flight planning and filing and a full range of premium services. FltPlan has more than 18 years of general aviation experience, giving pilots access to the best support team in the business.
24/7 FltPlan Go support is available at Tech@FltPlan.com

• Add photos, set your own pricing, and add features that make your boat unique
• Check in and check out your bookings

- Meet your linguistic goals at your own pace

bluejetty:00165439:ios.description:
Welcome to Hello Town, dreaming of the best merge game.
No worries about ads or internet connection!
Help new employee Jisoo succeed and grow through merging!
Jisoo, a new employee who has just joined a real estate company, starts her first day at work with high hopes but is quickly disappointed by the shabby and old building. Through the company's mission, Jisoo helps to revitalize the old building by opening new stores, assisting with remodeling, and transforming it into a vibrant shopping complex.
Generate profits through merging, and remodel to create the ultimate commercial building! Help Jisoo rise to the position of the next executive by turning the company into a top-tier enterprise!
As you enjoy the merge puzzle game, you'll be able to expand the building even more impressively!
Game Features:
Complete customers' orders by merging!
- Merge bread, coffee, and fruits! Combine identical items to upgrade to higher-level items.
- Complete a variety of customer orders through merging and earn rewards!
Repair the old, worn-out stores!
- Use the money you've collected to decorate the shop!
- You can also raise a cat.
- Complete decoration missions and level up!
Open new stores!
- Decorate new shops and attract more customers.
- Hire managers to increase profits and expand the building!
Compete with people worldwide!
 - National rankings open at Lv 15, and world rankings open at Lv 25.
 - How do your skills rank in our country? How about worldwide?
 - Compete with users globally and become the world's best merge game player!
No internet? No problem!
- You can play offline too!
Do you have questions about the game? Contact our customer support and we’ll gladly assist you. Reach out to us at help@spcomes.com.

bluejetty:00125871:ios.description:
Discover, be creative and expand your imagination in a virtual world full of quests where you have the power to build a lot of different houses with a choice.
Build and explore the world with a fun and relaxing 3D puzzle game. All the models are based on the world's famous buildings. While assembling the parts into various models, players are also feeling the exotic atmospheres around the world.
How To Play:
- Select a 3d building model and assemble it by yourself.
- Simply drag the objects and place them on the floor.
- Rotate the floor and find the exact position by dragging near to it.
- If you will not find an object reflection on the wooden floor, then rotate the floor again and solve it like a puzzle.
- Use hints to find the exact position of the object and solve the jigsaw world puzzle.
- Get more hints by watching ads and complete the percentage for 3d coloring view.
- Enjoy the background music while constructing a building.
Features:
- Hundreds of items to build.
- Beautiful 3D graphics.
- Trains your brain and open your imagination by crafting objects.
- Designed to develop creativity with hours of world-building fun.
- Travel the world and craft your world from scratch piece by piece.
- Open world sandbox game where no specific goals are required to accomplish.
Immerse yourself in creative gameplay with city builder and create your own adventure. World 3D builder is the perfect game to spark your creativity.

bluejetty:00119551:ios.name: Schedulista Appointments
bluejetty:00119551:ios.summary:
Schedulista provides easy appointment booking and online scheduling with automated text message and email appointment reminders, so your clients don't miss appointments.
Clients can book appointments from your website, or from a "Book Now"
bluejetty:00119551:ios.description:
Schedulista provides easy appointment booking and online scheduling with automated text message and email appointment reminders, so your clients don't miss appointments.
Clients can book appointments from your website, or from a "Book Now" button on your Facebook or Instagram page. With the scheduling app, you can manage your calendar on the go.
Note: The scheduling app is for businesses and is a lightweight companion to the (paid) web product.
PERFECT FOR
•Hair stylists, salons and barbers
•Massage and wellness
•Fitness and trainers (classes)
•Therapists and professional services
•Mobile/on-site businesses
(Available in 7 languages.)
TOP FEATURES
24/7 APPOINTMENT BOOKING FOR INDIVIDUALS AND CLASSES
Clients can schedule appointments anytime, anywhere and from any device.
BEAUTIFUL ONLINE BOOKING PAGE
Customize your online appointment booking page to match your personal brand. Integrate with your website, add a "Book Now" button to Facebook and Instagram, and invite clients to schedule appointments from email. (No website required.)
REDUCE APPOINTMENT NO-SHOWS
Clients receive email confirmations and appointment reminders. Free unlimited SMS/Text message appointment reminders. (Providers also receive push notification reminders prior to appointment and when appointments are booked.)
MULTIPLE STAFF
Manage your whole team. Per user logins, access levels, notifications.
CREDIT CARD CAPTURE 
With secure credit card capture, you can charge for no shows. Credit card capture can be set up for all services or for an individual service when clients book appointments.
POWERFUL SCHEDULING OPTIONS
Create repeating appointments, overlapping appointments. Block out lunch. Specific start times, set up clean-up time.
CALENDAR CUSTOMIZATION / APPOINTMENT COLORS
Choose custom colors for your appointments either based on service type and / or set them per appointment.
CUSTOM FIELDS
Tailored specifically for the services you offer. Ask clients for a variety of information necessary for their appointment, as well as inform them about your business, services, and/or scheduling policies.
MOBILE BUSINESSES
You or your client specify a location for the appointment. Clients can schedule house calls. Businesses can offer events or services at alternate locations.
SET YOUR AVAILABILITY
Choose when you work. A regular schedule or a custom schedule decided on the fly. Your online booking page will always be up to date.
CALENDAR SYNC 
Schedulista can synchronize with Outlook or Google Calendar via our unique 2-way Google Calendar Sync. Your appointment calendar will always be up to date.
EMAIL MARKETING
Export / Import all your client data and share with just about any product. Also, Schedulista integrates directly with MailChimp.
VIDEO MEETINGS
Schedulista's integration with the Zoom video conferencing service allows you to automatically set meetings in Zoom when clients book your online services through your appointment scheduler.
MULTI SEAT BOOKING
Multiple spots can be booked for a single appointment with our multi seat booking feature.
RELATED APPOINTMENTS / APPOINTMENT SERIES
Add clients to a set of related appointments or a series of appointments at once. 
ANALYTICS
Schedulista has built-in reports that give you detailed information about your clients and the performance of your business.
HERE IS WHAT CUSTOMERS HAVE TO SAY
“Schedulista is the reason my business has taken off! It's nice to wake up to a full schedule without having to spend any time on the phone” - Kyra Gerhard
“Schedulista helps me to work my business smarter… my clients love the ease of scheduling and changing appointments. I am able to concentrate on what I’m good at -- training!” -Jennifer Toro
CUSTOMER SUPPORT
Email support: support@schedulista.com
We're here to help!

bluejetty:00128979:ios.name: Tally • Quick Counter
bluejetty:00128979:ios.summary:
Tally is the quick, easy way to keep track of any counts, from habit tracking and fitness, to scorekeeping, inventory, and attendance. Tally’s gesture-based interface keeps your eyes free while counting. 
## COMMON USES ##
* Scorekeeping
bluejetty:00128979:ios.description:
Tally is the quick, easy way to keep track of any counts, from habit tracking and fitness, to scorekeeping, inventory, and attendance. Tally’s gesture-based interface keeps your eyes free while counting. 
## COMMON USES ##
* Scorekeeping - Board games or out on the pitch!
* Habit Tracking - Keep up with your exercise, coffee intake, medications, whatever! Daily, weekly, monthly reset options.
* Event Attendance
* Inventory
## FEATURES ## 
* Easy gesture support. Tap to count up, swipe down to count down
* Unlimited tallies
* Quick tally set creation with natural language, just describe your set like "Score a game with Jim, Jill, and Jenn"
* Each tally can count up or down and have a “step” increment -- to count by twos, fives, tens
* Set targets on tallies to track progress
* Create decimal (0.00) tallies
* Event tracking histories for all tally changes
* Configure daily, weekly, monthly resets
* Visual, audio, and haptic feedback for counts
* Quick reset to starting values for individual tallies or whole tally sets
* Adjustment options to add, subtract, or set tallies to arbitrary values – great for scoring games with varied score values
* Widgets! Add, subtract, or keep up with your favorite tallies and tally sets right on your Home or Lock Screen
* Live Activities. Pin a tally set to your Lock Screen with Live Activity support
* Shortcuts support. Extensive support for automation. Add to, subtract from, or reset counts–even create and query tallies and tally sets
* Use Tally on your Apple Watch for easy updates on the go
* Sync with iCloud across devices
## TALLY PRO ##
Tally is always free to use, but you can get more out of Tally with a Tally Pro:
* Tally for Apple Watch!
* Unlimited tally sets
* Customize accent colors and app icons
* Choose alternate sound effects
* Advanced automation with Shortcuts
Tally Pro is available as a reasonable annual subscription, or a one-time lifetime unlock.
## SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS ##
* Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase
* Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period
* Automatic renewals will be charged at the same price you were initially charged for the subscription
* Subscriptions can be managed or canceled by going to Account Settings on the App Store after purchase
Have questions? Email support@agiletortoise.com.
Terms: https://agiletortoise.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://agiletortoise.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00024301:ios.description:
QR & Barcode Scanner Plus is a code reader app. Use it to scan all the types of QR and barcodes. Scan and save the codes to come back to them anytime. 
Use QR/Barcode Scanner Plus to:
- Scan codes and read the Wi-Fi passwords
- Sign in and order food in restaurants and pubs
- Scan barcodes on the products and search for them on the Internet 
- Share webpages, videos, photos, Facebook profiles, app pages on app stores, or any other information with friends and family
- Scan the QR- and barcodes in books and magazines
- Scan the codes on boarding passes for different means of transport.
QR Barcode Scanner Plus is a clean and well-designed QR and Barcode reading and decoding app that is easy-to-use and works great in your everyday situations. Scanning a QR code or Barcode will always be at your fingertips with our QR Barcode Scanner app.
The code reader supports all the QR and Barcode formats: QR code, Data Matrix, Maxi code, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, Codabar, UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-8, ITF, etc. This is a universal barcode and QR code reader app.
Why the QR Barcode Scanner Plus is a good choice:
- It is swift and reliable
- All your scannings are saved in the history 
- Use a flashlight to scan in the dark
- It supports all QR and Barcode formats
- You can zoom the image to scan 1D (linear barcode) and 2D (such as Data Matrix, QR Code, or PDF417) barcodes with more comfort
- No internet connection is required
- It is safe - only camera permission is requested
- It is a free barcode and QR code reader
QR Barcode Scanner Plus can read all kinds of QR codes and barcodes, including those containing information about products, URLs, Wi-Fi passwords, phone numbers and e-mail addresses, text, calendar events, location, etc. You can also use it to scan codes on promotions and coupons in shops to get discounts.
Install our QR and Barcode Scanner Plus app, point your device’s main camera at the QR Code you want to scan, and immediately get the result!

bluejetty:00167605:ios.name: Aimchess - Learn Chess Online
bluejetty:00167605:ios.summary:
Improve your Chess with next level analysis and focused training. Say goodbye to questions like “Why am I losing?” or “What should I be working on?” Let us guide you through the next stage in your chess improvement journey!
With our dedica
bluejetty:00167605:ios.description:
Improve your Chess with next level analysis and focused training. Say goodbye to questions like “Why am I losing?” or “What should I be working on?” Let us guide you through the next stage in your chess improvement journey!
With our dedicated suite of detailed analytic tools that can connect with any of your favourite online chess platforms, like Chess.com, Chess24 or Lichess, we can develop a unique Personalized Study Plan and targeted training options based on your own games. You can progress your chess faster than ever with Aimchess.
ANALYTICS
Connect your Chess.com, Lichess or Chess24 account for instant analysis of your online games.
Get breakdowns on your performance in key areas such as Openings, Tactics, Endings, Advantage Capitalization, Resourcefulness and Time Management.
See how you compare to other Chess players in your range, to really understand what areas you need to improve on.
Opening Breakdowns. Find out which openings work for you, and where you need to put more work in. 
UNIQUE TRAINING EXERCISES
Adaptive Tactics. Everyone loves Chess Puzzles! With Aimchess our Tactics Puzzles adapt to your strengths and weaknesses. Struggling with specific kinds of puzzles? We’ll show you them more often so you can make the most of your training time. Is one particular puzzle giving you difficulty? We’ll show it to you again a little later so you can prove that you’ve learned from your mistakes!
Blindfold Tactics. Are normal Tactics Puzzles too easy? Test your skills with our Blindfold Tactics, where you have to visualise and solve the position simultaneously!
Blunder Preventer. Given two possible moves, do you think you can spot the blunder? It’s not always as easy as you’d think!
360 Trainer. These aren’t your Grandfather’s Tactics Puzzles, instead these positions will really test your skills with offensive & defensive tactics, equal positions and mistakes from your past games. With no clear material gains available even the smallest positional advantage could be the right move!
Practice Visualisation. Memorize a board and then answer questions about where the pieces were, how many undefended pieces there were, or even what moves you need to make to capture certain pieces.
Checkmate Flash Cards. Run through a series of mates that all great Chess Players need to know, can you get them all right and beat your best time?
Much More. Also included in our Training Room is our Opening Improver, Advantage Capitalization Trainer, Endgames, Intuition Trainer, Retry Mistakes, Defender and Time Trainer. 
OTHER FEATURES
Discover a world of tactical chess content, prepared by Grandmasters, in the Explore section of Aimchess. Learn everything from basic checkmates, to high level theoretical concepts. With interactive tutorials and exercises, you can make sure the ideas stick!
Warm Up for your games with a rapid fire puzzles gauntlet designed to get your chess brain working so you can hit the ground running against your opponents!
Dedicated workouts to help improve your Focus and Tactical thinking.
Personalized Training Plans help keep you on the right track with regular targets for games to be played and exercises to be completed.
PREMIUM DETAILS
Aimchess’ Free Tier allows you to do any 15 lessons per day in the Training Room or via the daily Personalized Workouts. You also get limited access to Scouting Reports and Statistics.
Aimchess Premium allows you access to unlimited exercises in the Training Room and full access to all of our Statistical Analysis tools.
Monthly Subscriptions are $9.99 per month, or get an Annual Subscription for $71.99 (Equivalent to $5.99 per month)
Premium subscription is paid from your iTunes account at the time of purchase with automatic renewal every 30 days.
Auto-renewal and write-off of money for a new period occurs within 24 hours immediately before the subscription expires.
Auto-renewal can be disabled in the iTunes account settings on your device.

bluejetty:00062466:ios.summary:
C.H. Spurgeon - Morning and Evening: Daily Readings (with KJV Bible)
This devotional has a morning and evening meditation for every day of the year. Although these devotions are short in length, they are filled with spiritual goodness. In j
bluejetty:00062466:ios.description:
C.H. Spurgeon - Morning and Evening: Daily Readings (with KJV Bible)
This devotional has a morning and evening meditation for every day of the year. Although these devotions are short in length, they are filled with spiritual goodness. In just a few sentences, C.H. Spurgeon is able to convey the wisdom of Scripture with eloquence and purpose. These daily messages provide Christians with the spiritual energy they need to begin and end each day. Spurgeon weaves a verse of Scripture into each devotion, helping readers draw deeper meaning out of the selected passages. This powerful devotional provides Christians with the spiritual nourishment required to strengthen their relationships with God.
Faith's Checkbook. Bible Promises
Charles Spurgeon believes that we all have personal banks of faith. In his book, Faith’s Checkbook, Spurgeon urges readers to view each daily Bible reading as a “check” from God to us. Believers can cash these spiritual “checks” to receive the gifts and promises that God has given. In this delightfully creative daily devotional, readers are given fresh hope every day that God is looking out for them and working for their good. There is no better way to start a morning than with an uplifting promise from God himself.
Daily Light on the Daily Path
Daily Light is a Christian daily devotional scripture reading published by Bagster & Sons about 1875. It has been reprinted continually since then. It consists of brief groupings of scripture passages which speak to prominent Biblical themes—two themes (morning and evening) for each day of the year. It appends no commentary, but simply allows scripture to speak for itself.

bluejetty:00100712:ios.name: Shrimad Bhagavad Gita English
bluejetty:00100712:ios.summary: Bhagavad Gita is knowledge of five basic truths and the relationship of each truth to the other: These five truths are Krishna, or God, the individual soul, the material world, action in this world, and time. The Gita lucidly explains the n
bluejetty:00100712:ios.description:
Bhagavad Gita is knowledge of five basic truths and the relationship of each truth to the other: These five truths are Krishna, or God, the individual soul, the material world, action in this world, and time. The Gita lucidly explains the nature of consciousness, the self, and the universe. It is the essence of India's spiritual wisdom.
Bhagavad Gita, is a part of the 5th Veda (written by Vedavyasa - ancient Indian saint) and Indian Epic - Mahabharata. It was narrated for the first time in the battle of Kurukshetra, by Lord Krishna to Arjun.
The Bhagavad Gita also referred to as Gita, is a 700–verse Dharmic scripture that is part of the ancient Sanskrit epic Mahabharata. This scripture contains a conversation between Pandava prince Arjuna and his guide Krishna on a variety of philosophical issues.
Faced with a fratricidal war, a despondent Arjuna turns to his charioteer Krishna for counsel on the battlefield. Krishna, through the course of the Bhagavad Gita, imparts to Arjuna wisdom, the path to devotion, and the doctrine of selfless action. The Bhagavad Gita upholds the essence and the philosophical tradition of the Upanishads. However, unlike the rigorous monism of the Upanishads, the Bhagavad Gita also integrates dualism and theism.
Numerous commentaries have been written on the Bhagavad Gita with widely differing views on the essentials, beginning with Adi Sankara's commentary on the Bhagavad Gita in the eighth century CE. Commentators see the setting of the Bhagavad Gita in a battlefield as an allegory for the ethical and moral struggles of the human life. The Bhagavad Gita's call for selfless action inspired many leaders of the Indian independence movement including Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, who referred to the Bhagavad Gita as his "spiritual dictionary".

Meet, Play, Share
bluejetty:00159373:ios.description:
TennisPAL is a tennis community where you can find and connect with other like-minded tennis players using the app. Use TennisPAL to find your next tennis partner, share favorite moments, find a new tennis court, and more.
Meet, Play, Share, And Learn Tennis, Anytime, Anywhere!
Users can engage with TennisPAL by signing up for free.
As a free user, you are limited to one FindPAL search per day and one new chat every 4 hours.
Upgrade to a paid plan for unlimited tennis player searches, chats, and more.
Key Features include:
• Find tennis players near you based on your search criteria
• Find tennis courts near you
• Get driving directions and information about tennis courts
• Match with other tennis players based on tennis skill level, age, availability, and proximity
• Chat with other app users using in-app direct messaging
• Share updates, pictures, and videos with other members of the TennisPAL community
TennisPAL includes both a free version and paid subscription versions with premium features.
You can subscribe and pay on the App Store, using your Apple ID. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renew may be turned off after purchase by going to the ‘Manage Subscription’ page in settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. The subscription will renew at the same cost.
Terms of Service: https://tennispal.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://tennispal.com/privacy

bluejetty:00187244:ios.description:
Sched is the number one platform for session registration and attendance management. Manage all the details for your complex multitrack event in one place. We have a vision of a world where events are experienced not endured.
Get more out of your event:
- Full Schedule
Conveniently browse the entire schedule for events on Sched. Get the key information of your event without ever having to crack open an event guide.
- Personalize your experience
If you've already created a schedule online, you can log in to view it on your phone and make on-the-go changes. If you need to sign up for a public event, create an attendee account to instantly save your favorite sessions to your personal schedule.
- Directory
View comprehensive professional profiles of speakers and exhibitors for the event.
- Offline Caching
Fully equipped with offline storage to make sure you always have your schedule, even if your connection drops.

- "Communication is the main problem that Sched solves. It's an at-a-glance snapshot of an entire evening that easily drills down into specifics. - "Sched is really simple to use. They have fantastic customer service. The price was very affordable for our budget. They are constantly developing their software to provide more services. "
Enjoy the app and have a great event!

bluejetty:00033612:ios.name: Connected Hearts - Beauty
bluejetty:00033612:ios.summary: Step into a world where romance stories and mysterious challenges blend seamlessly in "Connected Hearts: Cost of Beauty." This game is a treasure trove for fans of romantic games, love story games, and hidden object games. Discover how love
bluejetty:00033612:ios.description:
Step into a world where romance stories and mysterious challenges blend seamlessly in "Connected Hearts: Cost of Beauty." This game is a treasure trove for fans of romantic games, love story games, and hidden object games. Discover how love can conquer all, even in the face of dark sorcery. Follow the intertwined fates of Cindy and Albert as they navigate through a compelling narrative rich in romance stories and dramatic twists!
Cindy is a young orphan who lives with a stepmother and stepsister, mourning her late father. She is almost used to her low status in the house, but things change with one overheard talk. Cindy discovers that her father is actually alive, and it’s her stepmom Rachel who merely hides him. Now is Cindy’s chance to save her dad by sneaking into the Town Hall to pick up one important letter. And how fortunate that there's a ball tonight! Meanwhile, the Mayor's son, Albert, is furious about his father not attending the ball he has arranged himself. But he has no idea that once he goes down to the party, he will meet her. The one and only…
Help two lovebirds to meet and overcome all obstacles:
Engaging Love Story Games!
Experience heart-fluttering romantic games within an immersive fantasy setting. Your decisions influence the love stories unfolding in a realm of magic and mystery!
Thrilling Hidden Object Games!
Embark on an object hunt that challenges you to find hidden objects crucial to advancing the love story. Our hidden object games are designed to integrate seamlessly with the romantic games plot, adding excitement!
Engaging Puzzles and Brain Teasers!
Delve into a series of puzzles and brain teasers that not only challenge your mind but also tie directly into the storyline. Each puzzle in these romantic games brings Cindy and Albert closer to their goals, making it a core part of the gameplay!
Collection of Magical Elements!
As part of the gameplay in these finding object games, collect magical spells and potions that aid in overcoming challenges and deciphering brain teasers. These elements are crucial in the struggle against the dark forces faced by our protagonists!
Explore a Network of Romance and Mystery!
Uncover a complex array of characters who either help or hinder Cindy and Albert in their quest. The interactions and developments within this network enrich the romance stories, making it one of the most immersive love story games available.
Join us in this free trial part of a romantic games adventure that promises to captivate your heart and challenge your mind!
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00183249:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00183249:ios.description:
How much protein do you really need to become leaner, stronger, and fitter?
This app helps you find your optimal daily protein intake in just a few seconds – science-based, easy to understand, and suitable for every fitness goal, whether it is muscle building, fat loss, or healthy weight management.
Protein plays a central role in your body. It supports muscle growth, helps maintain a lean and toned physique, promotes fat loss, and is essential for recovery, performance, and your immune system. Many people eat too little protein and lose potential progress. With this app, you always stay on track.
The Protein Calculator determines your daily protein requirement based on your body data, activity level, and personal goals. Modern scientific recommendations are applied to give you a clear and personalized guideline – whether you want to lose weight, gain muscle, or simply live healthier.
The Protein Facts section provides easy-to-understand knowledge about protein, amino acids, nutrition, fat loss, muscle building, and healthy eating. Each info card delivers valuable insights, motivating content, and practical tips.
With the Protein Sources feature, you get a growing collection of the best protein-rich foods: meat, fish, dairy, vegetarian and vegan options, legumes, snacks, and more. Each food item comes with helpful nutrition details and short descriptions to make it easier to add more protein to your daily routine.
The app also includes automatic metric and imperial units, motivating info cards and food guides, fast science-based protein calculation, and an intuitive, user-friendly interface suitable for beginners and advanced users.
Note: The calculation serves as an orientation and does not replace professional medical advice. Recommendations are based on current scientific knowledge and are intended for healthy individuals who want to optimize their protein, amino acid, and nutrient intake.
Optimize your muscle growth, support fat loss, improve healthy weight management, and boost your performance by eating enough high-quality protein. Learn more about protein, amino acids, nutrition for fitness, daily protein intake, protein needs, fat loss, muscle building, and maintaining a lean and healthy lifestyle. Ideal for fitness, sports, dieting, bodybuilding, weight loss, and high-protein nutrition.

bluejetty:00040706:ios.description:
حين تقع المسألة القانونية، لا يسعفك البحث الطويل ولا انتظار موعد. إياس يضع بين يديك محامياً مرخصاً من وزارة العدل خلال دقائق — ويمنحك قبل ذلك ما يعينك على القرار: تحليلاً لعقدك، ومقارنة بين العروض، ومساعداً يفهم موقفك قبل أن تدفع ريالاً واحداً.
 استشارة عاجلة حين لا يحتمل الأمر التأجيل 
تصف مسألتك أو جلستك القضائية، فيقرؤها المساعد الذكي ويحدد التخصص الذي تحتاجه، ثم يتولاها محام مختص في دقائق. محادثة مشفرة ومكالمة صوتية مباشرة — من حيث أنت، بلا موعد ولا انتقال.
 لا تدفع قبل أن تقارن 
اطرح قضيتك مرة واحدة، فتصلك عروض محامين متخصصين. قارن الخبرة والتخصص والسعر جنباً إلى جنب، واختر الأنسب لك لا الأسرع وصولاً.
 اعرف عقدك قبل أن توقع 
ارفع عقدك فتمر عليه أربع طبقات تدقيق في آن واحد: قواعد الصياغة، وأحكام نظام العمل السعودي، ومكتبة من الأنظمة، ومقارنة بعقود مرجعية. تحصل على تقرير يرتب البنود بحسب خطورتها ويشرح كل ملاحظة بلغة مفهومة — وإن أردت رأياً بشرياً، ربطناك بمحام مختص من التقرير نفسه.
 مساعد قانوني متخصص في نظامك 
مساعد ذكي مدرب على الأنظمة السعودية وسوابقها القضائية — لا نموذج عام يجيبك من قوانين بلاد أخرى. اعرض مسألتك عليه في أي وقت، فيفهم موقفك ويدلك على التخصص الصحيح ويمضي بك أعمق، ثم يحولك إلى محام مرخص حين تحتاجه.
 سؤال مجاني كل شهر

bluejetty:00023985:ios.summary:
NCLEX PN & RN Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation application that will help you successfully pass the nursing licensure exam set up by the National Council Licensure Examination (NCLEX) and get a high score on your first attempt.
NCLEX
bluejetty:00023985:ios.description:
NCLEX PN & RN Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation application that will help you successfully pass the nursing licensure exam set up by the National Council Licensure Examination (NCLEX) and get a high score on your first attempt.
NCLEX PN & RN Exam Prep 2026 not only helps you gain insight into concepts related to nursing exam preparation, but also helps you increase your confidence in passing the exam on your first attempt by practicing thousands of test-like questions.
### Passing the exam on the first attempt ###
In NCLEX PN & RN Exam Prep 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by exam experts that cover the range of standardized exam requirements. Depending on the exam requirements, you will need to master several subjects, each containing several subdivided content areas. You have the flexibility to choose which subjects you need to practice, depending on your situation.
Specifically, the subjects on the NCLEX-PN and NCLEX-RN include:
- Safe and Effective Care Environment
- Health Promotion and Maintenance
- Psychosocial Integrity
- Physiological Integrity
### Key features ###
- Over 3800 practice test questions, each including detailed answer explanations
- Specialized practice by content area, with the flexibility to switch between them at any time
- View analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the nursing exam is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the exam. You will find that every time you practice on NCLEX PN & RN Exam Prep 2026, your knowledge of the exam increases, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions while hinting to yourself to do the same tomorrow. After you develop good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high on not only these nursing exams, but any other exams that follow!
### Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas, and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - https://nclex.yesmaster.pro/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy - https://nclex.yesmaster.pro/privacy-policy.html
Please let us know if you have any questions or comments about your use by emailing us at contact@yesmaster.pro and we will resolve them for you within 3 business days at the latest.

bluejetty:00120951:ios.description:
Wartime Glory is a strategy board game that is a perfect mix of classic war games like Risk with special cards that give it a new dimension of strategy and tactics.
You will become a General, fight in epic battles, deploy troops, attack enemies, and utilize all strategies of war in order to conquer the world and win.
You've never seen a board game like this one. Wartime Glory was created by fans of Risk, Risiko, Axis & Allies and other classic board games. Battle players from around the world in the online multiplayer mode to win trophies and level up; Or play against incredible AI in offline mode to improve your war strategy. Climb to the rank of four-star General and unlock advanced weapons and abilities like the Atomic Bomb and Blitzkrieg.
Prepare to relieve the great battles of World War 2 (WW2) and lead your army to world domination. As a General, you will have to formulate your strategy at every turn, plan reinforcements, lead attacks, deploy defenses and use special powers and cards to turn the tide to victory.
Unlike Risk, you don't need to spend hours on a match. Matches can last only minutes as all players plan and execute their strategies at the same time.
Features include:
- Online multiplayer in real time against thousands of global players
- Trophies and rewards with every victory
- Offline practice mode against an incredible artificial intelligence
- Complete missions and special challenges for rewards
- Battle free-for-all or 2v2
- Fight in multiple maps based on historical battles of World War 2 (WW2)
- Lots of ways to personalize and outfit your army
Do you have what it takes to create an invincible war strategy and lead your men to global domination? Your army awaits your orders!
================================
VIP Subscription
- Subscribe and get coins each day and no ads! You will receive coins every 24 hours and have ads removed for the duration of the subscription.
- Subscriptions start at USD 2.99 monthly. 3-month subscription is USD 7.99 USD and annual subscription is USD 19.99*.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews for the same price and period as the chosen package unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen package.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
- You may cancel a subscription during via the subscription settings in your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. Please visit http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098 for more information.
- You may turn off auto-renewal from your iTunes Account Settings. However, you won’t be able to cancel the current subscription during its active period.
- Any unused portion of a free-trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a VIP Subscription.
Links to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy can be found below
Privacy Policy: http://www.sandstormi.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: http://www.sandstormi.com/terms-of-use/
* Prices are equal to the value that "Apple's App Store Pricing Matrix" determines as the equivalent of the subscription price in USD
================================
IMPORTANT: We take customer's feedback very seriously, this is clearly shown by the number of updates we have done since launch. So we ask that if you have an issue or suggestion you use the adequate channels (facebook, email or in game feedback). Writing your issue on a review does not allow us to get back to you promptly. If you need for something to be resolved please email us at contact@buldogo.games. Thank you!
