bluejetty:00120800:ios.description:
** nPlayer officially supports DTS (DTS HD ), DTS Headphone:X, Dolby (AC3, E-AC3).
** nPlayer is the universal app. You can install it in any other iOS device without additional purchase.
** nPlayer Plus officially supports Dolby Audio codec and Dolby Sound Effect. But if you don't mind using Dolby Audio codec embedded in iOS, please update your iOS to 9.3 version or later and purchase nPlayer in the lower price.
- You don't need to convert video files to MP4 to play them in your mobile device. nPlayer enable you to play all kinds of video formats and codecs without file converting efforts.
- You don't need to store video files in your device with limited storage space. nPlayer's powerful and various network technologies will help you to stream them from remote devices. 
- With your finger tip, you can adjust playback position, move to previous and next subtitle position, adjust location and font size of subtitles, control volume and brightness.
- Experience nPlayer, thousands of users recommendations.
* Features
- Supports officially DTS audio codec (DTS HD)
- Supports officially Dolby audio codec (AC3, E-AC3)
- Supports Dolby Mobile Surround Sound
- Supports iXpand Drive
- Supports Chromecast
- Supports video cast for Smart TV
- Supports HDMI output
- Supports video files : MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, WMV, ASF, FLV, OGV, RMVB, TP etc.
- Supports audio files : MP3, WAV, WMA, FLAC, APE etc.
- Supports subtitle files : SMI, SRT, SSA, IDX, SUB, LRC, SUP, MLP2 etc.
- Supports image files : JPG, PNG, BMP, GIF, TIFF etc.
- Supports playlist files : CUE, M3U, PLS
- Supports WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, HTTP, SMB/CIFS, NFS
- Supports UPnP/DLNA (supports subtitles if DLNA server provides subtitles information.)
- Supports cloud service (Box, Dropbox, OneDrive, Yandex.Disk)
- Supports in-app web browser 
- Supports iTunes video/audio play (except for DRM contents)
- Supports videos and pictures in Album
- Playback speed control : 0.5x ~ 4.0x
- Resume playback
- AB repeat(specific section repetition)
- Screen lock
- Supports AV1/HEVC/H.264/MPEG4 Hardware acceleration
- Supports 3D video mode
- Screen flip horizontally, vertically. brightness and saturation control
- Aspect ratio : Default, 1:1, 3:2, 4:3, 5:3, 16:9, 1.85:1 etc 
- Supports multi-track audio
- Supports audio boost
- Supports audio sync
- Supports lyrics display
- Supports Dolby, DTS HDMI Bitstream (Passthru)
- Supports embedded subtitles
- Supports multi-track subtitles
- Supports user’s selection of subtitle files
- Supports addition of optional subtitle files while playback
- Supports subtitles font, color, shadow, outline customization
- Supports subtitles sync
- Supports external subtitle fonts
- Supports SAMI(SMI) tag
- Supports SSA/ASS with full styling, embedded subtitles
- File management : Delete, Move, Rename, Create a folder
- Playlist management : Add, Delete, Modify
- Supports recently played list
- Folder lock
- Supports Open-in
- Supports UI theme
* Gesture Features
- Tap : Menu
- Double tap : Pop-up play
- Drag horizontally : Playback position adjustment
- Drag vertically on right half of the screen : Volume control
- Drag vertically on left half of the screen : Brightness control
- Pinch on the screen : Screen size adjustment
- Drag horizontally on subtitle text : Move to previous/next subtitle text
- Drag vertically on subtitle text : Subtitle position adjustment 
- Pinch on subtitle text : Subtitle font size adjustment
- Supports finger gesture customization

- Supports iTunes video/audio play (except for DRM contents)
- Supports videos and pictures in Album

- Playback speed control : 0.5x ~ 4.0x
- Resume playback
- AB repeat(specific section repetition)
- Screen lock

- Supports AV1/HEVC/H.264/MPEG4 Hardware acceleration
- Supports 3D video mode
- Screen flip horizontally, vertically. brightness and saturation control
- Aspect ratio : Default, 1:1, 3:2, 4:3, 5:3, 16:9, 1.85:1 etc

- Supports audio boost
- Supports audio sync
- Supports lyrics display

- Supports multi-track subtitles
- Supports user’s selection of subtitle files
- Supports addition of optional subtitle files while playback
- Supports subtitles font, color, shadow, outline customization
- Supports subtitles sync
- Supports external subtitle fonts
- Supports SAMI(SMI) tag
- Supports SSA/ASS with full styling, embedded subtitles

- File management : Delete, Move, Rename, Create a folder
- Playlist management : Add, Delete, Modify
- Supports recently played list
- Folder lock
- Supports Open-in

- Supports UI theme


* Gesture Features

- Tap : Menu
- Double tap : Pop-up play
- Drag horizontally : Playback position adjustment
- Drag vertically on right half of the screen : Volume control
- Drag vertically on left half of the screen : Brightness control
- Pinch on the screen : Screen size adjustment
- Drag horizontally on subtitle text : Move to previous/next subtitle text
- Drag vertically on subtitle text : Subtitle position adjustment 
- Pinch on subtitle text : Subtitle font size adjustment
- Supports finger gesture customization

ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT
- Fingerprint and Face login to access information quickly

bluejetty:00146404:ios.description:
Welcome to Hayya
Your Gateway to Qatar
Hayya is Qatar’s primary e-visa platform. Operating under Qatar Tourism, it provides streamlined e-visa services, enables the hosting of family and friends in Qatar, and facilitates B2B events across the country for international visitors, residents, and event attendees.
Hayya delivers seamless access to Qatar for visitors, and smooth access to selected events and attractions for residents.
Core Services
• Tourist e-Visa Application & Management 
• E-Visa Status Tracking & Real-Time Notifications 
• Upload Accommodation Proof
• “Host Family and Friends” feature – enabling Qatar residents to host visitors digitally
• Visa with Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) 
• Media personnel & Businesses application status -tracking 
• Event Information and Transport Guidance 
Why Choose Hayya?
• No paperwork, No Hassle
Through a single, user-friendly app, Hayya delivers end-to-end Digital Visa Processing. Users can apply for their tourist visa, track their visa application status, and receive their Hayya E-Visa directly in the app. 
• AI-Powered and Secure
Built in OCR, face recognition, and ICAO-compliant image checks verify identity with high accuracy.
• Face Match Technology
Compares the applicant’s personal photo with their passport photo to ensure identity verification and detect impersonation attempts. 
• Rule-Based Intelligence
Dynamically adjusts form fields and document requirements based on nationality and visa type, streamlining the application process. 
• Cross-Platform Compatibility
Hayya is available on iOS, Android, Huawei and devices.
• Accessibility and Inclusivity
The platform features a multilingual interface, available in English and Arabic, and customer support in 3 additional languages: Urdu, Hindi, and Tagalog. Additionally, it includes accessibility features such as enlarged text and screen reader compatibility, designed to accommodate users with special needs.
Whether you’re an international visitor or a local resident, Hayya ensures a smooth and seamless experience to visit or host visitors in Qatar.

Stream Tracker is an all-in-one growth companion for Twitch streamers.
Whether you are just starting out or trying to grow a more consistent audience, Stream Tracker helps you follow your Twitch progress, learn from other creators, promote
bluejetty:00126433:ios.description:
Stream Tracker is an all-in-one growth companion for Twitch streamers.
Whether you are just starting out or trying to grow a more consistent audience, Stream Tracker helps you follow your Twitch progress, learn from other creators, promote your stream on social media, and find collaboration opportunities with other streamers.
Track your Twitch growth
Connect your Twitch channel and follow your progress over time. Stream Tracker helps you keep an eye on your channel growth, milestones, supporters, and streaming activity so you can better understand how your channel is evolving.
Compare yourself with other streamers
Track other Twitch streamers in your niche and compare their growth with yours. Follow similar creators, spot trends, discover what types of streams are gaining traction, and use those insights to improve your own content strategy.
Create short social clips from your streams
Turn your Twitch streams and clips into short vertical videos made for platforms like TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Stream Tracker helps you repurpose your stream content into social posts that can reach new viewers outside of Twitch.
Promote your upcoming streams
Create social media content to announce your streams, share your schedule, and make your Twitch channel easier to discover. Use promotion tools and templates designed for streamers who want to bring more viewers back to their live streams.
Discover collaboration opportunities
Use Collab Hub to find other streamers, explore potential collaborations, and connect with creators who share your niche or audience goals. Collaborations, raids, and shared events can help you reach new viewers and grow alongside other creators.
Manage your streaming schedule
Build a more consistent streaming routine by planning and sharing your upcoming streams. A clear schedule helps viewers know when to come back and makes it easier to promote your content across social media.
How it works:
1. Download Stream Tracker
2. Connect your Twitch channel
3. Track your growth, follow other streamers, create short social content, promote your stream, and find collabs
Have suggestions or feedback? You can reach me from the app's Settings screen or by email at ebapps.customers+streamtracker@gmail.com. You can also vote for upcoming features in the roadmap from Settings.
Terms of Use & Privacy Policy:
www.edouardbarbier.com/apps/stream-tracker/privacy
Contact: ebapps.customers+streamtracker@gmail.com

bluejetty:00111525:android.description:
Looking for vegetarian and vegan recipes? Fast, delicious, Italian veggie food? You've found it! 
VegMenu is an app to prepare lots of veg foods. Cooking in vegetarian and vegan version some of the typical and most healthy recipes of the Italian cuisine.
A cookbook full of appetizers, first courses, main courses, salads, side dishes and delicious cakes, children's recipes, quick dishes, seitan recipes, tempeh recipes, tofu recipes.
Whether you follow a vegetarian diet, a vegan diet or an omnivorous diet, you will find lots of healthy recipes, to suit every palate.
With VegMenu you can:
• Browse through hundreds of vegetarian and vegan recipes for free!
• Cook many recipes of Italian cooking in vegetarian and vegan version.
• Choose the number of portions and VegMenu will automatically calculate quantities.
• Get step by step help in preparing the recipe.
• View the nutritional values and calories for each recipe to help you keep in shape!
• Find menus for all occasions: Christmas, New Year, Carnival, Easter, Halloween etc...
• Buy ingredients and keep them in a shopping cart.
• Respect portions by using a spaghetti doser.
• A spaghetti doser to always respect the portions.
• Eat healthy and cheap with the help of an in-season fruit and vegetable guide.
• A handy measurement converter to easily convert from grams to ounces, from milliliters to liquid ounces and from Celsius to Fahrenheit.
• Search by color recipes to have an iron constitution, or to prepare a romantic dinner for your partner, in short, for the right recipe for every occasion!
• Look up recipes without gluten, lactose or eggs.
A diet based on plant foods is:
• Ethical, because it respects animals.
• Eco-sustainable, because it respects the environment
• Healthy, because it respects the well-being of your body and of your mind.
A vegetarian or vegan diet prevents many diseases such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, obesity, diabetes, osteoporosis, dementia and Parkinson's.
For technical support or for other help, send an e-mail to the app developer: help@vegmenu.net

bluejetty:00135115:ios.description:
rMove® is revolutionizing transportation research by using in-app surveys and GPS data collection to reveal users’ travel habits and needs. 
How do you sign up? rMove® can only be used by people who are invited to participate in a study and requires a unique access code to log in. Just download the app, follow the instructions, answer your surveys, and rMove® takes care of the rest! 
Why should you use rMove®? As technologies and the way people get around continue to change, rMove® helps organizations understand how, when, where, and why people travel. Participating in an rMove® study helps your community and saves you time compared to older survey methods. 
Want to learn more? Go to the rMove® website, which offers answers to frequently asked questions and the fine print you’re looking for. We take your privacy seriously and we are committed to GDPR and CPRA compliance. You can review our complete privacy policy and learn more about how we protect your information on the rMove® website. 
And because honesty is always the best policy, we want you to know that rMove® will use your location even when it’s not open (that’s how it does its magic). As a result, you may notice a decrease in your device’s battery life. This is normal and varies based on your phone’s age, battery health, and use.

bluejetty:00178373:ios.description:
Toot! is a client for the Mastodon social network. It is beautiful, and full of character and whimsy.
What makes Toot! special?
- It is delightful. It is full of beautiful design, animation, amusing details and hidden treasures.
- It is fast and robust. It caches data locally to let you read without waiting for slow loading, and it remembers your reading position.
- It lets you be as many people as you like. You can easily switch between accounts with a flick of your finger. It even lets you read timelines on instances you are not logged in to!
- It has wide support for most features in Mastodon.
- It has the cutest icon.
What makes Mastodon special?
- It is a social network by humans, rather than algorithms and corporate interests.
- It is a social network for humans, rather than advertisers and data collectors.
- It is a social network that is humane, rather than preying on your insecurities and worst instincts.
Why does Toot! cost money?
- Toot! shows you no ads, and it collects none of your information, nor does it track any of your habits. It does not try to trick you into doing anything you do not want.
- That means it gets no money through such shady tricks, and relies on you to support its development.
Follow @tootapp@mastodon.social for more updates and information!
Also, many icons by icons8.com.

bluejetty:00041936:ios.description:
Dive into the thrilling world of "Dinosaur Coding - Trucks," an innovative app designed to ignite a passion for coding in kids through a captivating superhero adventure. This app brilliantly combines entertainment with education, allowing children to take on the role of coding superheroes. They'll control mechanical dinosaur trucks, or 'Dinotrucks', on heroic rescue missions, saving trapped dinosaurs and overcoming various challenges.
The heart of this app lies in its visual block-based programming system. Kids can effortlessly write instructions by simply dragging and clicking pattern blocks. This method makes programming as straightforward as building with blocks, removing the need for literacy in early learning stages. Children will engage in various tasks like melting ice blocks, destroying rocks, and breaking through stone walls, all by coding their Dinotruck's actions.
Across 6 vividly themed scenes, the app presents 84 engaging levels of coding challenges. Each level is designed to teach essential coding concepts like sequencing and looping. The levels progress from simple to complex. This progressive learning approach is supplemented by a well-designed guiding teaching and hint system, which offers support and encouragement, especially when kids face tougher challenges.
In addition to the core programming missions, "Dinosaur Coding - Trucks" includes 24 exciting parkour-style levels, blending coding learning with dynamic gameplay. This feature not only enhances the fun factor but also encourages physical thinking and strategy.
The app boasts more than 18 cool mechanical dinosaur trucks and 6 unique companion characters, each adding a layer of engagement and interaction. The daily challenge feature adds a fresh dimension to the gameplay, encouraging regular play and offering generous rewards for consistency and progress.
Parents and educators will appreciate that "Dinosaur Coding - Trucks" can be played offline, ensuring that learning and fun are uninterrupted. Moreover, the absence of third-party advertisements makes for a safe and focused learning environment.
Overall, "Dinosaur Coding - Trucks" offers an immersive coding adventure for kids, transforming them into coding superheroes who save the day while learning the essential skills of the future. With its unique blend of education and entertainment, it's an ideal choice for young learners embarking on their coding journey.
Features:
• Visualized block-based programming system tailored for effortless coding for kids
• Drag, arrange, and click to program - as easy as playing with blocks
• Thoughtfully designed hint system aiding players in overcoming challenges
• Command over 18 cool mechanical dinosaur trucks for heroic rescues
• 6 themed scenes and 6 distinct companion characters for captivating gameplay
• 108 thoughtfully designed levels for gradual learning of programming concepts such as sequences and loops
• Newly added daily challenge feature with generous rewards for dedicated play
• Play offline without needing an internet connection
• No third-party advertisements
Embark on a coding adventure with Dinosaur Coding - Trucks, one of the best coding games for kids! Save the trapped dinosaurs and become a coding superhero today!
About Yateland:
Yateland's educational apps ignite the passion for learning through play among preschool children worldwide. We stand by our motto: "Apps that children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, please visit https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
Yateland is committed to protecting user privacy. To understand how we handle these matters, please read our complete privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

Dive into the thrilling world of "Dinosaur Coding - Trucks," an innovative app designed to ignite a passion for coding in kids through a captivating superhero adventure. This app brilliantly combines entertainment with education, allowing children to take on the role of coding superheroes. They'll control mechanical dinosaur trucks, or 'Dinotrucks', on heroic rescue missions, saving trapped dinosaurs and overcoming various challenges.

The heart of this app lies in its visual block-based programming system. Kids can effortlessly write instructions by simply dragging and clicking pattern blocks. This method makes programming as straightforward as building with blocks, removing the need for literacy in early learning stages. Children will engage in various tasks like melting ice blocks, destroying rocks, and breaking through stone walls, all by coding their Dinotruck's actions.

Across 6 vividly themed scenes, the app presents 84 engaging levels of coding challenges. Each level is designed to teach essential coding concepts like sequencing and looping. The levels progress from simple to complex. This progressive learning approach is supplemented by a well-designed guiding teaching and hint system, which offers support and encouragement, especially when kids face tougher challenges.

In addition to the core programming missions, "Dinosaur Coding - Trucks" includes 24 exciting parkour-style levels, blending coding learning with dynamic gameplay. This feature not only enhances the fun factor but also encourages physical thinking and strategy.

The app boasts more than 18 cool mechanical dinosaur trucks and 6 unique companion characters, each adding a layer of engagement and interaction. The daily challenge feature adds a fresh dimension to the gameplay, encouraging regular play and offering generous rewards for consistency and progress.

Parents and educators will appreciate that "Dinosaur Coding - Trucks" can be played offline, ensuring that learning and fun are uninterrupted. Moreover, the absence of third-party advertisements makes for a safe and focused learning environment.

Overall, "Dinosaur Coding - Trucks" offers an immersive coding adventure for kids, transforming them into coding superheroes who save the day while learning the essential skills of the future. With its unique blend of education and entertainment, it's an ideal choice for young learners embarking on their coding journey.

Features:
• Visualized block-based programming system tailored for effortless coding for kids
• Drag, arrange, and click to program - as easy as playing with blocks
• Thoughtfully designed hint system aiding players in overcoming challenges
• Command over 18 cool mechanical dinosaur trucks for heroic rescues
• 6 themed scenes and 6 distinct companion characters for captivating gameplay
• 108 thoughtfully designed levels for gradual learning of programming concepts such as sequences and loops
• Newly added daily challenge feature with generous rewards for dedicated play
• Play offline without needing an internet connection
• No third-party advertisements

Embark on a coding adventure with Dinosaur Coding - Trucks, one of the best coding games for kids! Save the trapped dinosaurs and become a coding superhero today!

About Yateland:
Yateland's educational apps ignite the passion for learning through play among preschool children worldwide. We stand by our motto: "Apps that children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, please visit https://yateland.com.

Privacy Policy:
Yateland is committed to protecting user privacy. To understand how we handle these matters, please read our complete privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00117698:ios.summary:

Galaxy Reborn: Second Empire is a real-time multiplayer space strategy game. Start on one planet, build your economy, research new technologies and expand into a universe shared with other players. Som
bluejetty:00117698:ios.description:
Build an empire. Then try to keep it.
Galaxy Reborn: Second Empire is a real-time multiplayer space strategy game. Start on one planet, build your economy, research new technologies and expand into a universe shared with other players. Some will become allies. Others want what is yours.
CHOOSE YOUR PLAYSTYLE
• Miner: Build mines on your planets and colonies. Produce metal, crystal and deuterium to fuel your growth.
• Farmer: Find resources left unprotected on other players' planets. Launch raids and bring the spoils home.
• Fleeter: Hunt enemy fleets, fight space battles and recycle the debris into resources for your next move.
There are no forced classes. Mix all three to build your own strategy.
BUILD FOR THE LONG GAME
Develop mines, power plants, research labs, shipyards and defenses. Use the tech tree to plan what to unlock next. Manage resources across your empire and develop moons with their own specialized buildings.
FIND YOUR ALLIES
Join an alliance for advice, coordinated attacks and defense missions. Talk through in-game messages, world chat and alliance chat. Experienced players can help you learn the ropes; ask questions and find your place in the community.
START WITH NOOB PROTECTION
New players have a degree of protection from larger empires. While protected, you can attack and be attacked only by new players of similar rank. As your points grow, stronger opponents enter the picture. Protection is a head start, not a permanent shield.
OPTIONAL PREMIUM PURCHASES
You do not need to buy Dark Matter to advance. Dark Matter purchases are optional and fund premium features, including officers, the resource Trader and planet moves. Officers provide gameplay benefits; planning, timing and alliances still matter.
JOIN THE COMMUNITY
Visit grse.app for downloads and the game guide. Join an alliance in the game for advice and conversation.
The universe is already running. Found a planet. See if you can hold it.

bluejetty:00167361:ios.summary: Create beautiful invitations for your loved ones using the Invitation Maker app, the perfect app for designing invitations and event cards for all occasions. Whether it’s a wedding, birthday, party, or holiday gathering, create stunning inv
bluejetty:00167361:ios.description:
Create beautiful invitations for your loved ones using the Invitation Maker app, the perfect app for designing invitations and event cards for all occasions. Whether it’s a wedding, birthday, party, or holiday gathering, create stunning invitation cards on your iPhone, send them instantly online, and manage guest responses all in one place.
Explore the vast collection of invitation card templates to create your own. Once you choose a template, the custom invitation maker tool lets you modify every bit of your card. Insert text, change font, size, color, spacing, format, and so on. You can also add or change the invitation background, add stickers, and manage layers to craft the unique card your loved ones deserve.
Key Features:
• Collection of 1000+ invitation card templates
• Multiple invitation categories such as Wedding, Holiday, Party, Birthday, Event, etc.
• Fully customizable text with options to adjust font, size, color, spacing, alignment, and more
• Add and personalize photos in the invitations
• Change or add card background
• Add stickers and customize as you want
• Manage multiple layers to arrange your edit
• Export invitations in PNG, JPEG, and PDF formats
• Share invitations directly via Email, Messages, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, and more
• Create online RSVPs to track and manage guest responses easily
Invitation Templates for Every Occasion
The Invitation Maker app offers an extensive collection of templates tailored to suit every occasion and event imaginable. Whether you're looking for a wedding or party invitation, this app offers an abundance of options. Additionally, the invitation templates are neatly categorized into sections such as birthdays, holidays, or any other event you can think of.
Make Every Invitation Your Own
Showcase your creativity in every invitation you send with one of the best apps for custom invitations on iPhone. Choose from 200+ fonts, add and style your text, then adjust size, color, spacing, and alignment to match your design. Add photos and stickers to enhance your invitation with visual elements. Customize further using gradients, patterns, textures, and colors, and easily arrange every layer to create the perfect design.
Share Invitations & Track RSVPs
Our Invitation Maker app is perfect for birthdays, weddings, anniversaries, parties, and more. Once your invitation card is ready, send it directly to your contacts using email, messages, or social apps like Facebook, WhatsApp, and Instagram. Easily manage event details like the date, RSVP deadline, location, gift registry, and guest list, all in one place to keep guests informed and your event organized. 
Auto-Renewable Subscription Terms:
Subscribe to unlock full access to all features.
• Subscription Length: Weekly, Yearly
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription with a free trial period automatically renews to a paid subscription unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the trial period.
• Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the trial period.
• You can manage or cancel subscriptions from your App Store account settings.
• Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.
• By signing up for this subscription, you agree to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
Terms of Use:
https://pixeltouch.net/legal/invitation-maker/terms.html
Privacy Policy:
https://pixeltouch.net/legal/invitation-maker/privacy.html
Disclaimer: This app is free to download, but you will be required to sign-up for an auto-renewing subscription to access the app's full functionality.

Complete tasks by playing the fun, challenging and relaxing match-3 puzzles to win stars so you can help cute cats restore, create, paint, build, decorate, design, renovate their rooms and houses by buying and choosing the right furniture that fits their look and style. You can invite, collect different cute cats and customize their looks with beautiful skins, cute cats emotions and soothing meow sounds. 
This game is perfect for kitty cat owners and pet lovers who like to be creative, who love to create, paint, restore, renovate, decorate, build and design houses, rooms, cute homes and mansions! You can also interact with the cute cats and make them meow, jump and move or walk around the house.

• FREE Cat home renovation & cat home design and improvement game
• Create, Build, Paint, Restore, Renovate, Decorate house by buying and placing furniture & fixtures
• Play as a decorator or as an architect who can design, decorate, renovate, build, create, paint the house, home and mansion
• Select from 3 furniture options for each item you decide to buy using stars and design and decorate your room accordingly
• Invite new cute cats to live in the rooms, house, mansion, home that you finished decorating, repainting, designing, creating for these cuties
• Collect, Customize & Interact with different cute Cats, kitties, kittens and cuties
• Unlock other rooms, home, mansion, house by completing tasks on task list
• Earn bonus rewards when you complete restoring, renovating, creating, designing & decorating cat cuties home, room, mansion, house.
• Dress up your cat with your favorite skins and also add emoticons, make them cuties!
• Interact with your cute cats, tap, swipe right and left to move them around the house
• Read funny chat meow messages and listen to meow sounds when you complete tasks and have a blast!
• Multiple rooms to decorate, design, create, paint, restore and renovate, rooms such as living room, bedroom, kitchen, garden room, game room, bathroom and many more rooms!
• Changing background colors with calming and relaxing music with cool cat sounds
• Calm and relaxing music along with challenging match-3 puzzles
• Stress Reliever and extremely cute and soothing!
GET STARS BY PLAYING MATCH 3 GAME! One of the best parts of Cat Home Design Game is that you can get stars by playing fun match 3 puzzle game! This match 3 puzzle game has all the fun blast elements that you would like:
• Slide to create match 3 items with a blast 
• Win bonuses for creating match 4 and match 5 combinations with cool blast
• Combine 7 elements to create a booster that can give you a mega blast powerup !
• Increasing difficulty with challenging puzzles every time you move up a level
• Use fun magic boosters to finish your puzzles even quicker!
• Earn stars to purchase beautiful furniture for your cute meow cat houses
• Limited amount of moves for each level
• Replayable yet still fun and addictive mind boggling yet entertaining puzzles!

bluejetty:00023636:ios.summary: PTSD Coach was designed for those who have, or may have, posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD). This app provides you with education about PTSD, information about professional care, a self-assessment for PTSD, opportunities to find support,
bluejetty:00023636:ios.description:
PTSD Coach was designed for those who have, or may have, posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD). This app provides you with education about PTSD, information about professional care, a self-assessment for PTSD, opportunities to find support, and tools that can help you manage the stresses of daily life with PTSD. Tools range from relaxation skills and positive self-talk to anger management and other common self-help strategies. You can customize tools based on your preferences and can integrate your own contacts, photos, and music. This app can be used by people who are in treatment as well as those who are not.
PTSD Coach was created by VA’s National Center for PTSD and DoD’s National Center for Telehealth & Technology.

bluejetty:00082007:ios.description:
We at CALOR believe that achieving your health and fitness goals should be simple, intuitive, and even enjoyable. Our app is constantly improving and is designed to empower you on your wellness journey by providing a comprehensive suite of tools to track your nutrition, visualize your meals, and gain valuable insights into your eating habits.
HOW TO USE CALOR AI:
CALOR is backed by scientifical research and papers such as the basal metabolic rate, fine tuned to your unique self.
Complete a quick lifestyle quiz to create a personalized diet and fitness plan designed around your specific health goals, whether that’s weight management, improving daily nutrition, or achieving fitness milestones.
Snap a picture of your meal and let our cutting-edge AI scan and provide an in-depth nutritional breakdown, including calorie, macronutrient, and ingredient details, even identifying special dietary needs such as gluten content or FODMAP-friendly options.
Log your meals and exercise with ease using our intuitive daily tracker. Calor AI not only counts calories but also tracks your exercise and overall health, offering seamless integration with popular apps like MyFitnessPal to make your fitness journey smoother.
Calor AI goes beyond being a simple calorie counter or diet app—it’s a comprehensive health and wellness tool that adapts to your lifestyle. We understand that life is busy, so we’ve made it quick and effortless for you to log your food, track your weight, and get actionable insights on your diet and exercise. Whether you're aiming for weight loss, muscle gain, or simply maintaining a healthy lifestyle, we’ve got you covered.
Our app is also tailored to fit specific dietary preferences, offering personalized recommendations for gluten-free, low-FODMAP, or other specialized diets. Calor AI is designed to make your health goals easier to achieve, without spending hours logging every detail.
KEY FEATURES:
- Easy meal tracking through photo capture.
- Detailed nutritional breakdown of your food intake.
- Personalized insights and trends about your diet.
- Goal setting and progress monitoring.
- User-friendly interface for seamless daily use.
Join thousands of users who have transformed their relationship with food through CALOR.
Have feedback or ideas? We’d love to hear from you! Email us at team@calico.games for any questions or suggestions. We're here to support you every step of the way on your path to better health.
DISCLAIMER: The nutritional and fitness advice provided by Calor AI is for informational purposes only. We encourage users to consult with healthcare professionals before making significant changes to their diet or exercise routines.
*A SUBSCRIPTION IS REQUIRED FOR DETAILED ANALYSIS.

bluejetty:00132663:android.name: Hole Master: Army Attack
bluejetty:00132663:android.summary: Welcome to "Hole Master: Army Attack," the ultimate fusion of strategy and physics-based fun! In this thrilling mobile game, you'll take on the role of a cosmic commander, controlling a voracious black hole to lead your army to victory. Are
bluejetty:00132663:android.description:
Welcome to "Hole Master: Army Attack," the ultimate fusion of strategy and physics-based fun! In this thrilling mobile game, you'll take on the role of a cosmic commander, controlling a voracious black hole to lead your army to victory. Are you ready to lead your troops into the cosmic battleground and emerge as the ultimate Hole Master?
Key Features:
- Innovative Gameplay: You control a black hole by using intuitive touch gestures to manipulate gravitational forces, strategically guiding your troops to victory.
- Strategic Depth: Consider troop types, numbers, and special abilities as you work to conquer your opponents.
- Endless Levels: Explore a variety of visually stunning and diverse environments as you progress through the game.
- Troop Variety: Build your army with a diverse set of unit types, each with its unique strengths and weaknesses.
- Upgrade and Customize: Improve your black hole and army with upgrades, customize their appearance, and unlock powerful abilities.
- Stunning Graphics: Experience breathtaking visuals that bring the battles to life.
- Intuitive Controls: Master the art of controlling your black hole with simple, intuitive touch gestures.
How to Play:
- Controlling Your Black Hole: To become a Hole Master, you must learn to control your black hole. The black hole's gravitational force will attract nearby troops, pulling them towards it. Be strategic in your movements to gather as many troops as possible.
- Building Your Army: As you absorb troops, they become a part of your army. Swipe your black hole over the units you want to capture, and they will be added to your forces.
- Strategic Deployment: Once you've amassed a formidable army, it's time to deploy them into battle.
- Upgrades and Customization: After each battle, you'll earn rewards that can be used to upgrade your black hole's abilities and improve your troops.
- Achieve Victory: Your goal is to lead your army to victory.
Master the power of hole, and lead your army to victory in "Hole Master: Army Attack." Are you ready to become the Hole Master and dominate the battlefield? Download now and start your journey to conquest!

bluejetty:00123732:ios.description:
Block Hit Puzzle is a free classic block puzzle game that won’t let your brain get bored! 
It's also addictive: once you play it, you'll never want to give it up!
Game rules are very easy – the Block Hit Puzzle goal is to complete each level by filling the game field with many-colored blocks. 
Drag the colorful block of various shapes to fill up all free space. Blocks can't be rotated. It is simple to play and fun to keep challenging yourself.
So, are you ready to test your wits and smarts?

Welcome to Mini Monsters: Card Collector, a captivating CCG adventure where you'll embark on a thrilling journey through a vibrant world filled with adorable mini monsters! Unpack card packs, collect rare cards, and engage in exhilarating mini games as you strive to become the ultimate card collector.
In Mini Monsters: Card Collector, as a budding card collector, your goal is to collect a deck of monsters from rare to legendary and find rare items for your collection!
The heart of Mini Monsters: Card Collector lies in its dynamic gameplay, which seamlessly blends card collecting, mini-games, and a strategic card battle. At the core of your adventure are the mini monsters themselves, each with their own unique abilities, strengths, and weaknesses. From mischievous imps to powerful dragons, there's a mini monster for every type of collector.
To expand your collection, you'll need to unpack card packs containing a variety of cards, ranging from common creatures to legendary monsters. These card packs can be acquired through earning coins by completing mini-game challenges.
Mini-games are a key aspect of the Mini Monsters: Card Collector experience, offering a fun and rewarding way to earn coins and unlock card packs. From memory games to puzzle challenges, there's no shortage of mini-games to enjoy in this CCG games. Test your CCG skills, earn rewards, and uncover rare cards to add to your collection.
With its charming visuals, addictive gameplay, and vibrant collectables, Mini Monsters: Card Collector offers an immersive CCG experience that will keep you coming back for more. Join the adventure today and begin your journey to becoming the ultimate card collector in Mini Monsters: Card Collector!

bluejetty:00187559:ios.description:
Microsoft Intune helps organizations manage access to corporate apps, data, and resources. Company Portal is the app that lets you, as an employee of your company, securely access those resources.
Before you can use this app, make sure your IT admin has set up your work account. Your company must also have a subscription to Microsoft Intune.
Company Portal helps simplify the tasks you need to do for work: 
• Enroll your device to access corporate resources, including Office, email, and OneDrive for Business
• Quickly reset the password to your work account if you should forget it
• Find apps that will help you with your daily tasks as provided by your company
• View and manage all your enrolled devices – and wipe them yourself if they get lost or stolen
• Get help from your IT department with easy-to-find contact information
A note about Intune: every organization has different access requirements, and will use Intune in ways that they determine will best manage their information. Some functionality might be unavailable in certain countries. If you have questions about how this app is being used within your organization, your company’s IT administrator should have those answers for you. Microsoft, your network provider, and your device’s manufacturer do not know how Intune will be used by your organization.

bluejetty:00076357:ios.description:
HushDM is a private photo vault with a built-in end-to-end encrypted messenger — and a decoy password that hides everything behind a fake vault.
4.6 stars — trusted by thousands of users who take privacy seriously
Forget hoping no one scrolls through your Camera Roll. Forget worrying about what a stranger could see if they picked up your phone. HushDM is password-protected, end-to-end encrypted for chat, and invisible until you enter the real password.
■ PRIVATE PHOTO VAULT
Import photos and videos from your Camera Roll into a password-protected private vault. Organize albums, browse your collection, and access it anywhere — only you can open it.
■ DECOY PASSWORD
Set a second password that opens a fake vault. If someone grabs your phone or forces you to unlock the app, they see decoy content. Your real private vault stays completely hidden behind your actual password.
■ END-TO-END ENCRYPTED CHAT
HushDM includes a full peer-to-peer messenger for chatting with other HushDM users. Messages are protected with X25519 key agreement and the Double-Ratchet protocol — the same cryptographic foundation that powers the world's most trusted private messengers. No one — not us, not Apple, not anyone in the middle — can read them.
■ ICLOUD SYNC — PRIVATELY
Back up your private vault to iCloud on your own Apple ID. Control Wi-Fi-only sync and manage storage inside the app. Your content never leaves your devices.
■ TRASH BIN
Accidentally deleted a photo? Restore it from Trash. Empty the bin whenever you want to permanently clear deleted files.
■ ORGANIZED & FAST
Create albums, sort your collection, and browse your vault as easily as the native Photos app — just completely private.
■ HUSHDM FEATURES:
‣ Secret photo & video vault with password lock
‣ Decoy passcode — show a clean vault to intruders
‣ Built-in end-to-end encrypted messenger
‣ Private iCloud sync & backup
‣ Album organization
‣ Trash bin with restore
‣ Requires iOS 18.0 or later · iPhone
► Download HushDM free and start your 7-day Premium trial.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
HushDM Premium unlocks the full feature set. A 7-day free trial converts to an auto-renewing subscription (Weekly or Yearly) at the price shown in-app at the time of purchase. The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel at any time in your Apple ID subscriptions in Settings.
__________

Support: https://hushdm.app/support

bluejetty:00184829:ios.summary:
The quickest, friendliest way to run a Secret Santa gift exchange, with fully shareable Wish Lists.
Set up your exchange in a few taps and let the app do the matching. Only you need the app. Everyone else receives their secret match by ema
bluejetty:00184829:ios.description:
The quickest, friendliest way to run a Secret Santa gift exchange, with fully shareable Wish Lists.
Set up your exchange in a few taps and let the app do the matching. Only you need the app. Everyone else receives their secret match by email or SMS, with nothing to install.
How it works:
• Create an event, set a gift budget, and add a personal message.
• Add people from your contacts, or just type a name and an email or phone number.
• Choose any "must buy for" or "must not buy for" pairings.
• Tap once and everyone is secretly matched.
• Send the assignments by email or SMS, or export a PDF to hand out.
Wish Lists (in-app purchase):
Let every guest share a few gift ideas, so their Secret Santa always gets it right. No more guessing, no more unwanted gifts.
Gift ideas:
Every guest sees a couple of suggestions for the person they're buying for, matched to your budget, with a link to shop for each one online.
Why people love it:
• No account and no sign-in. Start straight away.
• Private by design. Your events are stored on your device and backed up to your own private iCloud. Contact details are only ever used to send the assignments, never for marketing.
• Only the organiser installs the app. Everyone else is notified by email or SMS.
• Send messages in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, or German.
• Copy last year's exchange and add rules so the same pairs never repeat.
• Great for kids' parties too: use a child's name with a parent's email, or print their invite.
Not just for Christmas. Perfect for birthdays, Thanksgiving, Hanukkah, office parties, and any time a group wants to swap gifts.
Your privacy matters. You never have to create an account, and contact details are only ever used to send the assignments. Read more: https://www.secretsantas.gifts/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00028674:ios.description:
◆ Attention
No responsibility is taken for data lost by device changes or uninstalling the game. Please take particular care of your data when changing devices or reinstalling.
◆ Features
+ Vast Open World RPG! An expanded world to explore!
+ Exploration, Gathering, Fishing and Crafting for survival!
+ 3 times as many items and weapons than the previous game
+ More detailed character customization and appearances
+ Over 60 maps and regions to explore!
+ "World Missions" that take place across the globe
+ Create and upgrade your own special forces team
+ Artillery Support, Air Support, and Powerful Drones!
+ Embark on "Battle Armor" and engage in combat
+ Advanced graphics and upgraded systems
■ About “Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse”
'Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse' is the sequel to 'Bad 2 Bad: Delta' and 'Extinction', armed with a vaster world and richer content. Apocalypse follows the story of the Delta Team, led by Major Pan, saving and reconstructing the world ravaged by a virus from the Human Forces. Join the Delta Team on their journey from survival to rebuilding the world.
■ Survival and Rebuilding
With the core contents of Exploration, Gathering, Fishing, and Crafting for survival, upgrade your Base Camp and craft equipment to defeat powerful enemy forces and virus-infected Wilders to rebuild the world.
■ Upgraded Customization
From weapon remodeling to character appearances, much more detailed customization is possible. Night Vision and many accessories have been added to increase the depth of customization compared to previous games.
■ Your Own Special Forces
With a more powerful customization and squad system, in addition to being able to flexibly change tactics to fit the situation, the importance of each squad member and tactical changes are more important than ever in Apocalypse.
■ Powerful Support Weapons
Artillery support from self-propelled artilleries, air support from attack helicopters, and combat drones can be part of the squad, in addition to the powerful tactical weapon "Battle Armor", which you can embark on and ride into battle.

bluejetty:00116210:ios.name: Mystery Escape Room Adventure
bluejetty:00116210:ios.summary:
Adventure Room Escape Puzzle:
Trapped in a dark, cold basement with no memory of how you got there. No phone, no help, no one around, just locked doors, eerie silence, and a chilling mystery waiting to be solved. Can you escape?
Adventur
bluejetty:00116210:ios.description:
Adventure Room Escape Puzzle:
Trapped in a dark, cold basement with no memory of how you got there. No phone, no help, no one around, just locked doors, eerie silence, and a chilling mystery waiting to be solved. Can you escape?
Adventure Room Escape Puzzle: is a gripping escape room game where your logic, memory, and nerves will be pushed to the limit. Step into a disturbing thriller experience full of mind puzzles, mysterious clues, and a terrifying atmosphere. 
Engaging Storyline: You left your old life behind and wake up trapped in a basement. Unravel the mystery one clue at a time, with each discovery bringing you closer to the truth.
Challenging Puzzles: Test your brain with unique escape room puzzles, from hidden-object hunts to clever logic challenges. Every puzzle solved is a step closer to freedom.
A Realistic Room Escape Challenge
After a long day of work, you leave the office and... something strange happens. You wake up in a creepy basement alone, confused, and trapped.
Your only goal: Escape the room.
Explore dark environments, solve realistic puzzles, and uncover clues that reveal the story behind your kidnapping. Every room is a challenge. Every object could be a key to survival. Every decision matters.
Realistic Graphics & Sound: Immerse yourself in a dark, cold basement with atmospheric visuals and chilling audio. The lifelike environment heightens the suspense as you explore.
Think Hard or Stay Trapped
No random tapping. Every puzzle has meaning. From hidden codes to mechanical locks, Adventure Room Escape Puzzle is packed with:
Smart, handcrafted brain teasers
Hidden objects and secret mechanisms
A deep, addictive story-driven adventure
Suspenseful atmosphere and high realism
A lot of different room escapes
Use your mind to solve each mystery and make your way through locked rooms, strange symbols, and disturbing discoveries. No two puzzles are the same. Get ready to think outside the box. 
Story-Rich Room Escape Experience
Adventure Room Escape Puzzle isn’t just a game,it’s a psychological thriller. As you progress, you’ll uncover dark secrets and connect the dots of a twisted plot. What really happened? Who is behind this? Why you? Why am I locked in? Why am I locked in? Will I be escape from this escape room?
Your journey through this mystery escape room game will keep you hooked from the first lock to the final exit. You'll feel tension, fear, and satisfaction as each clue, brain teaser and room escape puzzles brings you closer to the truth.
Designed for Mobile Escape Fans
Whether you’re a veteran of escape room games or a newcomer seeking a fresh challenge, this game delivers:
Intuitive controls built for mobile
Immersive 2D environments
No timers, explore at your pace
Satisfying gameplay with real logic puzzles of room escapes.
Offline support, play anywhere
Built for fans of puzzle adventure, mystery games, room escape, and brain teaser games, this is one experience you won’t forget.
If you enjoy mystery adventures, brain-teasing puzzle games, and thrilling escape room challenges, this horror Room Escape game is for you. Adventure Room Escape Mistery Puzzle: Dive into a heart-pounding adventure and see if you have what it takes to survive the horror. The clues are hidden, the puzzles are waiting, and your escape depends on you. Download now to begin your terrifying journey solve the mystery, escape the basement, and experience the adrenaline rush of a true escape room!
Adventure Room Escape Puzzle: If you've been in a real escape room, you'll love it. Could you espace from this?

bluejetty:00183844:ios.description:
Take control of your income and spending and keep your personal finances organised.
MTracker is a simple money management app designed to help you record transactions, manage budgets and understand where your money goes. Its clear and practical interface makes managing your everyday finances easier.
KEY FEATURES
• Quick income and expense tracking
Add each transaction with an amount, category, date and note.
• Personalised budgets
Set an overall budget or individual limits for each category and see how much you have left to spend.
• Charts and statistics
Understand your income and spending with clear charts and summaries across different periods.
• Recurring transactions
Schedule regular income and expenses such as rent, subscriptions, household bills and salary.
• Search and filters
Quickly find previous transactions by keyword, category, date or other criteria.
• Data import
Import transactions from compatible files and manage your financial records in one place.
• Export and backup
Export your data in compatible formats for safekeeping, analysis or transfer.
• iCloud synchronisation
Keep your data in sync across your Apple devices using your personal iCloud account.
• Privacy and data control
Your financial records are stored on your device and, when synchronisation is enabled, in your private iCloud storage. You remain in control of your information.
MTRACKER IS IDEAL FOR:
• tracking everyday spending;
• controlling your monthly budget;
• organising household finances;
• managing personal income and expenses;
• understanding your spending habits;
• saving towards your financial goals.
Start recording your transactions today and make better decisions about your money.

bluejetty:00062082:ios.description:
CliniCalc is a comprehensive tool for medical professionals, making it easy to perform complex calculations and remember scores, scales, classifications & more with high quality images. CliniCalc gives you the answers you need, when you need them. 
Do you remember the CHADS2 Score for atrial fibrillation patients, or recall the details of the Glasgow Coma Scale? Medical professionals often need to remember a wealth of complicated calculations. 
No matter what you need to know, whether it’s a classification, formula, scale or anything else, CliniCalc’s streamlined navigation makes finding what you need simple and lightning fast.
Store your favorite formulas, find the most recently used, search for specific calculations using keywords and short descriptions. You’re only ever seconds away from finding the answers you need. 
CLINICALC – BENEFITS
• Hundreds of relevant formulas, scores, classifications & scales
• Store your favourite formulas, view recently used & search using keywords quickly
• Detailed background information for each formula 
• High quality images to help you with accurate classifications
• Universal support for US and SI units, with easy switching
FORMULAS, SCORES & CLASSIFICATIONS 
• Here’s just a small sample of the valuable information you’ll have access to when using CliniCalc:
• Anesthesia – ASA, Bromage, Cormack, Goldman, ABCD, APACHE, Parkland, CAM-ICU, SAPS
• Cardiology – CC/AHA ASCVD, CHADS, EuroSCORE, GRACE, HAS-BLED, Killip, PROCAM, QT-c, TIMI
• Emergency Medicine – 4T Score, CATCH, Canadian CT Head Rule, DIC, Dose Calculator, Glasgow Come Scale
• Gastroenterology – Child-Pugh, Glasgow, Harvey Bradshaw, MELD, NAC Calc, PELD, Ranson’s
• Hematology – DIC Score, Iron Deficit, ANC, Reticulocyte Index
• Nephrology – Cockcroft, GFR calculators, MDRD, Water Deficit & RIFLE
• Neurology – AMTS, Catch Rules, Dermatome Map, Hunt-Hess, NIHSS, WFNS
• Pediatrics – Age, Target Height, APGAR; Pediatric GCS, Tube Size, Westley Croup Score
• Pulmonology – CURB-65, MRC, GOLD, Spirometry, SMART-COP, BODE
• Miscellaneus – NNT, Odds, Sample Size, Two-Way Table, Corrected Ca, Units conversions
GET THE COMPLETE DATABASE OF FORMULAS, SCORES & CLASSIFICATIONS TODAY! 
This app is intended for educational purposes only, and is not intended to diagnose, treat or cure any disease. No clinical decisions should be made based on this app. 
CliniCalc uses elements from the open source project “MedCalc for iPhone” governed by the Apache 2.0 and Creative Commons licenses.

bluejetty:00186303:ios.description:
"EduHubSpot is a PMI® Authorized Training Partner trusted by 180,000+ learners across India, the US, the UAE and Canada, with a 99.7% certification pass rate. We help working professionals turn certifications into real career moves — with live mentor-led sessions, flexible batch schedules and real-world projects, all inside one app.
COURSES AVAILABLE ON THE APP
Project Management Certifications
• PMP® Certification Training & Bootcamp with 1-on-1 Mentorship
• CAPM® Certification Training for early-career professionals
• PMI-ACP® Agile Certified Practitioner Training
• PMI-RMP® Risk Management Professional Training
• PgMP® Program Management Certification
• PfMP® Portfolio Management Certification
AI & Agentic AI Training
• GenAI Professional Training & GenAI for Leaders
• Agentic AI Certification Training
• AI for Project Management Training
• Applied AI for Business Transformation
DevOps & Process Excellence
• DevOps Professional Certification Training
• Six Sigma Green Belt & Black Belt Certification
• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt & Black Belt Training
Data & Tools Training
• AI-Powered Power BI Analytics Training
• Data Science Foundation Training
• Advanced MS Excel Training (AI-Integrated)
• Microsoft Project Training
Career Resources
• Interview Prep & Career Resources across every certification track
APP FEATURES
Plan Your Certification
• View complete course details across PM, AI, DevOps, Agile and Six Sigma: duration, curriculum, mentor profiles and learner ratings
• Compare live, instructor-led and self-paced formats to pick what fits your schedule
• Track live 2026 batch calendars for weekday, weekend and fast-track cohorts
Prepare & Practice
• Access free practice tests and full-length exam simulators for PMP, CAPM, PMI-ACP and Six Sigma
• Download free study plans, prep checklists and certification study tools for every course track
• Track chapter-wise progress toward your certification exam
• Register for live weekly webinars and earn PDUs toward recertification
Get Support
• Chat directly with certification counselors for enrollment and course guidance
• Access post-training mentorship, interview prep and doubt-clearing support after you finish a course
• Read verified reviews from EduHubSpot's global learner community before enrolling
• Explore corporate and team training options for organizations
WHY LEARNERS CHOOSE EDUHUBSPOT
A certification only pays off if it changes what happens next in your career. That's why every course — PMP, AI, Agentic AI, DevOps, Agile or Six Sigma — comes with live mentor support and interview prep, not just recorded videos and a certificate.
• Certified, industry-expert mentors across Project Management, AI, DevOps, Agile and Six Sigma
• Live instructor-led and self-paced formats that fit around a full-time job
• Trusted by Rolls-Royce, Merck and Mercedes for corporate training
• 4.9-rated on Google and Trustpilot, with a 99.7% pass rate across cohorts
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Is the app free to download?
Yes. Downloading and browsing the EduHubSpot app is completely free. Fees apply only when you enroll in a paid certification program.
Will I get a recognized certificate?
Yes — PMI-aligned courses (PMP, CAPM, PMI-ACP, PMI-RMP, PgMP, PfMP) lead to PMI-recognized certificates; AI, DevOps and Six Sigma courses lead to EduHubSpot completion certificates.
Are practice tests updated for the latest exam pattern?
Yes, PMP, CAPM, PMI-ACP and Six Sigma tests are refreshed regularly to match current exam patterns.
Whether you're a project manager advancing your PMP career, building AI and Agentic AI skills, a team lead adopting DevOps, a Scrum Master exploring Agile certifications, or driving process improvement with Six Sigma, EduHubSpot gives you a single place to browse courses, book live batches, practice for your exam, prep for interviews and stay connected with mentors — every step of your certification journey, in your pocket."

13 Card Indian Rummy (रम्मी) Rules
13 Card Indian rummy variant is played between 2 to 5 players. Each player is dealt 13 rummy cards. For 2, 3 or 4 players two 52-card decks (104 cards) & 4 jokers (wild cards) are used. For 5 players three decks (156 cards) & 6 jokers are used.
The aim in the rummy game is to form sequences (runs) & sets. After a player has formed the required sequence & sets using all 13 cards, the player declares his turn.
13 Card Rummy Rules
· Minimum 2 runs (sequences) are required
· One of the runs (sequences) must be pure (called 1st Life)
· The second run can be pure or non-pure (called 2nd Life)
· Either 1st Life or 2nd Life must have 4 or more cards
A valid 13 card declaration must have a minimum of 2 runs & out of these runs, 1 must be pure & 1 run (pure or impure) must have 4 or more cards.
21 Card Indian Rummy (रम्मी) Rules:
This Indian rummy variant is played between 2 to 5 players with 3 standard decks of 53 cards each, which includes 1 Printed Joker per deck.
The 21 Cards Indian Rummy game rules are a little different from 13 Cards Indian Rummy rules.
21 Card Rummy Table Rules
· 3 Pure Sequences & the remaining cards arranged in sets or sequences
· 3 Tunnels in separate groups. The rest of the cards need not be arranged in sequences.
· 8 Dublees in separate groups. 
· 8 Jokers in a single group. 
 How to save points, if a Rummy player declares:
· A Rummy player must make at least 3 Pure Sequences & arrange the rest in sequences. A player will lose points only for the cards that are not arranged.
· Make at least 6 Dublees. A player will lose points only for the rest of the cards.
· If a player has 6 Dublees & 3 Pure Sequences, the players will lose points based on the option

bluejetty:00046299:ios.description:
O Muambator é o melhor aplicativo para rastreamento de encomendas do Brasil. Está presente há mais de 10 anos no mercado, e sempre foi líder em inovações. Se você é uma pessoa ansiosa, e costuma fazer compras no Mercado Livre, Aliexpress, Deal Extreme (DX), GearBest, Banggood o Muambator é o aplicativo perfeito para rastreamento de correios.
O aplicativo é integrado a diversas operadoras logísticas, incluindo Correios, China Post, Hong Kong Post, USPS. Você compra, recebe o seu código de rastreamento de pacote e ZAZ: acompanhar a entrega é muito mais divertido do que recebê-la!
Você ainda tem dúvidas? Eu tenho mais um monte de razões para te ajudar no processo de encontrar seu pacote. Quer ver só?
- Notificações! Todas as vezes que um pacotinho tiver uma alteração no rastreamento, PLEIM! Você vai receber uma notificação (se optar, é óbvio). Mas o óbvio precisa ser dito e relembrado: Somos totalmente anti-spam. O Muambator está há uma década no ar, e nunca enviamos um SPAM ou compartilhamos seus dados. E pode perguntar aos seus amigos;
- Não quero a notificação do rastreamento das encomendas, mas quero um e-mail: sem problemas! É possível receber as notificações por e-mail também;
- Cadastrar novos códigos de rastreamento de pacotes é muito simples. E ainda contamos com leitores de código de barras, o que facilita ainda mais! Imagina a facilidade para quem tem uma loja e deseja acompanhar o envio de tudo?!
- Organização de tudo: é possível colocar nome, tags (etiquetas), categorias e mais informações que te ajudem a identificar o rastreamento do pacote. Se você é uma pessoa compradora ávida, vai perceber que essa organização é fundamental para o rastreamento de pacotes;
Principais Recursos de Rastreio:
- Notificações push no seu celular
- Notificações por Twitter
- Notificações por e-mail
- Cadastro de novos pacotes
- Edição/remoção de pacotes
- Especificação de tags e categorias
- Visualização no mapa
- Buscas e filtros de registros
- Configurações na nuvem

bluejetty:00036925:ios.description:
Unveil mysteries in "Myth or Reality: Mystery of the Lake" – now free-to-play! Dive into the thrilling world of search and find games, where mystical riddles meet adventure. Explore the eerie beauty of Loch Ness Lake in one of the most captivating point and click adventure games. Investigate the legend, unravel secrets, and embark on an unforgettable journey of find the difference challenges and object hunts. Can you uncover the truth behind the legendary monster and survive to tell the tale? It’s time to find out, because you just received a letter:
Welcome to the Loch-Ness Hotel! It is an honor to host the author of such popular articles about mysterious incidents. We're glad that you accepted the invitation to visit and investigate the Loch Ness Monster mystery. Be careful, though, as it has recently been attacking tourists! Please note that the hotel is not responsible for your life and health! But we hope that our rooms, full of sweet trinkets and Scotland history, and nosy neighbors will be to your liking! It should be sunny with a chance of… flood?! Anyway… have a lovely time! Yours, Mr. and Mrs. Crossbury. 
We also have prepared some special challenges just for you:
Difficult Choices!
You will have the opportunity to choose the character's phrases for a particular action and influence the plot of point and click adventure games. As an expert in myths and monsters, it's up to you to uncover the truth behind the claims of a monster living in the waters of the Loch Ness Hotel!
Engage in Puzzle Solving!
Sharpen your mind with a variety of puzzles and brain teasers that challenge your search and find games skills. Progress through the adventure by solving mystical riddles that intertwine with the locals' tales and secrets!
Search for Collectibles!
Embark on an exhilarating object hunt to find rare artifacts and collectibles. These items are not just rewards but pieces of the greater puzzle that bring you closer to solving the mystical riddles of Nessie. Fans of search and find games and point and click adventure games will relish every discovery!
A Variety of Achievements!
Explore multiple picturesque locations for hidden objects, solve puzzles to earn achievements and highlight your success as a real myth investigator. Uncover all crypted-themed materials and learn more about mystery tales!
Follow the footsteps of the Loch Ness monster in this free-to-play version of legendary tales, don’t miss out!
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00134253:ios.description:
SubWallet is the comprehensive non-custodial wallet solution for Polkadot, Substrate & Ethereum ecosystems. 
Built on top of Polkadot {.js}, SubWallet focuses on improving UX & UI. We envision a crypto wallet as a Web3 multiverse gateway through which users can enjoy multi-chain services with utmost ease and absolute security.
Connecting and using blockchain-based applications is smoother than ever with SubWallet Browser Extension & SubWallet Mobile App. Our web wallet is coming soon!
SubWallet Crypto Wallet Key Features
1. Manage multi-chain assets on 150+ networks with 380+ tokens supported.
2. Manage multiple seed phrases with only one master password
2. Send & receive assets cross-chain
3. Display & manage NFT 
4. Stake to earn in-app easily via nominating directly and joining nomination pools
5. Explore Web3 apps without friction
6. Sync desktop & mobile wallets within seconds
7. Boost security with hardware crypto wallets Ledger & Keystone as well as Parity QR-signer
And a lot more!
Utmost Security & User Privacy
1. Non-custodial
2. No user-tracking
3. Fully open-source
4. Security audit by Verichains
5. Cold wallet integration
Token Standard Support
ERC-20, ERC-721, PSP-34, PSP-22
Assets Supported On All Networks & Parachains 
- Polkadot (DOT)
- Kusama (KSM)
- Ethereum (ETH)
- Binance Smart Chain (BNB)
- Moonbeam (GLMR)
- Moonriver (MOVR)
- Pioneer Network (NEER)
- Aleph Zero (AZERO)
- Astar (ASTR)
- Shiden (SDN)
- Bifrost (BNC)
- Polygon (MATIC)
- Arbitrum (ARB)
- Optimism (OP)
- TomoChain (TOMO)
- Composable Finance (LAYR)
- Phala (PHA)
- HydraDX (HDX)
- Picasso (PICA)
- Litentry (LIT)
- Ajuna Network (BAJU)
- XX Network (xx)
…
and more.
Support
You can find “How to” materials and tutorials on our Help Center: https://docs.subwallet.app/
and our Youtube Channel https://www.youtube.com/@subwalletapp
Any further queries, please contact us via community channel below.
Community & Updates
1. Download the latest version from our official website: https://www.subwallet.app/
2. Visit our Github: https://github.com/Koniverse/Subwallet-Extension
3. Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/subwalletapp
4. Join us on Telegram: https://t.me/subwallet
5. Join us in Discord: https://discord.com/invite/EkFNgaBwpy
As SubWallet is a community-driven product, our team is always more than happy to receive feedback and support our users.
Stay in touch!

bluejetty:00128785:ios.description:
Revolut is the money app designed to spend, save, and set money aside.
What's in store:
• Get your own customizable debit card and virtual cards to add to your Apple or Google Wallet (personalization fees may apply)
• Send money between friends on Revolut (minimum age restriction applies)
• Receive money from everyone — even if they’re not on Revolut — with Payment Links
• Save and earn with a Savings account
• Get a 360º view of your money with Analytics
• If you’re in the UK, you can move to the main app once you turn 16
How does it work?
1. Download this app and create an account (if you're below the age of data consent, your parent will need to create an account for you from their Revolut app. You can check the age of data consent in your country below)
2. Get approved by your parent or guardian
3. Choose a debit card and customize it with text, stickers, and your own sketches (personalization fees may apply), then order it from your parent's app
4. Add your card to Apple or Google Wallet to start spending straight away (minimum age restriction applies)
Parents and guardians, this part's for you ↓
With Revolut, they can manage their money independently, under your supervision.
Teens above the age of data consent can sign up themselves, but you'll have access to security controls, like spending notifications, in-app card freezes, and many other features to give you peace of mind.
If you have teens below the age of data consent, you can create an account for them from your Revolut app. Here’s how: 
1. Have them download this app and create an account
2. Approve their account from your Revolut app
3. Order their prepaid debit card from your app (personalization fees may apply)
Find your country's age of data consent ↓
In Bulgaria, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Gibraltar, Iceland, Latvia, Malta, Norway, Portugal, Singapore, Sweden, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, or the United States:
• Teens aged 13+ can create an account with parent or guardian approval
• Teens aged 12 or under (minimum age restrictions apply) will need a parent or guardian to create their account from the main Revolut app
• Referrals and payments to and from customers on this app are only available to teens aged 13+
In Austria, Belgium, Cyprus, Italy, Lithuania, or Spain:
• Teens aged 14+ can create an account with parent or guardian approval
• Those aged 13 or under will need a parent or guardian to create their account from the main Revolut app
• Referrals and payments to and from customers on this app are only available to teens aged 14+
In Australia, Czech Republic, Greece, or Slovenia:
• Teens aged 15+ can create an account with parent or guardian approval
• Those aged 14 or under will need a parent or guardian to create their account from the main Revolut app
• Referrals and payments to and from customers on this app are only available to teens aged 15+ (referrals subject to feature availability in your country)
In Croatia, Germany, Hungary, Ireland, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Poland, Romania, or Slovakia:
• Teens aged 16 and above can create an account with parent or guardian approval
• Those ages 15 or under will need a parent or guardian to create their account from the main Revolut app
• Referrals and payments to and from customers on this app are only available to teens aged 16+

• Learn more about your skin with Skin School with our practicing dermatologist, Dr Greg.
• Learn about skincare, nutrition, wellness, and Ayurveda with our Ayurvedic specialist Dr. Tarini.

Get ready for the official Hotel Transylvania game, based on the TV series by Sony Pictures Animation and Nelvana Limited! 
Mavis let the adorable but troublemaking Wolf Pups go, and now they’re roaming free around Hotel Transylvania, wreaking havoc. Aunt Lydia is NOT happy and has grounded poor Mavis. The only way her punishment will be dropped is if she rights her wrongs - help her find the Wolf Pups to stop them from causing more damage, and get the hotel back into tiptop shape.
Features:
> Play as your favorite character: Dracula, Mavis, Hank, Pedro or Wendy.
> The Wolf Pups are a little too good at hiding. Find them before they completely destroy the hotel!
> Collect coins as you run, to pay for hotel renovations. Fix everything in the hotel so Aunt Lydia will stop grounding Mavis!
> Avoid enemies, traps and numerous scary things in this 4-zone, 80-level platformer!
> Each character has a special ability that can help you, like monster-killing burps or double jumps!
> Use powerups wisely to find your way out of the maze-like rooms!
> Renovate and decorate the hotel. As you progress, new floors and new rooms will unveil!
> Replay levels to complete all objectives. High scores will allow you to run wild with the renovation! 
> Find the hidden rooms! Each character has his own room that only he can pass!

bluejetty:00024638:ios.summary:

O
bluejetty:00024638:ios.description:
Outdoor Run++ tracks your outdoor workout using your iPhone's GPS. You can use it to track the distance, time, speed, pace, and calories burned during a walk, run, or bike ride. You can even use Outdoor Run++ to track your driving path. 
Outdoor Run++ gives you the capability to see the distance, pace, and speed measurements in both miles and kilometers units. You can easily switch between the two units even in the middle of a workout with a swipe on the distance label. 
Outdoor Run++ saves a map of the path you have traveled and shows you mile or kilometer markers. You can use the "Mark" button to mark certain locations on your path so that you can check the distance and time it took you to get to that mark. 
Outdoor Run++ has the capability to track multi-section workouts. You can use "Start", "Pause", and "Resume" sequence to track your multi-section workout. In the workout summary you will see each section of your workout under "Workout Splits".
HealthKit Access: You can choose to grant access to Outdoor Run++ to read "Date of Birth", "Sex", "Weight", and "Height" information from your Health app (HealthKit). These data points are solely used for calorie calculations. Therefore if you choose not to grant permission to Outdoor Run++ to access your health data all the functionality of Outdoor Run++ is intact except for calorie calculations. 
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Please do not hesitate to contact us for any questions, comments, to report any bugs, or to suggest additional features you would like to see in the upcoming updates.

bluejetty:00093736:ios.description:
Monticello Banking Company is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Monticello Banking Company:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the goMBC app, you must be enrolled as a Monticello Banking Company Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

• Index: Explore all released monsters, quickly see shiny forms and ot
bluejetty:00022104:ios.description:
PokeMate is a beautiful, smooth and customizable field guide.
Track your in-game progress and make your experience better with always up to date informations and tools.
• Index: Explore all released monsters, quickly see shiny forms and other variations.
• Eggs: See what could hatch from specific eggs, what is their CP range and if they can be shiny.
• Raids: See what monsters are currently available to fight in raids.
• Research Task: Quickly find what monsters are given as a reward for completing a specific task.
• Team GO Rocket: See what lineup is used by the different grunts and what shadow monster you can catch after defeating them.
• Battle League: Quickly find what rewards are given for each rank.
• Events: Browse through a list of current, upcoming and past events, see the various bonuses and set custom notifications for event starting dates.
• Active Bonuses: See at a glance all the currently active bonuses.
• Simulated Battles: Run a simulation for a Raid Boss to see a list of perfect counters and their best movesets.
• Regionals: See what regional monsters are available in your area
• Personalized Lists: use default and/or manual filters to create custom lists and track how many monsters of a certain kind you have.
• Spotlight Integration: Search for a specific monster, Research Task or Rocket grunt directly from Spotlight, without ever needing to leave the game.
===========
The app offers monthly and annual subscriptions for "PokeMate PRO".
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased.
To manage auto-renewal or cancel your subscription, please go to the iTunes Account Settings on your device.
For more information, refer to our Terms and Conditions at https://simonegiuditta.com/pokemate/terms and Privacy Policy at https://simonegiuditta.com/pokemate/privacy

- AI Food Tracker: Scan food like mom's biryani, your go-to cheat meal or that one shawarma at 2am. Scan it all, no excuses

- Nutritionist Check-ins: Doctors, weight loss specialists and real experts check in daily. More than an algorithm

- Rewards & Discounts: Hit your goals with Fit by oladoc and earn real vouchers. Health that pays off
OLADOC: DOCTORS, LABS & MORE
Book a Doctor Appointment Online

- Online Doctor Consultation: Talk to an online doctor by video, 24/7, right from your couch
