bluejetty:00022590:ios.description:
■ KakaoTalk – Korea’s no. 1 messenger
KakaoTalk is more than just a free messenger. It brings you instant connection, fun short-form content, and smart AI features—anytime, anywhere. Enjoy meaningful one-on-one and group conversations with friends, family, and colleagues, and discover new communities you're interested in via Open Chat. You can also share photos, videos, and files in just a tap!
■ Chat made easier, experience made better
Keep your chats organized with folders, and easily edit or delete messages you’ve sent. Keep discussions on track with the new Threads feature, so every topic stays clear and easy to follow.
■ Voice Talk & Face Talk with screen sharing
Hop on a group Voice Talk or Face Talk with up to 10 people. During a call, you can switch to Face Talk or share your screen. Make your Face Talk more fun with various screen effects.
■ See trends at a glance in Open Chat communities
Discover real-time trends in Open Chat communities without entering a chat room. Choose a topic of interest and dive straight into the conversation.
■ Your profile with extra dimensionality
Your profile is your own space to showcase your interests and tastes. Feel free to set your profile visibility by chat room.
KakaoTalk may request access permissions to deliver its full range of features. You can still use the app without granting optional permissions, though some functions may be limited. 
[Optional permissions]
 - Location Services: For searching and sharing location information
 - Contacts: For adding friends, and sending contacts and profiles
 - Photos: For sending and saving photos, videos, and files
 - Bluetooth: For connecting to wireless audio devices
 - Microphone: For Voice Talk, Face Talk, voice messages, and recording
 - Speech Recognition: For speech-to-text transcriptions
 - Camera: For Face Talk, capturing photos/videos, and scanning QR codes and card numbers
 - Notifications: For receiving various alerts and message notifications
 - Face ID: Biometric authentication for in-app security verification
 - Siri: Access to read or write chat messages through Siri
* “KakaoTalk,” “Info Talk,” “Open Chat,” “Face Talk,” etc., are registered trademarks (®) and trademarks (™) of Kakao Corp. ® and ™ symbols are omitted in the app.
[KakaoTalk on social]
 - Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/kakao.today 
 - YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@Kakaobrandmedia
[Kakao Customer Service] 
https://cs.kakao.com/helps?service=8

bluejetty:00167800:ios.description:
Fancy AI is an AI-powered tool for creating stunning logos and high-quality photos without needing design skills. Suitable for both novices and professionals, Fancy AI quickly turns ideas into brand-aligned logos and photos.
Customizable Logo Creation
Users can create and adjust logos in various styles, ensuring uniqueness and brand consistency. Fancy AI’s logos are perfect for avatars, product icons, and corporate brands, and can be easily shared across platforms.
CREATE YOUR UNIQUE AI ART
+ Trained with millions of images in the database, your dreams can be transformed into digital art in seconds.
+ Describe what you have on your mind with words to generate an image. Remember, more details can lead to a better visual effect. 
+ No ideas? Fancy AI provides you with dozens of prompts to have a try, which can bring you more sparks of inspiration.
+ Create your masterpiece from various art styles. Oil painting, hyper-realistic, 3D render, fantasy, cyberpunk, mystical...Explore them as you like.
+ Generate your artwork to save and share with your family, friends and social media to become the center of attention!
GET YOUR CARTOON IMAGE
+ Let Fancy AI take you into a two-dimensional world.
+ Cannot wait to see your cartoon avatars? Using our cartoon templates with your friend to get a beautiful anime photo.
+ Use cutting-edge AI to create outstanding avatars. Make an impression on social media with completely original visuals.
PICK FROM VARIOUS ART STYLES
Dive into a world of artistic possibilities by selecting from a diverse range of familiar art styles, each tailored to specific scenarios. 
+ Transport yourself through time with our Time Machine, capture the innocence and sweetness of life with the Baby Theme, reminisce about the past with the nostalgic charm of 90s Yearbook aesthetics, celebrate life with the festive allure of Christmas, and explore the adorable world of animals.
+ Additionally, showcase your professional side with Resume Photos, immortalize love with Wedding Photos, experiment with various trendy looks through changing Hairstyles, document your global adventures with Travel Check-ins, and express yourself with Casual Outfits. 
Our extensive array of art styles ensures that you can create unique avatars tailored to your preferences across an array of imaginative scenarios and artistic influences.

bluejetty:00028802:ios.description:
Keep track of your blood pressure and heart rate in one simple app. Log every reading in seconds, see how your numbers change over time, and share your data with Apple Health.
BLOOD PRESSURE LOG
- Record systolic, diastolic and pulse in a few taps
- Add notes to each reading: mood, meds taken, arm, body position, irregular heartbeat flagged by your monitor
- Browse your full history of readings
TRENDS & CHARTS
- See your blood pressure and pulse trends on clear charts
- Spot changes in your readings week by week
HEART RATE WITH YOUR CAMERA
- Check your pulse anytime: just place your finger on the iPhone camera
WORKS WITH APPLE HEALTH
- Sync your blood pressure and heart rate readings with the Apple Health app
IMPORTANT
This app does not measure blood pressure. Use a blood pressure monitor and log your readings in the app. The app is for informational purposes only and is not a medical device. Always consult a doctor for medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION

bluejetty:00119109:ios.description:
Ready your sword, pack your provisions and prepare to embark upon quests of epic proportions where YOU choose what happens next! Journey a magical realm, fighting monsters and unravelling mysteries in Fighting Fantasy Classics – text-based roleplaying adventures remastered. 
FREE GAMEBOOK FOR EVERY PLAYER
Receive Jonathan Green's swashbuckling pirate adventure - Bloodbones - for free when you download the game.
MULTIPLE DIFFICULTY SETTINGS
Make the gamebooks as easy or hard as you like with a range of difficulty settings to suit the needs to every player.
AUTOMATED ADVENTURE SHEET
Which keeps track of your equipment, stats, inventory, and knowledge gained during your journey.
MAP YOUR JOURNEY
Auto mapping feature makes it easy to keep track of everywhere you have explored during both current and previous playthroughs.
COLLECTABLE ARTWORK GALLERY
Featuring classic, original artwork from Iain McCaig, Russ Nicholson, Malcolm Barter, Ian Miller, Brian Williams and more! 
ATMOSPHERIC MUSIC
Specially composed ambient tracks immerse you in your adventure, transporting you to the game world. 
UNLIMITED BOOKMARKS
Allow you to revisit difficult sections of the story as many times as desired.
DICE ACCELEROMETER SUPPORT 
Roll your way to victory with accelerometer support - shaking the device will allow you to reroll your dice!
All this and more as you play through classic adventures including: Bloodbones, Caverns of the Snow Witch, Citadel of Chaos, City of Thieves, Deathtrap Dungeon, Forest of Doom, House of Hell, Island of the Lizard King, Trial of Champions and Warlock of Firetop Mountain, with more titles to come in future updates.
Originally presented by Steve Jackson & Ian Livingstone in the 80s and 90s, Fighting Fantasy Classics brings these timeless tales to your phone or tablet using our critically acclaimed Gamebook Adventures Engine.
Traverse the realm of Allansia, using your might and magic to hunt down evil demisorcers. Brave the dangers of Darkwood Forest to help save a doomed village of dwarves. Seek vengeance from the Pirate Lord who stole your family and destroyed your life many moons ago. Save a port-town from the wrath of an undead lord and his ghostly hound minions!
Part story, part game, in these adventures YOU ARE THE HERO!

Massachusetts RMV Permit Test Prep:
Prepare for your Massachusetts DMV Driver's Permit Test with confidence! Master the Massachusetts DMV Practice Test and prepare for the Massachusetts driver's license test, learner's permit test, and written knowledge exam. Whether you're applying for your learner's permit, Motorcycle License, or a Commercial Driver's License (CDL), our Massachusetts DMV Practice Test Prep app provides everything you need to study, practice, and pass your written exam. 
Study using realistic practice questions based on the official Massachusetts Driver's Licensing Manual, take full-length mock tests, review detailed explanations and track your progress with learning tools designed for the Massachusetts driver's license knowledge test.  
Prepare for Every License Category
- Car Driver's License
- Motorcycle License
- Commercial Driver's License (CDL)
- CDL Endorsements: Air Brakes & Hazardous Materials (HazMat) 
Comprehensive Knowledge Covers:
Master Traffic laws, Road signs, signals, safe driving practices, vehicle inspection, basic vehicle control, and driving conditions.
Key Features:
- Unlimited MA RMV Practice Tests: Practice as many times as you like to build confidence before your written test.
- Quiz Mode: Test your knowledge with interactive quizzes and retry questions until you answer correctly.
- Study Mode: Study all questions with the correct answers highlighted for quick review and easy learning.
- Exam Simulation Mock Test: Simulate the real Massachusetts driver license exam and measure your readiness.
- 1000+ Practice Questions: Prepare with a large collection of questions covering all major DMV Manual topics.
- Flashcards
- Detailed Explanations: Understand why each answer is correct and learn from every question.
- Bookmark Questions: Save difficult questions and review them later.
- Weak Question Review: Automatically identify the questions you miss often and focus your study.
- Progress Tracker: Monitor completed tests and overall improvement.
Flexible Test Experience
- Resume or restart interrupted tests anytime
- Get on-the-spot scoring with detailed answer breakdowns.
- Study comfortably day or night with Auto, Light or Dark appearance 
Why Choose Massachusetts DMV Permit Test Prep?
- Practice with realistic, state-specific DMV-style questions
- Study at your own pace
- Improve learning with Quiz & Study Modes
- Track your progress and identify weak areas
- Build confidence before your Massachusetts permit test 
Whether you're getting your first driver's permit, applying for a motorcycle license, or preparing for a CDL exam, Massachusetts DMV Permit Test Prep helps you study smarter and get ready for your test.

The content is organized and presented as a study aid to help users prepare for the Massachusetts driver's license written test for Car, Motorcycle, and Commercial Vehicle license categories.

bluejetty:00174761:ios.description:
Command your army, hex by hex. XeeWar is a turn-based strategy war game: build units, capture bases and outsmart your opponent — through an 18-mission solo campaign, or against real commanders online.
EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER
Every turn is simple: build, move, capture, attack. Winning is not. A dozen unit types with real strengths and weaknesses, terrain that shapes every fight — mountains and forests give defenders the edge — and no dice-roll luck. Position wins wars, not chance.
CONQUER THE CAMPAIGN
• 18 handcrafted missions across three theaters: Ground War, Naval War and Air War
• Earn up to 3 stars per mission — win fast and keep your units alive
• The enemy grows smarter and stronger with every level, from pushover to General
• A hands-on tutorial makes you battle-ready in your very first game
BATTLE REAL COMMANDERS
• Online turn-based multiplayer over Game Center
• Quick Match drops you on a random battlefield and finds an opponent fast — or host any of the 18 maps yourself
• Watch your opponent's turn play out like a replay, then plan your answer
• Play at your own pace: take your turn anywhere, anytime — no need to finish in one sitting
CLIMB THE RANKS
XeeWar uses chess-style Elo ratings: every online match moves your rating up or down based on the strength of your opponent. Rise through seven ranks, from Recruit all the way to General, and claim your place on the global leaderboard.
Good luck on the battlefield, Commander.

bluejetty:00115473:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00115473:ios.description:
Classic Mahjong Solitaire
Discover the timeless joy of Mahjong Solitaire, the classic tile-matching puzzle. Whether you're a classic core player seeking challenge, a senior or family gamer looking for friendly fun, or a fan of zen, mindful relaxation, this game is ideal for playing offline at any time.
How to Play
Tap or drag exposed matching tiles to clear them from the board.
Match pairs strategically - you can only remove tiles that have at least one side exposed.
Clear all tiles to win! It's a simple yet enjoyable mahjong match experience.
Play at your own pace, or challenge yourself with daily levels in our daily mahjong match mode.
Game Features
1. Eye-Friendly & Customizable
Large, clear tiles designed for easy viewing – perfect for all ages, especially mahjong for seniors.
Multiple themes: From traditional Eastern patterns to minimalist modern designs.
Soothing backgrounds for a calm and pleasant mahjong offline session.
2. Thousands of Levels
Thousands of handcrafted puzzles – from beginner-friendly boards to expert-level challenges.
3. Helpful Power-ups
Smart Hints: Guide your next move.
Shuffle: Mix tiles when you're stuck.
Unlimited Undo: Learn without penalties.
All power-ups are available in offline mode.
4. Play Anytime, Anywhere
100% mahjong offline support – no internet needed.
Perfect for travel, waiting rooms, or relaxing at home.
Why You'll Love It
Classic Core Players: Relive the authentic tile-matching challenge with endless variety.
Seniors & Families: Enjoy easy-to-read tiles, adjustable difficulty, and friendly gameplay.
Zen & Relaxation Seekers: Immerse yourself in calming visuals, soft sounds, and mindful gameplay.
Perfect for Brain Training
Mahjong Solitaire is more than a tile match game. Whether you're aiming to keep your mind active, enjoy a peaceful break, or compete globally, our mahjong games offer the ideal balance.
Highlights at a Glance
Classic Mahjong Solitaire gameplay.
Daily mahjong match challenges.
Large, high-contrast tiles for comfortable play.
Custom themes and relaxing backgrounds.
Thousands of levels for endless fun.
Smart hints, shuffles, and unlimited undo moves.
Offline play – anytime, anywhere.
Your Ideal Mahjong Journey Starts Here
If you love mahjong match games, this is amazing experience – combining tradition, accessibility, and relaxing fun. Perfect for short sessions or long, focused play.

Privacy Policy: https://www.flyfoxgames.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00014563:ios.description:
PDF Expert is a fast and easy PDF app to read, annotate, fill and sign PDF forms, convert files to PDF, and merge, split or compress documents – all in one intuitive app for iPhone, iPad, Mac & Vision Pro.
Read PDF files with comfort, highlight and mark up text, fill out forms, sign contracts, create and convert PDFs, and summarize long documents in seconds with AI-powered tools. Unlock unlimited possibilities with PDF Expert Premium and work across all your Apple devices.
"PDF Expert is one of my must-have iPad apps and a desktop-class PDF reader." – MacStories
"The best app for managing, editing, and reading PDFs on your iPad." – The Sweet Setup
▶ WITH PDF EXPERT, YOU CAN:
READ PDFs
- PDF reader with Day, Night, and Sepia modes for comfortable reading anytime
- Scroll PDFs vertically or horizontally and search text in any document
- Open and view PDF files from email, web, Files, or any app via the Share menu
- Read PDFs out loud with Text to Speech
ANNOTATE AND MARK UP PDFs
- Highlight, underline, and strike through text in your PDFs
- Mark up documents with pen, shapes, text, notes, and comments
- Add stamps such as Approved or Confidential
- Record your voice and add audio notes to PDFs
FILL AND SIGN PDF FORMS
- Fill out PDF forms with text fields, checkboxes, and radio buttons
- Sign PDF documents in seconds – draw your signature or add it from an image
- Save your signature to sign contracts, agreements, invoices, and applications faster
- Fill, sign, and send forms right from your iPhone – no printing or scanning needed
- Supports all major form formats, including AcroForms and static XFA forms
***PREMIUM FEATURES***
EDIT PDFs
- Edit text directly in a PDF – just as you would in a Word document
- Add, replace, and resize images in your PDFs
- Add links to other pages or websites
- Add outlines to navigate large PDFs
CREATE AND CONVERT PDFs
- Create PDFs from Word files, images, and other documents
- Convert Word to PDF, JPG to PDF, and PNG to PDF in seconds
- Convert PDF to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, and TXT
MERGE, SPLIT AND ORGANIZE PDFs
- Merge and combine multiple PDF files into one
- Split PDFs and extract pages into a new file
- Add, delete, rotate, and reorder pages with thumbnail preview
COMPRESS PDFs
- Compress PDFs to reduce file size for email and sharing
- Shrink large PDF files to save space on your device
SUMMARIZE PDFs WITH AI – PDF COPILOT
- List Main Points – get key takeaways from any PDF
- Summarize – get concise summaries of entire PDFs or annotations
- Ask Anything – find details with AI answers and references
- Explain – get instant explanations of words or phrases
PROTECT YOUR FILES
- Password-protect PDF Expert
- Redact – permanently black out sensitive information
WORK WITH SCANNED DOCUMENTS
- Open scanned PDFs to fill out, sign, annotate, and share
CONSTRUCTION TOOLS
- Scale and measure drawings with the Measure tab
- Polygon, polyline, and redline tools
MORE FEATURES
- Customizable toolbar
- Presentation Mode
- Print and share PDFs via email or cloud
ONE ACCOUNT FOR ALL YOUR APPLE DEVICES
One Premium subscription covers PDF Expert on iPhone, iPad, and Mac – no need to buy versions separately.

https://pdfexpert.com/terms

• Open your account online easily thru the app and issue your digital mada card instantly
• Instant 24/7 transfers between local banks with the Instant Transfer Service
• International Transfers using Enjaz Easy, Western Union services and TRANSFAST
• Register for e-channels directly from the app 
• Easy login using authorized fingerprint or Face ID
• Quick access to view your account and transactions 
• Personal accounts services
• SADAD and MOI services
• Cards services
• View your financing details

bluejetty:00123722:ios.description:
Let’s join the LARGEST BID WHIST COMMUNITY in the world to play with thousands of online players!
Bid Whist Plus offers you a great experience against many Bid Whist players from all around the world! You can play in many different game modes such as Classic, Solo, or Whist. 
Bid Whist is one of the traditional trick-taking card games played in pairs like Spades, but in this game players determine the Trump suit by bidding higher than others. 
==BID WHIST PLUS FEATURES==
● FREE COINS
Get 20,000 Free Coins as a “Welcome Bonus”, and get even more coins by collecting your “Daily Bonus” every day!
● DIFFERENT MODES
Play Bid Whist however you want!
CLASSIC: Make your bid with your partner and challenge other teams 
VIP: Play the classic Bid Whist in custom Tables.
SOLO: There is no partnership. Each player gets his/her own points.
WHIST: No one bids in Whist tables! Trump suit changes automatically in each round. 
● GREAT SOCIAL EXPERIENCE
Meet new people and add them as friends to be their best partner or challenge them in games!
Use Public or Private Chat to stay in touch with other players.
● CREATE YOUR OWN TABLES
You can create tables in different modes. Choose your “Game Rule” type, set the “Bet Amount” and the “Final Point” or decide if there will be “Faster Play” or “Chat” options. If you don’t want to be found, create your own “Private Table” where games are “Invite Only”.
Additional information:
* Make sure you have a good internet connection to get the best experience. 
* The game is free to play; however, in-app purchases are available for additional content and in-game currency. In-app purchases range from $0.99 to $99.99 USD.
* Use of this application is governed by Zynga’s Terms of Service, found at https://www.take2games.com/legal.

bluejetty:00040723:ios.summary:

Ready to try your hand (and eye) at this fantastic matching game? Match Junk has got everything you’re looking for in a triple match game and more with tons of fun items, unique gameplay and even the ability to p
bluejetty:00040723:ios.description:
I spy, with my little eye…
Ready to try your hand (and eye) at this fantastic matching game? Match Junk has got everything you’re looking for in a triple match game and more with tons of fun items, unique gameplay and even the ability to play offline. Come see if you can spot and match all the items before the timer runs out!
Begin the game with a variety of objects scattered all across the screen; identify three identical ones and tap on them to connect. Continue hunting for and matching items in groups of three tiles until you’ve cleared the panel in as little time as possible, since you’ll need to work fast to beat the timer. Don’t worry though, this game is anything but stressful – Match Junk has tons of cool features to really enhance your gaming experience, such as:
• Fun and useful boosters – Make use of the shuffle feature to switch up the item placement, as well as tons of cool boosters that let you quickly organize and triple match objects to fly through the levels. Difficult levels and sneakily hidden items won’t stand a chance against you with these under your belt.
•Unique gameplay – Test your strategy and logic skills as you try and match all the tiles before the time runs out. By making this game triple match as opposed to the usual single, we’ve upped the fun and possibility to learn something from the game. As you hone your spotting skills, you’ll also be training your brain and eyes – now that’s a win-win!
•Charming level design – No one likes playing games where the graphics are glitchy or the levels are poorly designed. Enjoy great 3D objects and fun puzzles that appeal to the young and young-at-heart alike as you take a break from reality and spend a few relaxing minutes (or hours, shh we won’t tell!) matching items.
•Offline play – Maybe you’re traveling and need a distraction, have limited data that you don’t want to use up, or are just having trouble getting your phone to connect to the spotty Wi-Fi. Match Junk doesn’t require an internet connection, so you’ll be able to keep matching to your heart’s content no matter the situation!
A match made in heaven
Whether you’re looking to just have some fun or to give your brain a little push, Match Junk is the triple match puzzle for you. Zoom through levels as you identify matching tiles on the screen and meet your objectives, all while enjoying the great design and ability to disconnect from the internet while you play. Download today to get the fun ball rolling!

bluejetty:00175341:ios.description:
WeChat is more than a messaging and social media app – it is a lifestyle for one billion users across the world. Chat and make calls with friends, read news and use local services in Official Accounts and Mini Programs, play games with friends, enjoy mobile payment features with Weixin Pay, and much more.
Why do one billion people use WeChat?
• MORE WAYS TO CHAT: Message friends using text, photo, voice, video, location sharing, and more. Create group chats with up to 500 members.
• VOICE & VIDEO CALLS: High-quality voice and video calls to anywhere in the world. Make group video calls with up to 15 people.
• REAL-TIME LOCATION: Not good at explaining directions? Share your real-time location with the tap of a button.
• MOMENTS: Never forget your favorite moments. Post photos, videos, and more to share with friends on your personal Moments stream.
• STICKER GALLERY: Browse thousands of fun, animated stickers to help express yourself in chats, including stickers with your favorite cartoon and movie characters.
• CUSTOM STICKERS: Make chatting more unique with custom stickers and selfie stickers.
• OFFICIAL ACCOUNTS: Tons of accounts to follow with original content and news for your reading pleasure.
• MINI PROGRAMS: Countless third-party services all within the WeChat app that don't require additional installation, saving you precious phone storage and time. 
• TOP STORIES: See the latest articles your friends are reading and discover all kinds of interesting content.
• GAMES: Have fun and compete with friends in a huge selection of WeChat Mini Games and Tencent Games (available in select regions).
• WEIXIN PAY: Enjoy the convenience of world-leading mobile payment features with Weixin Pay and Wallet (available in select regions).
• WECHAT OUT: Make calls to mobile phones and landlines around the globe at super low rates (only available in select regions).
• WERUN: Use Healthkit and Health app data to sync your step count on WeRun, where you can compete against friends with daily step rankings. Enable WeRun in “Settings” > “General” > “Plug-ins”.
• LANGUAGE SUPPORT: Localized in 20+ different languages and can translate friends' messages and Moments posts.
• BETTER PRIVACY: Giving you the highest level of control over your privacy, WeChat is certified by TRUSTe - view our privacy policy for more information.
• EASY MODE: Clearer and larger text and buttons for better readability.

bluejetty:00073537:ios.description:
Master Cleaner is a comprehensive application designed to efficiently cleaning up your storage. With its intuitive interface and powerful features, Master Cleaner helps you reclaim valuable space and organize your photos.
Key Features:
* Smart Cleaner: Master Cleaner intelligently scans your device for duplicate photos and videos, allowing you to effortlessly remove them with a single tap. This feature helps you eliminate unnecessary clutter and free up valuable storage space.
* Contacts Cleanup: Manage your contacts effortlessly with Master Cleaner. Easily identify and remove duplicate or outdated contacts, ensuring your address book remains organized and up to date.
* Calendar Optimization: Master Cleaner helps you optimize your calendar by identifying and eliminating past events, ensuring your schedule is streamlined and clutter-free.
* File Compression: With Master Cleaner, you can compress large files to save storage space without compromising their quality. This feature is particularly useful for videos and photos, allowing you to reclaim significant storage capacity.
* Manual Sorting with Swipe Gestures: Take control of your files with the intuitive swipe gestures in Master Cleaner Swipe left to delete unwanted files and swipe right to keep important ones, enabling you to effortlessly organize your data.
* Step-by-Step Instructions: Master Cleaner provides easy-to-follow instructions in the form of stories, guiding you through manual cache cleaning for popular apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, TikTok, Safari, and more. Learn how to delete unnecessary apps and free up space by offloading rarely used applications.
Master Cleaner is your all-in-one solution for device optimization. By removing duplicate photos, optimizing contacts and calendars, compressing files, and providing manual sorting options, it ensures that your device stays clean, organized, and runs at its best. Reclaim valuable storage space and optimize your device's performance with Master Cleaner today.
NOTE: The app cannot clean the memory of your iPhone or iPad.

bluejetty:00095533:ios.description:
TV Remote – Smart Control for All TVs.
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a powerful universal TV remote!
Control Samsung, LG, Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, Hisense, Sony, TCL & more — all from one smart app.
No more juggling remotes. Cast, control, and mirror – effortlessly.
Key Features
• Universal Remote for Smart TVs
Control power, volume, channels, input, and settings on Samsung, LG, Roku, Fire TV, and Android TVs.
• Quick App Access
Launch Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, Hulu, TED, and CNN instantly with one tap.
• Smart Touchpad Navigation
Swipe and tap like a laptop trackpad — intuitive and fast.
• Cast Photos & Videos
Stream photos and videos from your iPhone/iPad camera roll to your TV. No cables. No setup.
• Voice Control
Use voice commands to search, play, pause, adjust volume, and more — hands-free.
• Stable WiFi Remote
Control TVs via WiFi — no line-of-sight needed. Instant response & ultra-reliable connection.
• All-in-One Convenience
Consolidate all your remotes into one smart app available on both iPhone and iPad.
• Screen Mirroring (Coming Soon)
Mirror your iPhone/iPad screen to any compatible smart TV — great for presentations, videos, or mobile games.
* Works Great With:
Smart TVs, streaming devices, and more. Perfect for home entertainment, travel, and presentations.
* How to connect to TV Control – Universal Remote :
 1. Make sure your Smart TV and your iPhone/iPad are connected to the same Wi-Fi network.

 4. Choose your TV from the list of available devices.

Why Choose TV Remote – Smart Control?
• Works with almost smart TVs & streaming devices
• Seamless connection setup in seconds
• All-in-one remote for your home, travel, or office
• Clean, simple interface that anyone can use

We’ve opened up a world of opportunities to keep supporting the dynamic growth of your business. We want you to enjoy a more personalized and engaging experience with the #PluxeeEffect. Update your app today!
About this app:
-The Pluxee Merchants App is free and designed to make your daily operations easier.
-If you’re part of the Pluxee accredited merchant network, the app lets you track your sales made with Pluxee and Sodexo cards and manage your business from anywhere!
Want more? Here’s everything you can do:
- First access: Link your user profile to your business and start taking advantage of all our features.
- Advance reimbursements: Securely and easily advance the amounts paid by consumers using Pluxee and Sodexo cards.
- Transaction statement: Track your sales and simplify your business management.
- Payment history: Quickly and easily see the amounts you have to receive.
- POS terminal activation: Activate your payment terminals for Pluxee cards directly from the app, making your transactions smoother.
- Faster and more convenient with the Pluxee Merchants App.
- Boost your sales by offering payment with Pluxee and Sodexo benefit cards at your establishment—and give your customers a better experience!
Ready to open a world of opportunities with Pluxee? Download the Pluxee Merchants App today.
If you’re a Pluxee cardholder, download our beneficiary app here: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.primety.sodexomobile&hl=pt_BR&gl=US
*Some features may be available only in certain countries.

bluejetty:00039590:ios.name: Webaslan - GS 1905 Haber
bluejetty:00039590:ios.summary:
Galatasaray haberleri, GS transfer gelişmeleri, canlı skor ve maç sonuçları tek uygulamada: Webaslan! Sarı kırmızı gündemi anlık bildirimlerle ilk sen öğren.
Webaslan, Galatasaray taraftarı için hazırlanmış ücretsiz bir GS haber uygulamas
bluejetty:00039590:ios.description:
Galatasaray haberleri, GS transfer gelişmeleri, canlı skor ve maç sonuçları tek uygulamada: Webaslan! Sarı kırmızı gündemi anlık bildirimlerle ilk sen öğren.
Webaslan, Galatasaray taraftarı için hazırlanmış ücretsiz bir GS haber uygulamasıdır. Son dakika Galatasaray haberleri, transfer gelişmeleri, canlı maç anlatımı, Süper Lig puan durumu, fikstür, muhtemel 11'ler ve TV'de bugün yayın akışı cebinde. Futbolun yanı sıra Galatasaray basketbol ve voleybol haberleri de burada.
SON DAKİKA GALATASARAY HABERLERİ
• Transfer planları, görüşmeler, imzalar ve resmi açıklamalar
• Maç sonu gelişmeleri, teknik direktör ve oyuncu açıklamaları
• Sakatlık ve ceza durumu, kadrodaki son değişiklikler
• Antrenmandan son görüntüler, özel röportajlar ve incelemeler
• Önemli gelişmeler anında bildirim olarak telefonunda
HABERLER ARASINDA KAYDIRARAK HIZLI OKUMA
Haberi aç, sağa sola kaydır; GS gündemindeki son gelişmeleri saniyeler içinde oku. Uzun listelerde kaybolmadan tüm Galatasaray haberlerini akıcı bir deneyimle takip et.
CANLI MAÇ ODASI VE CANLI SKOR
• Galatasaray maçlarında dakika dakika canlı anlatım
• İlk 11'ler, yedekler, oyuncu değişiklikleri ve maç istatistikleri
• Gol, kırmızı kart, maç başlangıcı ve maç sonu bildirimleri
• Süper Lig, Şampiyonlar Ligi, Avrupa ve Türkiye Kupası maçları
• Diğer maçların canlı skorları ve maç sonuçları da tek ekranda
MUHTEMEL 11 VE KADRO
Maç öncesi Galatasaray'ın muhtemel 11'ini, kadroda olmayan oyuncuları ve rakibin durumunu öğren. Maç günü ihtiyacın olan her bilgi hazır.
PUAN DURUMU VE FİKSTÜR
• Güncel Süper Lig puan durumu, averaj ve gol krallığı
• Galatasaray fikstürü: önceki ve sonraki maçlar, maç saatleri
• Şampiyonlar Ligi ve Avrupa kupalarında grup ve lig tabloları
• GS maçı ne zaman, saat kaçta? Ana sayfadan tek dokunuşla öğren
TV'DE BUGÜN
Günün tüm spor yayınlarını ve maç programını gör: hangi maç hangi kanalda, saat kaçta? Hatırlatıcı ekle, Galatasaray maçlarını ve programlarını takvimine kaydet, hiçbir yayını kaçırma.
MAÇ ÖZETLERİ VE GALERİLER
Maç sonrası önemli anlar, gol videoları ve maçlardan, antrenmanlardan özel fotoğraf galerileri.
SPORX KADRO KUR
Kendi Galatasaray ilk 11'ini kur, dizilişini seç ve arkadaşlarınla paylaş. Teknik direktör sen olsan kimi oynatırdın?
QUIZ
Galatasaray tarihi, efsane oyuncular ve güncel futbol hakkındaki bilgini test et, arkadaşlarınla yarış.
BASKETBOL, VOLEYBOL VE DİĞER SPORLAR
Galatasaray basketbol ve voleybol takımlarından haberler, Basketbol Süper Ligi puan durumu ve fikstürü, diğer branşlardan güncel spor haberleri.
KOLAY VE SADE MENÜ
Sol menüden tek dokunuşla: Takımım (GS), Son Haberler, Canlı Skor, Canlı Maç Odası, TV'de Bugün, Quiz, Futbol, Basketbol ve Diğer Sporlar. Galatasaray içerikleri her zaman akışın en üstünde.
NEDEN WEBASLAN?
• Son dakika Galatasaray haberleri anlık bildirimle
• Canlı maç anlatımı, canlı skor ve gol bildirimleri
• Muhtemel 11, kadro ve maç sonu gelişmeleri
• Süper Lig puan durumu, fikstür ve maç sonuçları
• TV'de bugün yayın akışı ve takvime hatırlatıcı
• Transfer haberleri ve kadro güncellemeleri
• Ücretsiz, hızlı ve sade kullanım
SIK SORULANLAR
GS maçı ne zaman, hangi kanalda? Fikstür ve TV'de Bugün ekranlarından maç saatini ve yayıncı kanalı görebilirsin.
Gol bildirimlerini nasıl açarım? Takımım ekranından Galatasaray'ı seç, bildirim ayarlarından gol ve maç bildirimlerini aç.
Uygulama ücretli mi? Hayır, Webaslan ücretsizdir.
Görüş ve önerilerin bizim için değerli. Bize her zaman destek@webaslan.com adresinden ulaşabilirsin.
Webaslan'ı hemen indir, Aslan'ın her adımını ilk sen öğren!
Webaslan bağımsız bir taraftar haber uygulamasıdır; Galatasaray Spor Kulübü'nün resmi uygulaması değildir ve kulüple resmi bir bağlantısı yoktur.

bluejetty:00160813:ios.description:
*Used by over 1 million people around the world
*Best free journal in any app store
*Syncs to the web and other mobile platforms for free
Penzu is the most popular free diary, journal and notepad. It’s the best place to keep your most private thoughts safe and secure. Sync your journals to Penzu where your notes are accessible from almost any device in the world. So simple and fun that you’ll leave your paper diary behind!
FEATURES
*Unlimited journaling
*Sync journals with Penzu cloud for free
*Customize your journal covers
*Lock journals with a password
*Encrypt your journals
*Add photos
*Lock app with a PIN
*Search journals
*Add tags
*Write offline
and more...
WHY PENZU?
Penzu is a diary and personal journal that is focused on privacy. With a unique and compelling user experience, it makes writing online as easy and intuitive as writing on a pad of paper.
PRIVACY
Your journal and your thoughts aren’t always meant to be shared — some things are supposed to be private! Use Penzu to jot down whatever you want. Then lock your journal with a password (or even encryption) so no one can read it but you! Furthermore, you can lock the entire app with a PIN in the event that someone gets access to your mobile device.
PENZU
Unlike other journal apps, Penzu has a web-based counterpart. So you can access your journals and diary from any web browser and other devices. Penzu is constantly being updated and improved so that the writing experience is effortless and reliable.
SUBSCRIPTION INFO
This app is free to download but requires a free Penzu account in order to start writing.
Upgrading to Penzu Pro is available for a small monthly or yearly subscription. Your subscription will auto-renew unless you cancel manually. Monthly subscriptions are $4.99 USD and renew every month. Yearly subscriptions are $19.99 USD and renew every year.
You can see our privacy policy here: http://penzu.com/m/privacy
You can read our terms of use here: http://penzu.com/m/terms

bluejetty:00034728:ios.description:
Secure Your Digital Life with Our Authenticator App
Our Authenticator app is designed to provide you with a seamless and secure two-factor authentication (2FA) experience. Safeguard your online accounts from unauthorized access by generating time-based one-time passcodes (TOTP) that add an extra layer of protection to your login process.
Key Features:
- Multiple Account Support: Easily manage and secure all your accounts in one place, from social media to financial services.
- Effortless Setup: Quickly add accounts by scanning QR codes or manually entering details.
- Face ID and Touch ID Integration: Use biometric authentication for quick and secure access to your codes.
- Cloud Backups: Ensure you never lose access to your codes with secure backups on iCloud.
- Dark Mode: Enjoy a sleek, eye-friendly interface designed for low-light environments.
- Cross-Device Sync: Seamlessly sync your codes across multiple devices for maximum convenience.
Whether you're protecting your email, social media, or online banking, our Authenticator app is your trusted companion for enhanced security.
Terms of Use: https://authenticator2.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://authenticator2.com/policy

bluejetty:00186019:ios.summary:
Award-winning reading app trusted by millions of families and educators!
Splash Reading helps kids master English Language Arts (ELA) skills from Kindergarten through Grade 5. Designed by experts, it combines structured lessons with fun, ga
bluejetty:00186019:ios.description:
Award-winning reading app trusted by millions of families and educators!
Splash Reading helps kids master English Language Arts (ELA) skills from Kindergarten through Grade 5. Designed by experts, it combines structured lessons with fun, game-based activities to build strong readers and confident writers.
Awards & Recognition
- Winner of the Tabby Award for Best Educational App
- Featured as “No. 1 Education App” by Apple
- Loved by millions of kids, teachers, and parents worldwide
About Splash Reading
Splash Reading turns learning into an engaging journey.
Through phonics, vocabulary, spelling, grammar, and comprehension lessons, children progress step-by-step at their own pace. Each activity helps them strengthen reading fluency, boost confidence, and enjoy learning.
What Your Child Will Learn
→ Kindergarten
- Recognize letters and sounds
- Trace letters and learn sequencing
- Explore sight words, rhyming words, and phonics basics
→ Grade 1
- Build foundational reading and writing skills
- Master sight words, bossy R words, and silent e
- Practice rhyming, digraphs, and vowel blends
→ Grade 2
- Strengthen fluency and phonics understanding
- Learn diphthongs, trigraphs, and consonant clusters
- Expand vocabulary and spelling accuracy
→ Grade 3
- Develop reading comprehension and word usage
- Improve writing and spelling through fun activities
- Practice cursive writing and sentence construction
→ Grade 4
- Advance grammar and vocabulary
- Analyze text meaning and improve comprehension
- Strengthen writing structure and creativity
→ Grade 5
- Master advanced grammar and vocabulary
- Read complex passages with understanding
- Enhance creative and analytical writing skills
Why Families Love SplashLearn
- Guided Learning Path: Lessons build progressively for smooth skill development
- Playful Practice: Interactive games turn reading and writing into fun challenges
- Independent Learning: Kids learn confidently at their own pace
- Safe and Ad-Free: A secure environment designed by educators
Parent Reviews
- “My son struggled with reading until we tried Splash Reading. Now he enjoys it every day!” – Parent of a 2nd Grader
- “The phonics games are amazing. My daughter’s fluency has improved so much.” – Parent of a 1st Grader
- “A fantastic app for independent learning. My kids are having fun while improving.” – Parent of a 4th Grader
Subscription & Free Trial
Try it free! Get full access during your free trial, then choose a flexible plan that fits your family.
Enjoy unlimited access to reading and writing activities for your child.
Need Help?
We’re here for you → https://support.splashlearn.com/hc/en-us
Privacy & Terms
Your child’s safety comes first.
- https://www.splashlearn.com/privacy
- https://www.splashlearn.com/terms-of-use

Exciting Gameplay
- Simple to learn, hard to master
- Race against time while facing clever enemies
- Quick, action-packed rounds perfect for any moment
Unique Features
- Discover hidden shooters in tunnels and unleash them to stop the incoming wave of enemies
- Use rope-linked shooters—call them into firing positions in pairs
- Reveal a mystery shooter’s color to unlock new ways to counter enemy tactics
Tricks to Gain the Upper Hand
- Use Lightning Bolt to zap the first few enemies and clear a path for your defense
- Activate Shooter Pull to bring any shooter from the board to your side, instantly turning the tide of battle
Face Powerful Bosses Fight bosses who can speed up the enemy column or shield their units, testing your ability to adapt and counter their moves!
Outsmart, Outshoot, Outlast! Download Strike Jam now and dominate the battlefield with smart strategies, powerful tricks, and unbeatable shooters. Every move counts—and the clock is ticking!
Tap Get and start the challenge!

bluejetty:00075863:ios.name: Swipe Photo Cleaner: SwipeWipe
bluejetty:00075863:ios.summary:
Swipe right to keep, left to delete. Swipe Photo Cleaner turns a full camera roll into a quick game: go month by month, clear duplicates, big videos and old screenshots, and free up gigabytes of iPhone storage.
Your library grows every day
bluejetty:00075863:ios.description:
Swipe right to keep, left to delete. Swipe Photo Cleaner turns a full camera roll into a quick game: go month by month, clear duplicates, big videos and old screenshots, and free up gigabytes of iPhone storage.
Your library grows every day: ten takes of the same sunset, screenshots you needed once, videos nobody watches again. Deleting them one by one in Photos takes an evening. Here one swipe decides each photo, and the space you free is counted as you go.
SWIPE TO CLEAN
• Swipe left to delete, right to keep
• Go through your library month by month instead of scrolling through thousands of shots
• Changed your mind? Undo the last swipe
• Share a photo right from the card
FIND WHAT TAKES SPACE
• Duplicates and similar photos grouped together, so you keep the best shot
• Large videos in their own list
• Screenshots in their own list
• Filter by type: videos, Live Photos, portraits, panoramas, bursts, slo-mo, time-lapse, GIF and RAW
MEMORIES AND HABIT
• On This Day brings back photos taken on this date in past years
• A daily streak keeps the cleanup going a few minutes a day
• Widgets on the Home Screen and Lock Screen show your streak and the space you have freed
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Secret Space: hide photos and videos behind a passcode or Face ID
• Photos are sorted on your iPhone and never uploaded
• Deleted photos go to Recently Deleted in the Photos app, so you can still restore them
WHO IT'S FOR
• Anyone who keeps seeing "iPhone Storage Full"
• Parents with thousands of near-identical photos of their kids
• Travelers making room before a trip
• Anyone moving to a new iPhone who wants a tidy library
• People who like to relive old photos while they clean
FREE AND PREMIUM
Swipe for free every day. When you hit the limit, wait for the timer or invite a friend, and you both get extra swipes. Premium removes the limit and unlocks every feature. Available plans and prices are shown in the app before you pay.

--E
bluejetty:00016515:ios.description:
The story takes place on a beautiful and mysterious land, where lives a variety of bizarre monsters. Each trainer has a dream in his mind -- to get his fondest monsters in search of this land and fight with them.
 [Features of the game]
--Explore this vast and mysterious mainland
It’s worthwhile to search everywhere on this vast expanse of land. Defeat the annoying monsters and BOSSES that block your way; Help troubled inhabitants solve their problems in exchange for rich rewards; Bargain with vendors to buy rare goods. Moreover, lairs with haunting creeps, formidable force and ancient treasury in the desert ruins… They are all waiting for you.
--Utilize the restraint relationship to build various teams
The nine type monsters, with different skills and talents, reinforce and neutralize each other. Based on their restraint relationship, you can create a variety of teams -- Weather Group, Double Blade, Control Center… There’re only teams that you cannot image, yet no teams that you cannot build!
--Train strongest monsters through various ways
Upgrade brings higher level; Star-up increases stats growth; Awaken unlocks new skills. Also, skill upgrade, talent activation, personality cultivation… Training though various ways helps you get more and stronger monsters.
--Dominate the glorious ancient battlefield
Settle in this ancient battlefield with your dreaming monsters and fight with them in this place filled with treasures and dangers. Here, you may encounter close friends but also dreadful enemies. Who shall laugh last？
--Delicate and powerful training base
Bring the rare recipes gained through the adventures to the Blacksmith. Craftsmen there will prepare necessities for your next journey. Collect magic books scattered throughout the land. Learners in the holy Shrine will study the sealed magic to make you more powerful. Every time you come back to the base, it is for the purpose of travelling farther.

bluejetty:00079379:ios.description:
Eato® is a streamlined app for managing weight health through calorie tracking and meal planning, keeping you on the path to wellness.
Here, Eato® takes you on a new path of weight loss and improves your body health with scientific and effective methods.
FEATURES:
· Calorie Counter: Get customized daily caloric intake recommendations based on your body's needs and your weight loss ambitions. Log food and meal calories through various methods, including search, barcode scanning, or AI image recognition, to stay on course with your dietary goals.
· Step Counter - Set your daily step goals, and we'll assist you in achieving and tracking them. Staying active has never been easier or more rewarding.
· Recipe Recommend - Enjoy three square meals a day, helping you maintain a normal diet during your eating window while maximizing nutrient intake. Based on your eating habits, we craft a personalized meal plan just for you.
· Weight Tracker - keep an eye on your progress and let us supply you with the best plan tailored to you. Developing the habit of recording your weight is crucial for scientific weight loss and maintaining optimal health.
 · Healthy Weight Planner: Select your plan, set your goals, and track your progress. With the simple tap of a button, you can start or conclude your journey. Our clear, user-friendly interface ensures you can monitor and navigate your path with ease.
Note: Achieving healthy weight loss goals requires a balanced diet plan combined with physical activity. Relying solely on dietary restrictions without exercise is unlikely to lead to desired weight management.
Healthy Weight Programs:
There are plans for beginners and experienced people. You can customize your plan. No matter your stage, a plan should always match your goal.
Nutrient-Rich Recipes:
Knowing what to eat is the gateway to success. Eato® designs customized meal plans for you. We are not aiming to restrict your diet but to give you a nutritional supplement for your everyday meals. Three meals a day, guide you through hunger and satisfy your body at most in the eating window.
Why Eato®:
- The Most User-Friendly Calorie Tracker
- Personalize weight loss plan
- Helping you manage your eating window
- Telling you what exactly you should eat in each meal
- Wise weight loss method combining a nutritious diet and moderate exercise
- Friendly reminders keep you on track
- A step-by-step plan guides you to a good habit
- Guiding you to stay healthy and feel well
Apple Health: Apple Health integration to track steps for daily active goals.
Subscription Information: Eato® offers a 7-day trial subscription service for $79.99/year, granting unlimited access to VIP features during the subscription period. Your payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase after the 7-day trial. During the trial period, you can manage your subscription and cancel by going to your 'Account Settings'. After being charged, you may turn off auto-renewal by visiting the same section. Your subscription will automatically be renewed unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The renewal cost will be charged to your account 24 hours before the end of the current period. When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but they will not refund the current subscription. If offered, any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.
Note: This app is developed for informational purposes only. You must always consult your physician or doctor before starting any fitness program. Results can vary.
Terms of Use: https://enerjoy.life/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://enerjoy.life/privacy-policy
If you have any questions or suggestions, email us at: service_ios@support.eato.health

bluejetty:00090241:ios.description:
Take care of yourself starting today! 
Catzy is a self-care app that helps you make self-care part of the little things you do every day. Complete daily Self-Care tasks, track your mood, and practice mind-body exercises so every act of self-care comes with clear feedback. Use your rewards to care for your cat, unlock outfits and furniture, and explore the world.
With small, steady steps, you can better understand how you’re doing and make time to breathe and reset.
Easy daily self-care 
Self-care doesn’t have to start with a major change.
• Complete daily goals such as waking up on time, making your bed, and drinking water.
• Put life’s happy moments into the Happy Energy Jar.
• Use a variety of home-screen widgets to check your goals, water logs, task progress, and other daily information.
• Make self-care clear, easy, and simple to maintain.
Understand your emotions more deeply 
• Mood Tracking: Record how you feel each day and notice emotional changes.
• Emotional Reflection: Sort through your thoughts with guided questions.
• Emotional Temperature: Explore your current emotions and understand the reasons and changes behind your feelings.
Self-care tools for different states of mind 
• Breathing Exercises: Slow down and ease tension.
• Focus Timer: Stay focused on the task in front of you.
• Sleep Assistant: Relax and fall asleep with soothing sounds.
• Affirmations: Encourage yourself with positive words.
• Calm Channel: Find a moment of quiet whenever you need it.
• 5-4-3-2-1: Bring your attention back to the present.
• Book of Answers: Find new perspectives in a lighthearted way.
Start with one small goal, take care of yourself, and take care of your cat too. 
Subscription Information 
Catzy offers auto-renewing subscription services. Plan details, subscription period, and pricing are as shown on the purchase page. After confirming your purchase, you will have access to premium features.
Your subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renewal in your iTunes/Apple ID settings at least 24 hours before the current subscription period ends. The renewal fee will be charged to your account within 24 hours before the current period ends. Once payment is successful, your subscription will enter the next period.
After cancellation, your premium access remains active until the end of the current billing period.
If you do not cancel during the free trial in your iTunes/Apple ID settings, your subscription will be activated and charged automatically when the trial ends. Any unused trial time will expire after purchase.

bluejetty:00100125:ios.description:
Keep a Dated History of Your Followers with The Followers Unfollow Tracker
Curious about who unfollowed you on Instagram?
The Followers Unfollow Tracker keeps a dated history of your own account. Run a check-up whenever you like: each one is saved on your iPhone with its date, so you can look back and see who followed you and who left between check-ups.
Core Features:
Run a new check-up any time with Check again on Overview.
See who followed or unfollowed you since your last check-up.
Track mutuals, fans, and people who don't follow you back.
Spot accounts no longer found: deactivated, renamed or no longer visible to you.
See engaged non-followers: people who liked or commented recently but don't follow you.
Unfollow from the app, one account at a time.
Insights & History
Insights shows how your account evolves across your check-ups:
See the followers gained and lost between check-ups.
Follow your follower count across your recent check-ups.
See how your recent posts and stories are doing.
Ask About Your Numbers
Ask short questions about your latest check-up, like "What changed in my latest check-up?" Answers are made on your iPhone with Apple's on-device Foundation Models; no server or third-party AI is used. It only answers about your own counts and can be turned off in Settings.
Home Screen & Lock Screen Widgets
Widgets show the counts and time of your latest check-up—no names or photos, hidden while your iPhone is locked, no network use.
Watchlist & Explore
Explore: look up public profiles.
Watchlist: add public accounts and see their follower counts over time.
Why You Need a Follower Tracker
Instagram doesn't show you who unfollowed you or how your follower list changed over time. The Followers Unfollow Tracker keeps that history for you.
Simple & Safe
You sign in on Instagram's own login page inside the app, and your password goes only to Instagram. We never ask for or store your Instagram password.
The app reads your follower information from that signed-in session, on your device. Check-ups run while the app is open.
Privacy & Security First
Your privacy matters. Your check-ups, lists and Watchlist are stored on your device, and you can remove local app data at any time from Settings > Delete my data.
Purchase and attribution services receive limited account information, as described in our Privacy Policy.
Perfect For
Influencers, businesses and everyday users who want to see how their audience changes over time.
Pro Subscription
Some lists and Insights features need Pro. Choose a weekly or yearly auto-renewing subscription (eligible users may get a free trial) or a one-time lifetime purchase. The price is shown in the app before you buy.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.
Disclaimer:
This app cannot display profile viewers and can't tell who blocked you.
Not a repost or view-tracking tool.
Completely unaffiliated with Instagram: The Followers Unfollow Tracker is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Instagram or Meta.
Notes:
An active Instagram account is required.
Ask about your numbers requires iOS 26 with Apple Intelligence.
Take charge of your follower history with The Followers Unfollow Tracker — a simple way to see who comes and goes over time.
Terms of Use: https://thefollowers-ec32d.web.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://thefollowers-ec32d.web.app/privacy.html
Download now and start building your follower history.

bluejetty:00045267:ios.description:
Sensical – Safe, Free Streaming for Kids 
Sensical is the safest free kids streaming app, offering educational, age-appropriate videos for kids—without unsafe content, data tracking, or subscriptions. 
Built for families, Sensical combines expert-reviewed kids’ videos, trusted characters, and powerful parental controls so kids can explore independently while parents stay confidently in control. 
Safe Videos for Kids You Can Trust 
Safety comes first on Sensical. 
Every video is hand-reviewed by child development experts for age-appropriateness, educational value, and positive role models. 
Designed for Preschool (2–4), Little Kids (5–7), and Big Kids (8–10) 
100% COPPA compliant 
No collection of personal data 
Kid-safe advertising standards 
Sensical delivers a worry-free streaming experience parents can trust. 
15,000+ Educational Videos Kids Love 
Kids can explore 15,000+ videos across 50+ kid-safe channels, featuring favorite characters and trusted creators, including: 
Thomas & Friends, Franklin, Sid the Science Kid, Sunny Bunnies, Mother Goose Club, Pinkfong! Kids’ Songs & Stories, Morphie, Kipper, and more. 
From storytelling and science to creativity, music, and hands-on learning, Sensical supports curiosity across hundreds of topics. 
Educational & Fun 
Every video on Sensical is selected to be both educational and entertaining—so parents know screen time is time well spent. 
Learning happens naturally when kids love what they’re watching. 
Kids Explore. Parents Stay in Control. 
Sensical is designed for independent discovery with built-in parental controls, including: 
Individual child profiles by age 
Content blocking 
Cross-device time limits 
Personalized learning reports 
Parents guide the experience. Kids enjoy the freedom. 
Always Free Kids Streaming 
Sensical is free to download and free to watch—no subscription, no registration required. Enjoy unlimited kids’ videos anytime, anywhere, on any device. 
Download Sensical Today 
Join families everywhere using Sensical for safe, educational streaming for kids. 
Questions? Contact us at feedback@sensical.tv

bluejetty:00175413:ios.summary: Doctor On Demand by Included Health offers 24/7 access to board-certified doctors, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists via secure video visits from your phone, tablet, or computer. When you're feeling sick, want a doctor’s note, need hel
bluejetty:00175413:ios.description:
Doctor On Demand by Included Health offers 24/7 access to board-certified doctors, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists via secure video visits from your phone, tablet, or computer. When you're feeling sick, want a doctor’s note, need help with a prescription, and more, we make it easy to get quality telehealth anytime, anywhere—with or without insurance. Download the free Doctor On Demand app to get started. 
Why Choose Doctor On Demand?
Fast Access to Online Doctors – See a board-certified, US-based provider with telehealth appointments anytime, day or night.
Therapy & Psychiatry – Book virtual visits for mental health concerns like stress, anxiety, depression, PTSD, trauma, and more.
Online Urgent Care, Treatment, Prescriptions – For colds, flu, allergies, skin conditions, UTIs, headaches, and more, our providers can send prescriptions to nearby pharmacies if medically appropriate. 
Doctor’s Notes – Need a doctor’s note for work or school? We’ve got you covered. See an urgent care provider for help. 
Insurance or Self-Pay – We work with major health plans and many employers to reduce the costs of visits for eligible members. If not covered, we offer affordable visit costs to all patients with no surprise bills. 
How It Works
Download the app and create an account for free.
Choose to see the first available provider, or schedule a visit.
Get personalized care, prescriptions, and treatment plans in an online visit. 
Conditions We Treat
- Cold, Flu & Sinus Infections
- UTI Treatment Online
- Acne, Rashes & Skin Issues
- Allergies & Asthma
- High Cholesterol, Diabetes & Thyroid Screening
- Headaches & Migraines
- Mental Health Support: Anxiety, Depression, Grief & More
- Prescription Refills & Lab Orders
Frequently Asked Questions
When are doctors available?
Our virtual providers are available 24/7, 365 days a year, including weekends and holidays. Mental health appointments are often available within days—much faster than traditional providers who can take weeks
How much does a visit cost?
You’ll always see your exact visit cost upfront. We accept most insurance plans and partner with top employers and health plans to lower your costs. No insurance? Our telehealth visit costs are affordable.
Who are the doctors?
Our US-based, board-certified doctors, licensed psychiatrists, and therapists have an average of 15 years of experience and come from diverse specialties to ensure you receive expert care.
How does it work? 
Join a telehealth visit to connect face to face with a provider from your phone, tablet, or computer in as little as ten minutes. Like an in-person visit, your provider will discuss with you how you’re feeling, your healthcare history, and propose a recommended treatment plan. Labs, screenings, and prescriptions will be sent to nearby facilities.
What can you treat? 
Our urgent care doctors can treat hundreds of issues, including cold and flu, urinary tract infections, allergies, headache, sprains, and skin conditions. They can also order labs and screenings to help with preventative care and help manage chronic care conditions. Our extensive team of therapists and psychiatrists are able to treat anxiety, stress, depression, PTSD, trauma and loss relationships, and more. 
Your Privacy is Our Priority
We adhere to strict HIPAA guidelines to protect your health data and personal information.
Our providers are unable to prescribe controlled substances. 
Get Started Today
Join millions of patients who trust Doctor On Demand for fast, convenient, and reliable healthcare. Download the app now to sign up for free!

Therapy & Psychiatry – Book virtual visits for mental health concerns like stress, anxiety, depression, PTSD, trauma, and more.

Online Urgent Care, Treatment, Prescriptions – For colds, flu, allergies, skin conditions, UTIs, headaches, and more, our providers can send prescriptions to nearby pharmacies if medically appropriate. 

Doctor’s Notes – Need a doctor’s note for work or school? We’ve got you covered. See an urgent care provider for help. 

Insurance or Self-Pay – We work with major health plans and many employers to reduce the costs of visits for eligible members. If not covered, we offer affordable visit costs to all patients with no surprise bills. 

How It Works

Download the app and create an account for free.
Choose to see the first available provider, or schedule a visit.
Get personalized care, prescriptions, and treatment plans in an online visit. 

Conditions We Treat
- Cold, Flu & Sinus Infections
- UTI Treatment Online
- Acne, Rashes & Skin Issues
- Allergies & Asthma
- High Cholesterol, Diabetes & Thyroid Screening
- Headaches & Migraines
- Mental Health Support: Anxiety, Depression, Grief & More
- Prescription Refills & Lab Orders

Frequently Asked Questions
When are doctors available?
Our virtual providers  are available 24/7, 365 days a year, including weekends and holidays. Mental health appointments are often available within days—much faster than traditional providers who can take weeks

How much does a visit cost?
You’ll always see your exact visit cost upfront. We accept most insurance plans and partner with top employers and health plans to lower your costs. No insurance? Our telehealth visit costs are affordable.

Who are the doctors?
Our US-based, board-certified doctors, licensed psychiatrists, and therapists have an average of 15 years of experience and come from diverse specialties to ensure you receive expert care.

How does it work? 
Join a telehealth visit to connect face to face with a provider from your phone, tablet, or computer in as little as ten minutes. Like an in-person visit, your provider will discuss with you how you’re feeling, your healthcare history, and propose a recommended treatment plan. Labs, screenings, and prescriptions will be sent to nearby facilities.

What can you treat? 
Our urgent care doctors can treat hundreds of issues, including cold and flu, urinary tract infections, allergies, headache, sprains, and skin conditions. They can also order labs and screenings to help with preventative care and help manage chronic care conditions. Our extensive team of therapists and psychiatrists are able to treat anxiety, stress, depression, PTSD, trauma and loss relationships, and more. 

Your Privacy is Our Priority
We adhere to strict HIPAA guidelines to protect your health data and personal information.

Our providers are unable to prescribe controlled substances.

2. Connect to a Study Expert tutor in seconds for a personalized, 10-minute chat session. bluejetty:00066356:ios.description:
Tap Color – Coloring Game is one of the BEST relaxing games for you to release stress on your mobile devices. You can leisurely draw your own modern masterpieces based on numbers. So it can help you release stress and feel relaxed by number coloring.
A coloring book is a secret weapon of anti-stress. According to some research, coloring may increase creativity in painting for educational purposes and also can be beneficial to people's mental health.
GREAT FEATURES:
- Simple & Easy to Paint Your Artworks
Do not know about art painting? Don’t worry, all you need do is tap the numbers and follow the clues, then tap the relevant cells to fill the color. It is much easier than drawing pixel art.
- Well Designed Anti-Stress Paintings
All the paintings are designed carefully, they will provide you with an excellent way to feel calm and enjoy hours of fun and relaxation.
- Various Images in Different Categories 
There are a variety of coloring pages in different categories, you can color flowers, landscapes, unicorns, mandalas, etc. More types are on the go.
- Coloring Masterpieces Anytime & Anywhere
Try to start this coloring game for relaxation and creation anytime or anywhere, you can color and revise your coloring pages Anytime & Anywhere.
- Editors’ Selected Images for Your Coloring
There will be some images selected by editors for you to color. Those editors’ choices will offer you a better coloring experience than the regular ones.
- Share Your Creations on Social Networks 
You can quickly send your artwork to your friends or post them on social networks like Facebook.
HOW TO PAINT:
- Choose different numbers to locate the unfinished coloring cells.
- Use 2 fingers to zoom in or zoom out through the coloring image.
- Use 1 finger to drag the coloring image from one place to another.
- “Hints” help you auto-locate the coloring cells which you cannot find.
- Your artwork’s progress will be auto-saved when you leave or close it.

bluejetty:00153812:ios.name: Air Printer App - Smart Print
bluejetty:00153812:ios.summary: Experience the full power of mobile printing with Air Printer, your go-to printing app for iPhone. With just a few taps, you can connect to any Air Print-compatible printer or pair with Bluetooth thermal and label printers to print document
bluejetty:00153812:ios.description:
Experience the full power of mobile printing with Air Printer, your go-to printing app for iPhone. With just a few taps, you can connect to any Air Print-compatible printer or pair with Bluetooth thermal and label printers to print documents, photos, PDFs, scans, receipts, and labels - no cables, no desktop needed.
Whether you're printing important business reports, scanning contracts, or sending cherished memories to paper, Air Printer offers everything you need for fast, flexible, and reliable mobile printing.
Key Features:
- Connects to All WiFi Printers
Air Printer works seamlessly with all major printer brands that support AirPrint. If your printer is on the same Wi-Fi network, you're good to go - no driver installation required.
- Bluetooth Thermal & Label Printing
Connect to Bluetooth thermal printers and label printers to print receipts, tags, and labels directly - no Wi-Fi required, just pair and print with this smart printer companion.
- Print Photos & Files Instantly
Print everything from images in your camera roll to PDFs, Word documents, Excel sheets, and more. The app supports a wide range of file formats for both personal and professional use.
- Smart Document Scanner
Turn your iPhone into a pocket-sized document scanner. Scan receipts, ID cards, handwritten notes, or full pages with crystal clarity. Save scans as PDF or print them right away.
- Email Attachments & Web Pages Notes
Need to print a boarding pass or a file from your inbox? Air Printer makes it easy to print email attachments. You can also select and print notes from web pages, making it ideal for saving articles, recipes, and online forms.
- File Editing Before Printing
Take control of your print job. Adjust layout, paper size, orientation, and page range. Crop, rotate, or annotate scanned files before printing - all within the app.
Why Choose Air Printer?
Air Printer combines the convenience of wireless Air Print technology with powerful tools that make it more than just a printer app. It's a full-featured mobile print and document scanner solution built for everyday needs.
Whether you're a student needing fast printouts, a professional scanning and printing on the go, or a parent printing photos at home - Air Printer makes the process simple, fast, and reliable.
Auto-Renewable Subscription Terms:
- Your subscription will automatically renew on a weekly, monthly, or annual basis according to the plan you choose, and the charge will be processed via your Apple ID.
- Free trials automatically switch to paid subscriptions unless canceled at least 24 hours before the trial period ends.
- If you purchase a premium plan during a free trial, any remaining trial time will be forfeited.
- You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your iTunes account settings. Changes will apply after the current billing period ends.

bluejetty:00121401:ios.summary: Welcome to the ORIGINAL Emoji Trivia Game! Guess The Emoji is the original cult classic guessing game that will entertain you for hours. This crazy fun emoji quiz game tests your knowledge, logic and reasoning skills to solve simple (and of
bluejetty:00121401:ios.description:
Welcome to the ORIGINAL Emoji Trivia Game! Guess The Emoji is the original cult classic guessing game that will entertain you for hours. This crazy fun emoji quiz game tests your knowledge, logic and reasoning skills to solve simple (and oftentimes hard!) emoji puzzles! 
HOW IS GUESS THE EMOJI DIFFERENT?
The concept is simple, really! We show you a series of emojis and emoticons (such as an emoji of a cat, then an emoji of a fish), then give you a set of letters to use for your guesses - it's your job to guess what they mean when put together. Did you get CATFISH? We're pretty sure you did, that was an easy puzzle! But trust us, this guessing game gets a lot harder as you go, with tons of categories to play through! 
So... can you guess all the emoji trivia questions correctly?
HINTS TO HELP YOU OUT!
Many times things have double meanings and these puzzles can be a real challenge! Nothing is worse than being stumped during a trivia game... so instead of making you phone a friend, we offer some in-game boosts to help you guess correctly and move to the next quiz question!
Expose A Letter - Using this hint will reveal a random letter in the game puzzle. Use this hint when you need an extra nudge to guess the answer to a hard trivia question! 
Remove The Letters - This hint removes all letters from the board which are NOT USED in the puzzle game. This hint can be very helpful in guessing on shorter puzzles. Use it wisely!
Solve It! - We get it. Sometimes it just doesn't click. This is when guessing games go awry and you're frustrated. (We created the game and even we sometimes still get stuck!) This hint will completely solve the trivia question for you and allow you to move on to the next set of emojis in the guessing game! 
~Emojis provided by http://emojione.com~

DO YOU NEED A SECOND NUMBER TO SEPARATE YOUR WORK AND PRIVATE LIFE?
Call Now allows you to have different lines to meet your dating, shopping and business without a SIM card. It provides you with a real US & Canada number and you can make calls and texts.
With Call Now, you can:
- Online Shopping. Keep your personal phone number private when shopping online or receiving deliveries.
- Dating. Giving your friends on social apps a separate number protects your privacy.
- Services & Rentals. Communicate securely with a new phone number when contacting public services, hostings, or car rentals.
Features:
- Get a real US & Canada phone number for calling and texting
- Set app lock to protect your privacy (supports PIN code, Touch ID, and Face ID)
- Call to voicemail (for US numbers) when you are not available to answer a phone call.
- Create, sync, and manage contacts seamlessly within the app
- Send and receive MMS (for US and Canadian numbers)
- Rich messaging experience with EMOJI and STICKERS

• You can cancel a free trial or subscription anytime by turning off auto-renewal through your iTunes account settings. This must be done 24 hours before the end of a free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the free service

bluejetty:00155724:ios.description:
Zidy transforms the way your business talks to customers with the unified communications hub that puts real‑time conversations, bookings, reviews, payments, and marketing automations on a single screen.
Running a growing team means juggling multiple channels and touchpoints. Zidy consolidates SMS, social messaging, voice, reviews, and scheduling into one intuitive dashboard so you can serve customers faster, capture more leads, and keep every teammate in sync—anywhere, even offline.
Key Capabilities:
• Unified Inbox: Handle SMS, Facebook Messenger, and Instagram DMs side‑by‑side with internal team chat and group threads.
• AI Assistance Everywhere: Deploy an AI chatbot and real‑time voice AI to greet visitors, qualify leads, book appointments, summarize chats for your team, and free you from repetitive replies.

Introducing Sweet Dreams, the must-have app for families using Dexcom or Libre to monitor sugar levels. With our innovative features and seamless integr
bluejetty:00174171:ios.description:
NEW: now supports Libre, Dexcom, Medtronic, Nightscout, Eversense, Medtrum and Twiist!
Introducing Sweet Dreams, the must-have app for families using Dexcom or Libre to monitor sugar levels. With our innovative features and seamless integration of the latest Apple technology, Sweet Dreams keeps you and your loved ones informed, connected, and in control of your sugar levels, making diabetes management a breeze.
Key Features:
1. Live Activity: Stay updated with your sugar levels without even unlocking your iPhone. Our Live Activity widget on the lock screen gives you a clear and friendly view of your sugar levels, so you're always in the know.
2. Dynamic Island: Keep an eye on your sugar levels while using other apps, thanks to our Dynamic Island feature. This feature displays sugar level data at the top of the screen, ensuring you never miss an important update.
3. Message Group: Bring the whole family together with our two-click messaging feature. Send pings and acknowledgements to keep everyone informed and coordinated. Whether you need to alert your family about a sudden drop in sugar levels or simply want to let them know you're aware of the situation, our Message Group functionality makes communication effortless.
4. Customisable Notifications: Sweet Dreams sends timely alerts when sugar levels are too high, too low, or experience significant changes. You'll also receive notifications when there are no readings. Personalise these alerts to suit your preferences, ensuring you never miss an important update.
5. App Badge: See live readings directly on the app's icon (optional)
6. Family Subscription: Our subscription model is designed with families in mind. One subscription covers the entire family, making it cost-effective and convenient for everyone to stay informed and connected.
Join the Sweet Dreams family today and experience the future of Dexcom/Libre sugar level monitoring. Download the app and start your journey towards a healthier, happier life with your loved ones by your side.
Compatibility:
This list may change over time. Sweet Dreams works with:
• Dexcom G7, G6 and ONE+
• FreeStyle Libre 3, 3 Plus, 2 and 2 Plus (Libre 2 only in regions where it uploads automatically to LibreLinkUp)
• Medtronic MiniMed 780G, 770G, 740G and 720G, Simplera and Instinct, via CareLink
• Eversense, via Eversense NOW
• Medtrum, via EasyFollow
• twiist, via Twiist Insiights
• Tandem t:slim X2 and Mobi, via Tandem Source
• Nightscout, and any CGM that uploads to it
• CamAPS FX, via xDrip+ and Nightscout
Not compatible: the original Dexcom ONE, Dexcom Stelo and Abbott Lingo.
---
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
