bluejetty:00094295:ios.description:
Sharpen your mind and train your brain logic with this free math puzzle game anywhere, anytime! 
Arcadia Zen Math, a zen style math puzzle game, combines the thrill of math skill and logic training with the crossword gameplay. Arcadia Zen Math is perfect for anyone who enjoys mental exercise and solving math puzzles. The gameplay of this math puzzle game is simple! You’ll just need to solve each math puzzle by filling in grids with the correct numbers based on math equations. 
Key Features:
- Use basic operations: addition (plus), subtraction (minus), multiplication (times), and division to complete the math puzzles.
- Multiplication and division have higher precedence than Addition and Subtraction.
- Powerful props: use "Hint" if you get stuck during playing. 
- Large numbers: a larger design on numbers for a better view of the board layout.
- Well-designed collections: complete each math puzzle and win plant collections. Collect different types of plants.
Highlights:
- A zen game experience: the calming background makes this math puzzle game the perfect choice for relaxing and unwinding. 
- Math skills in crossword puzzles: Solve fun and challenging number crossword puzzles by applying math skills. It’s a perfect blend of math game mechanics and the classic crossword puzzle-solving skills.
- Take the lead: Compete against global players all over the world by getting ranked on the weekly, world, and regional leaderboards. 
Why Choose Arcadia Zen Math?
- Variety of difficulty levels: you can start from an easy level, then grow your math skills to beat harder levels as a math master.
- Unlimited puzzles: with tons of math puzzle levels, you’ll always have a new math crossword puzzle to conquer. 
- Daily Challenge: beat your best speed of solving the math puzzles per day.
- Offline Mode: play anywhere, and enjoy the math puzzle game without connecting to Wi-Fi or the internet.
In the series of Arcadia games, we aim to help you find well-crafted game fun like Arcadia Zen Math, Arcadia Mahjong, Arcadia Dominoes for seniors, and Arcadia Onet Match

bluejetty:00136694:ios.description:
Soundmap: Collect Songs, Trade Music & Explore the World!
Turn your daily walks into the ultimate music collecting game! Soundmap is a real-world music adventure where you explore the map, discover songs, trade tracks with other players, and build a collection of your favorite artists. Whether you love pop, hip-hop, rap, rock, indie, R&B, or electronic music, there's always another song waiting to be found.
Ready to become the ultimate music collector? Get outside, find music drops, and start building your dream collection!
 ► EXPLORE THE MAP & COLLECT SONGS
Your neighborhood is full of music waiting to be discovered. Walk around with Soundmap, find nearby drops on the interactive map, and collect songs as you explore. Every trip outside can bring a new surprise, from familiar hits to tracks you've never heard of.
 ► FIND RARE, SHINY & EPIC SONGS
Not every song is created equal! Grow your collection with Common, Uncommon, and Rare tracks, then hunt for coveted Shiny and Epic versions. Discover exciting finds, chase your favorite songs, and show off the rarest additions to your music collection. What will your next drop reveal?
 ► TRADE SONGS WITH MUSIC FANS
Missing a track from your favorite artist? Join a community of music collectors and trade songs with players around the world. Browse the marketplace, discover available tracks, make offers, and negotiate trades. Swap songs you don't need for the ones you really want and work toward your dream collection.
 ► COMPLETE ARTIST QUESTS
Go beyond listening to your favorite artists: collect their music! Take on Artist Quests, earn special rewards, and work toward completing artist discographies. From chart-topping stars to underground favorites, every artist gives you a new collecting goal. Keep hunting, trading, and unlocking more of the music you love.
 ► BUILD YOUR ULTIMATE MUSIC COLLECTION
Make your collection your own. Collect tracks across genres, discover new favorites, and chase the songs that matter most to you. Whether you're collecting every track by one artist or searching for the rarest finds, Soundmap gives you new reasons to explore and play every day.
 ► LEVEL UP & CLIMB THE LEADERBOARDS
Show your dedication as a music fan. Keep collecting, complete quests, level up, and compete on the leaderboards. Celebrate your progress, show off your collection, and see how your music-hunting skills stack up against other players.
 ► A MUSIC GAME THAT MOVES WITH YOU
Soundmap combines music discovery, collecting, trading, and real-world exploration in one interactive game. It's a new way to enjoy your favorite artists while getting out and discovering what's around you. Play during a quick walk or make a full day of searching for new drops. Every find brings you closer to your next favorite track.
 ► WHY MUSIC FANS LOVE SOUNDMAP
• Collect songs by exploring a real-world map.
• Hunt for Common, Uncommon, Rare, Shiny, and Epic tracks.
• Trade music and browse offers from other collectors.
• Complete Artist Quests and grow your discography collection.
• Discover songs across pop, rap, rock, R&B, indie, and more.
• Level up, compete, and show off your favorite finds.
• Turn everyday walks into a music collecting adventure.
••• YOUR NEXT FAVORITE SONG IS OUT THERE
Love discovering music? Obsessed with collecting? Looking for a fun game to play while exploring your city? Soundmap brings it all together. Collect the songs you love, trade with fellow fans, and see what rare music you can uncover next.
••• MAKE EVERY DROP COUNT
Explore new places, check the map for songs, and keep an eye out for finds. Share your love of music through your collection, chase hard-to-find tracks, and connect with players who love the same artists you do.
Download Soundmap today and start your music collection adventure!

bluejetty:00017049:ios.description:
Step into the shadows of Red Crow Mysteries: Legion, a dark hidden-object adventure filled with puzzles, mystery, and supernatural secrets.
Your special gift allows you to see beyond the veil of reality — but that gift comes at a price. The Legion is waiting. Are you ready to face him?
Can you uncover the truth before the darkness consumes everything?
WHAT AWAITS YOU:
• A hidden-object puzzle adventure with a rich story
• Puzzle & mystery adventure — dozens of unique riddles and mini-games.
• Intriguing narrative — a dramatic plot with twists and memorable characters.
• Atmospheric visuals & soundtrack — moody scenes that pull you deep into the mystery.
• Full voiceovers & HD visuals — immerse yourself in the story.
• Difficulty levels — from relaxed exploration to true challenge.
PERFECT FOR PLAYERS WHO WANT:
• Fully optimized for iPad and iPad Pro — play on a big screen with stunning Ultra HD graphics and detail!
• Play completely offline — Desktop, Phone & Tablet support — anytime, anywhere
• No data collection — your privacy is safe
• Try free, unlock full game once — no ads, no micro-transactions
Gameplay
Tap to search scenes, collect clues, combine items from your inventory, and complete mini-games to progress.
Use hints if you get stuck — but the reward is uncovering more of the mystery.
Play your way
Explore, investigate, find hidden objects and items, and solve puzzles and mini-games to reveal the mystery in your own way:
adjustable challenge — Casual, Adventure, and Challenging difficulty modes.
Earn Achievements & Collectibles.
Atmospheric adventure
A gripping mystery adventure: narrative-driven gameplay with strong detective elements.
Immersive locations are waiting to be explored — seek, search, and solve.
Why players love it
The mix of art and atmosphere, combined with story-driven adventure and classic puzzles and mini-games.
Whether you enjoy relaxing hidden-object hunts or brain-teasing challenges — this game offers both.
Free to try
Try for free, then unlock the full game for the entire mystery — no distractions, just a mystery to solve.
Are you ready to lift the veil and face the Legion? Download now and begin your journey into the unknown.
• INVESTIGATE strange occurrences
• EXPLORE dozens of eerie locations
• FIND clues and items
• SEARCH for hidden objects
• CONFRONT the Legion and save your soul
• SOLVE many different mini-games
• EARN achievements
• 3 DIFFICULTY MODES: casual, adventure, challenging
• TUTORIAL for beginners

bluejetty:00061474:ios.summary:

With Numero: Access global
bluejetty:00061474:ios.description:
Do you find yourself needing a second number or multiple phone numbers?
With Numero: Own a second number or multiple numbers easily.
Constantly searching for a fast, affordable, and safe internet while traveling?
With Numero: Access global data plans while traveling.
Worried about expensive international calls?
With Numero: Make calls at affordable rates with your own number or a second number, and enjoy easy VoIP calling through the app.
Why Numero?
2ND VIRTUAL NUMBERS
Need another mobile number or landline for work, travel, privacy, business, WhatsApp Business, marketplace chats, freelance, toll free, or privacy? Numero lets you add second or multiple numbers without switching or removing your SIM.
Choose numbers from many countries, including the USA. Virtual numbers work through the cloud anywhere in the world.
Choose a number to:
• Receive SMS and calls only.
• Receive and send SMS and make calls. Add credit later if you need outgoing SMS or calling.
WhatsApp: Not every Numero number supports WhatsApp. If you need WhatsApp, choose a number from the dedicated WhatsApp-compatible section in the app.
Free US Number: Collect coins in the Free Coins Center to get a US number free for one month. Collect coins again to renew it. These numbers do NOT support WhatsApp.
Toll-free numbers let customers call you without call charges. Numero toll-free numbers offer up to 5 lines, no setup fees, low number costs, no long-term commitment, and affordable outgoing calls.
TRAVEL DATA & FULL eSIMs
Going abroad and don't want expensive roaming, SIM swapping, store searches, or removing your SIM? Manage your connectivity in Numero.
Choose from these data eSIMs:
• Local eSIMs for single-country trips.
• Regional eSIMs for multi-country trips.
• Global eSIMs covering 120+ countries in one eSIM.
• Unlimited eSIMs, terms apply.
Activate before you fly by scanning a QR code, then connect after landing.
A Data eSIM is data-only: no phone number for regular calls or SMS. You can still call and message through internet apps such as WhatsApp, Telegram, and FaceTime.
A Full eSIM combines a real phone number, mobile data, SMS, and calling minutes, letting you call, text, and browse from one eSIM.
AFFORDABLE INTERNATIONAL CALLING
Want to stay connected to home without expensive roaming? Numero lets you call mobile phones and landlines internationally at affordable rates.
Call from your primary or second number. Forward incoming calls to a local or international second number to help avoid roaming charges.
VoIP calls require internet. On the other hand, the person you call doesn’t need Numero or internet connection.
Calling options:
• Limited-time calling offers.
• Local calling plans for supported countries; a local virtual number is required.
• EU Calling plans with UK virtual numbers and up to 70% discounts on supported destinations.
CALL FORWARDING & VOICEMAIL
Don't want calls interrupting your vacation or risk missing them? Forward calls to your second number, another person's number, or voicemail.
PLANS, SUPPORT & REFERRALS
Phone numbers are available with 1, 3, or 12 month subscription options. Auto-renewal is ON by default.
To cancel a phone number subscription, use the method that matches your payment method:
• App Store: manage or cancel through the store.
• Stripe / Numero Money: open Numero and go to the number linked to the subscription.
• Website: manage or cancel through the website.
Get 24/7 Customer Support.
Refer a friend: share your link and earn Numero Money when they buy an eSIM. Friends get €3 off.
Sign up with your number and start using Numero!
Email: support@numeroesim.com
Instagram & Facebook: @numeroglobal
Privacy Policy: https://www.numeroesim.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://www.numeroesim.com/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00149530:ios.name: Getmyboat
bluejetty:00149530:ios.summary:
DIVE INTO THE WORLD’S BEST BOAT RENTALS, YACHT CHARTERS, AND MORE!
Getmyboat is the best app for boat rentals, and the world’s biggest and best marketplace for everything on the water —boat rentals, yacht charters, jet ski rentals, sailboat
bluejetty:00149530:ios.description:
DIVE INTO THE WORLD’S BEST BOAT RENTALS, YACHT CHARTERS, AND MORE!
Getmyboat is the best app for boat rentals, and the world’s biggest and best marketplace for everything on the water —boat rentals, yacht charters, jet ski rentals, sailboat rentals, fishing charters, party boat rentals, and so much more.
Whether you’re searching for a local boat rental or looking to charter a yacht on your next vacation, we make it easy to find the perfect option for any occasion and on any budget. Find the perfect boat for you, quickly and easily book your boat day, and communicate with your captain — all in one platform.
WHAT WE OFFER
Browse over 180,000 boats across 180 countries, including boat rentals, yacht rentals and yacht charters, boat tours, jetski rentals, wakesurfing lessons, and more. Whether it’s a birthday boat rental, a sailboat for a sunset cruise, a yacht for a bachelorette party or bachelor party, or a pontoon for a casual day on the lake, Getmyboat has the perfect boat rental for you. Browse locations like Miami, San Diego, Chicago, New York City, Los Angeles, Tampa, Austin, Mexico, the Caribbean and beyond to start your adventure.
POPULAR WATER EXPERIENCES
With Getmyboat you can compare prices, book easily, and chat directly with boat owners to personalize your experience. Here are just a few examples of what you’ll find:
* Boat Rentals: Pontoons, sailboats, fishing boats, catamarans, and more, we’ve got it all.
* Yacht Charters: Luxury yachts at surprisingly affordable prices, for big events, birthday parties, bachelorette parties, family celebrations, and more.
* Jet Ski Rentals: High-speed fun for thrill-seekers.
* Fishing Charters & Tours: For deep-sea fishing or laid-back lakeside casting.
* Wakesurfing and Wakeboarding: Shred the wake with these fast and fun boats.
HOW GETMYBOAT WORKS
We make it simple, safe, and accessible for everyone to get on the water, and renting a boat with Getmyboat is as easy as it gets:
1. Find the Boat for You. Browse through boat listings of all kinds, all over the world, with verified reviews and photos.
2. With or Without a Captain. Book a boat with a captain included, so you can sit back and enjoy the day. Or, find a self-charter that you can captain yourself.
3. Customize Your Trip. Found one you love? Book it instantly on most listings, and then chat with the owner to plan your perfect boat day. 
4. Have Fun! Meet your captain on the dock, get out on the water, and have a great time.
POPULAR DESTINATIONS
From city skylines to secluded getaways, we cover the best water destinations:
* USA & Canada: Explore the coasts of Miami, San Diego, or cruise the lakes near Chicago, Seattle, and Lake Tahoe.
* Mexico & the Caribbean: Charter a yacht for a day of snorkeling in Cancun or Cabo, or go deep-sea fishing off the coast of Nassau or St. Vincent.
* Europe: Sail the Mediterranean coast of France, rent a boat in Greece, or take a sunset kayak in Croatia.
FOR BOAT OWNERS: MAKE MONEY RENTING OUT YOUR BOAT
Own a boat or a boat rental business? Getmyboat is the best and easiest way to attract new customers, get more bookings, manage your schedule, and earn more. List your boat for free and let people find you in top boating destinations like Lake Travis, Toronto, and New York City. Whether it’s a luxury yacht, a fishing boat, or a small sailboat, we’ll help power your boating business.
* Create your listing for free in minutes.
* Connect with renters to set prices, schedule trips, and customize details.
* Manage everything easily from the app – built-in messaging, booking updates, and secure payments with fraud protection.
OWNER AND CAPTAIN SAFETY
Getmyboat boat owners and captains are responsible for operating safely and according to Coast Guard, national, and local regulations, including all licensing and safety standards.
Join millions of satisfied customers and boat owners who trust Getmyboat to power their water experiences worldwide.

From the creators of El Paso, Elsewhere, I Am Your Beast is a high-speed, covert-action FPS where you wage guerrilla warfare against the military-industrial complex across vibrant comic-book micro-sandboxes.
Play as Alphonse Harding, a legendary secret agent reluctantly drawn back into battle. After refusing one too many "one last jobs," you become the target of the ruthless Covert Operations Initiative (COI). Now hunted across North American wilderness, it's time to flip the script—stalking your enemies, turning their own weapons against them, and disappearing into a vast network of hidden tunnels.
GAME FEATURES:
Fast-Paced Stealth Action: Execute thrilling "he's-in-the-walls" tactics, leap through trees, and deliver explosive takedowns.
Immersive Storytelling: Experience a fully voiced revenge thriller narrative spanning 20+ action-packed levels.
Stunning Comic Book Art: Dive into lush visuals inspired by graphic novels, blending style with heart-pumping gameplay.
Replayable Micro-Sandbox Missions: Complete intense side objectives and race against the clock to set your best time.
Versatile Arsenal: Master pistols, sniper rifles, bear traps, and more to creatively eliminate threats.
Heart-Racing Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in pulse-pounding music from award-winning composer RJ Lake (Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator, Unbeatable, El Paso, Elsewhere).
Innovative Kinetic Typography: Enjoy groundbreaking storytelling through stylish, dynamic cutscenes.
Take revenge. Defy the hunters. Become the beast.

bluejetty:00184490:ios.description:
Fillwords is an exciting word game with 2000+ levels!
The goal of the puzzle is simple: find hidden words on the game grid. Connect letters with a line to form words and complete each level. Ready to challenge your mind and vocabulary?
A GREAT WORD GAME FOR EVERYONE
Fillwords suits both beginners and fans of all kinds of word puzzles. Want to relax after a long day? Looking to boost your focus and attention? Or maybe you’re a devoted word search fan? Then this game is the perfect choice for you!
WHY DO SO MANY PLAYERS CHOOSE FILLWORDS?
- A huge collection of puzzles: Thousands of carefully designed levels are waiting for you! Start with easy tasks and gradually move on to challenging word puzzles that will test even experienced players.
- A great brain workout: This game is a perfect way to improve concentration, vocabulary, and thinking speed – all in a fun and engaging format!
- A word game for adults: Fillwords was specially designed for adult players, with difficulty and themes picked to keep it truly interesting.
- Easy to start, impossible to stop: Every level is available to all players right away. Dive in and enjoy creating words from letters!
JOIN THE WORD GAME TODAY
Connect letters in any direction to find words. This puzzle will truly put your mind to the test! Play daily, search for words, and enjoy the exciting gameplay.
No internet connection? No problem! You can play Fillwords offline – on the go, in traffic, or while waiting in line. There’s always a new puzzle ready for you!
Form words from letters and dive into the wonderful world of word diversity. As a nice bonus, the game fully supports 10 languages: English, French, German, Indonesian, Kazakh, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, and Ukrainian.
WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR?
Fillwords has everything for a fun and captivating word game experience. Search for hidden words and challenge your intellect – training your brain has never been so easy and enjoyable!
Find hidden words offline and join this exciting word puzzle for adults today!
See you in the game!

Create stunning, high-quality photos in just a few taps.

App offers 3 types of subscriptions to choose from

- The offer is limited to a 3-day trial for a weekly subscription. At the end of the 3-day trial period, the subscription will automatically renew according to the tariff, unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the 3-day trial.

Logotipo: AI Logo Generator – Create Unique Logos with AI!
Discover the future of logo design with Logotipo, the AI-powered tool that turns your ideas into captivating logos in just seconds. Whether you’re a business owner, creative professional, or simply someone looking to establish a personal brand, Logotipo delivers effortless logo creation with professional results—no design skills needed.
To generate high-quality Logos in Logotipo, some premium subscriptions are needed.
[Create Unique Logos with Precision] 
Logotipo’s cutting-edge AI Logo Maker transforms your vision into logos that perfectly represent your identity. Whether you need a minimalist logo, a bold emblem, or something entirely unique, Logotipo captures the essence of your brand with stunning accuracy and style.
[Personalize Every Detail] 
With Logotipo, creativity has no limits. Customize colors, fonts, shapes, and layouts to craft a logo that’s unmistakably yours. Explore diverse design styles that align seamlessly with your branding goals—from elegant and timeless to vibrant and modern.
[Tailored for Every Purpose] 
Logotipo isn’t just for business logos—it’s a versatile solution for creating social media avatars, product icons, event badges, and more. Whatever the need, Logotipo ensures your design resonates with your audience and leaves a lasting impression.
[Seamless Integration Across Platforms] 
Your logos deserve to shine everywhere. Logotipo provides optimized designs for both digital and print use, ensuring your logo maintains its clarity and appeal on social media, websites, promotional materials, and beyond.
[Infinite Creative Possibilities] 
Go beyond traditional branding. Logotipo is your gateway to limitless design exploration, allowing you to experiment, innovate, and bring your most imaginative ideas to life.
Elevate Your Brand Today with Logotipo! Start crafting iconic logos that define your brand’s identity with Logotipo: AI Logo Generator—the ultimate tool for creativity, customization, and branding success.
About Subscriptions and Terms of Use:
-For Unlimited Features of Logotipo, Premium subscriptions are needed.
-Payment will be made from your iTunes account after you confirm the purchase.
-Subscriptions will auto-renew at the end of each term if it is not canceled 24 hours before the end of the purchasing term.
-The user can manage subscriptions. Auto-renew can be turned off from iTunes account settings.
-You can cancel your subscriptions by entering: http://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
-Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/logotipo-ai/terms-of-use
-Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/logotipo-ai/privacy-policy
-Support mail: logotipo.support@mobileocean.co

bluejetty:00072105:ios.name: Desh Kannada Keyboard
bluejetty:00072105:ios.summary:
Desh Kannada Keyboard is a keyboard extension that makes Kannada typing super easy:
• Type in English letters and get Kannada words with our transliteration technology
• Type faster using word predictions
• Easily switch to English with the
bluejetty:00072105:ios.description:
Desh Kannada Keyboard is a keyboard extension that makes Kannada typing super easy:
• Type in English letters and get Kannada words with our transliteration technology
• Type faster using word predictions
• Easily switch to English with the language key
• Word predictions and spell-correct is available in English also
• Emoji button is available after pressing 123
• 
Open the app and follow instructions to get your new Kannada keyboard:
• Enable keyboard from settings
• Activate the keyboard by holding the Globe icon and selecting "Desh Kannada Keyboard"
• Type Kannada everywhere!
Allowing full access:
• When enabling the keyboard, you may enable "Allow Full Access"
• This allows us to access crash reports and will help us improve the stability of the app
• We respect your privacy. No personal information is collected
• A standard warning is shown when you enable any downloaded keyboard app
How to access settings:
• Tap on the ⋯ button after opening the app and tap Settings. This option will be available after keyboard is activated
• Available settings: sound on key press, vibrate on key press, emoji row, number row
Using the clipboard:
• The clipboard lets you save text that you frequently use and paste them easily
• After you copy any text, it can be viewed from the clipboard by tapping on "Paste copied text". You can use the Pin button to save it permanently
• To show copied text automatically when clipboard is opened, you can change the "Paste from Other Apps" setting to "Allow"
Using stickers to make your chats more fun:
• Open the stickers page by clicking on the sticker icon on the keyboard. Click on any sticker you like to copy it
• Navigate back to your chat app and use your phone's Paste option in the message box
• The sticker will be pasted in the chat. Note that animations are currently sent as GIFs due to technical limitations
Do share your feedback and help us improve Desh Kannada Keyboard. And don't forget to leave a review if you like it.

bluejetty:00086190:ios.description:
Smart Football Stats, Match Data & Performance Analysis
Welcome to Enki's Football Stats - your all-in-one platform for football performance insights, match stats, and smart data tools.
Whether you're a fan, analyst, or someone who loves understanding football on a deeper level, Enki's Football Stats gives you the tools to explore key metrics, discover match trends, and review team performance - all in one clean, easy-to-use app.
Key Features:
1. Daily Match Insights
Stay updated with detailed match previews powered by real team stats, player trends, recent form, and historical performance.
2. VIP Access - Pro-Level Stats
Unlock deeper insights and advanced tools: - Premium match breakdowns
- Exclusive stat-based match suggestions
- Ad-free experience
- Expanded tactical and trend reports
3. Ticket Machine - Smart Suggestions
Use our unique "Ticket Machine" to generate stat-based match shortlists. Select your favorite leagues or criteria, and get a personalized feed of matches to follow.
4. Performance History
Track your favorite matches or shortlisted games using our built-in history tool. See how your analysis stacks up and identify recurring patterns.
5. Community of Stat-Lovers
Join thousands of users who rely on Enki's Football Stats to follow key matches, spot trends, and improve their football knowledge.
Why Choose Enki's Football Stats?
- Clean design, fast access, and real-time data
- Covers top leagues: Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga & more - Ideal for fans, analysts, and football data enthusiasts
- Built on smart statistical models and team-based trends
- VIP upgrades for deeper analysis tools
Know Football Like Never Before
From goal trends to clean sheets, from BTTS stats to team momentum - Enki's Football Stats gives you a smarter way to enjoy the game.
Disclaimer:
This app provides football stats and performance analysis only. It is not a betting platform and does not promote or facilitate gambling. bluejetty:00095562:ios.summary:
This drama requires an internet connection. Road to Empress I contains 16 chapters; Road to Empress II contains 32 chapters. Both include free trial chapters.
A palace adventure unlike anything you've played—shaped entirely by your choices
bluejetty:00095562:ios.description:
This drama requires an internet connection. Road to Empress I contains 16 chapters; Road to Empress II contains 32 chapters. Both include free trial chapters.
A palace adventure unlike anything you've played—shaped entirely by your choices!
Road to Empress II is now available! Step into a world of Eastern palace intrigue and power.
● Building on Road to Empress I, The Palace Legend Continues
Road to Empress I has captivated audiences globally.
Now, Road to Empress II plunges you into a gripping battle of court politics. Watch a legendary empress rise to new glory!
● 4K Cinematic Quality, Eastern Palace Aesthetics Reimagined
Filmed on lavishly built sets with 4K cinematic lighting, the story brings Eastern palaces to life: silk brocade texture, glinting golden hairpins, and a stirring traditional score. Featuring actors Kuan Hung, Evie Huang, Zeawo Yao, and Hana Lin. Sweeping scenes and nuanced performances ensure this golden age unfold right before your eyes. This is the ultimate Eastern aesthetic feast!
● From Unknown Girl to Legendary Empress, Write Your Own Story!
Ready to defy fate? Dive into the most thrilling palace power struggles ever! Rise from an unknown girl, break through rival factions, and climb to the peak of power. Think like a ruler: balance court power, plan ahead, and carve a blazing path to the throne.
● Approx.1,500 Minutes, Fully Immersed in Ruling Empress's Life
With around 1,500 minutes (I & II) of live-action content, immerse yourself in a sweeping saga of ambition and survival. Every choice triggers a chain of consequences. Twists and suspense await as you seize control and rewrite a dynasty's fate!
You decide who rises in the global popularity rankings.
● Stop Being a Spectator, Start Ruling Your Realm
A fully upgraded interactive experience: power is a battle of wits at your fingertips:
Review Memorials: With a press, witness your realm's lives—answer petitions, resolve disputes, and bring prosperity to your people.
Issue Edicts: Your imperial brush decides ministers' fate—reward merit, punish fault, and govern with wisdom.
● What Kind of Ruler Are You? Exclusive Trait Sketch Unlocked
At story's end, unlock an exclusive imperial trait sketch covering your scheming style, crisis decision-making, and methods of control. Are you the "Deadly Arsenic Trioxide"—cool, versatile, balancing power and passion? The "Romantic Datura"—loyal, ride-or-die, charging headfirst through fire? Or the "Overachiever Lurid Bolete"—ruthless, letting nothing stand in the way of ambition? Discover who you really are and share your exclusive empress profile!
About New One Studio
An independent team focused on interactive storytelling, blending Eastern culture with interactive media. In 2019, everyone who journeyed with The Invisible Guardian shared its BAFTA glory, reaffirming that great interactive storytelling can truly stay in people's hearts. Road to Empress depicts the deadly beauty of Eastern intrigue — a battlefield that tests your wisdom and courage.
Two works, different stories, one shared vision: let global users experience traditional Eastern culture. A bridge across cultures for every FMV fan.
Road to Empress is a saga of the legendary empress.
In Road to Empress I, follow a legendary beginning — an unknown girl navigating deadly palace power struggles with wisdom and courage.
In Road to Empress II, return as a master strategist. Stakes are brutally higher. Pull the strings, keep ministers in check, and forge a golden age. Every word of your empire's legacy — written by you!
(Official Orange Light Authorization, with sincere thanks to Orange Light for their music support.)

X：https://x.com/roadtoempressen
Instagram：https://www.instagram.com/roadtoempress/
Discord：https://discord.gg/roadtoempress

bluejetty:00077175:ios.name: PlayerPulse Player
bluejetty:00077175:ios.summary: PlayerPulse is the athlete wellness and performance app built for players of all sports, and the programs that develop them. College and youth teams use it to see the full picture of how each player is doing. That means both how they feel a
bluejetty:00077175:ios.description:
PlayerPulse is the athlete wellness and performance app built for players of all sports, and the programs that develop them. College and youth teams use it to see the full picture of how each player is doing. That means both how they feel and what their body has been through.
READINESS THAT SEES THE WHOLE PICTURE
Most wellness apps stop at a survey. PlayerPulse combines your daily wellness check-in with your actual training load to produce a single readiness score. You and your coaches can use it to decide when to push and when to recover.
Quick daily check-ins covering sleep, soreness, mood, and stress
Session RPE logging to capture how hard each training really was
Training load tracking that shows how your workload is building over time
One clear readiness score, updated every day
SYNC YOUR HEALTH DATA
Connect your health data and PlayerPulse pulls in sleep hours, heart rate variability, and workouts automatically, with no manual entry. Support for more wearables is on the way.
OBSERVER MODE FOR PARENTS
Parents of youth athletes can follow along with Observer Mode. They can see their player's training load, wellness trends, and recovery, so the whole support system stays on the same page.
BUILT FOR INDIVIDUALS AND TEAMS
PlayerPulse connects players with their coaching staff. Your check-ins and training data feed your team's dashboard, which helps coaches plan sessions, manage workloads, and catch warning signs before they turn into injuries or burnout.
Free for players whose club or school already has PlayerPulse seats
Available as a standalone subscription for individual athletes
Existing PlayerPulse users can log in with their current credentials, and all their history comes with them
WHO IT'S FOR
College soccer players and programs
Youth academy and club players
Parents who want visibility into their athlete's load and recovery
Any athlete who wants to understand what their body is telling them
YOUR DATA, PROTECTED
Athlete wellness data is personal. PlayerPulse is designed to give you control over what you share and who sees it.
Download PlayerPulse and start every session knowing where you stand.
TERMS & PRIVACY
Terms of Use (EULA): https://playerpulseapp.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://playerpulseapp.com/privacy

bluejetty:00122009:ios.description:
SHOWROOM is one of the largest live streaming platforms in Japan!*
Enjoying live streaming has never been easier.
Interact with and view streams from all the popular idols, artists, models, voice actors, comedians, celebrities, and more!!
Users can enjoy the many streams on the platform everyday or even start your own stream and start interacting and amassing a fanbase of followers.
(*) According to AppAnnie, including web and smartphone app.
◆How to Enjoy SHOWROOM◆
■Watch Live Streams!
-------------------------------------
Watch your favorite streamers and interact with them through commenting and send gifts. Streamers love to chat with their fans, so jump in to watch a stream and make sure to say "hello" in the comments!
■Start Stremaing
-------------------------------------
All you need is a smartphone to start streaming! Once you have started your stream, you can comment directly with your fans.
■There are lots of events every month!
-------------------------------------
There are many events held on SHOWROOM every month!
You can send gift items to streamers in events and help make their streaming dreams come true!
【Examples of Event prizes】
- TV appearances
- Production of original music by famous composers or musicians
- Appearance on runways of large fashion events
- Exclusive and regular modeling for famous magazines
- Fashion model for popular stores
- Become an ambassador for a famous company or store
- Create original goods in collaboration with stores and create a special sections in the stores
- Design your own original avatars
■Recommended functions
-------------------------------------
○Live Streaming
With SHOWROOM, you can easily stream live from your smartphone!
Feel free to start at any time you like! A lot of friendly listeners are waiting for you!
○Avatars
SHOWROOM has a unique avatar system that makes communication through your custom avatar fun!
○Karaoke
You can enjoy karaoke streaming while singing your favorite songs!
The listener can liven up the karaoke transmission with a mirror ball gift!
○Gifting
You can give items to your favorite streamers to support them and help make their dreams come true with your support!
You can choose from many gifts to send to your favorite streamers!
○Effects
You can use a variety of filters and make-up functions to make your skin and hair look beautiful, or create your special streams. Try to find your original settings by combining different effects!
○24-hour monitoring
In addition to the unique AI (patent pending), SHOWROOM is working to create a safe and secure environment for everyone by creating a 24-hour monitoring system to check for inappropriate streams or comments.
■SHOWROOM is recommended for the people who
-------------------------------------
- Want to support streamers who works hard for their dreams
- Want to work hard for my dream.
- Like to see popular idols and artists streaming
- Want to have friends I can talk to
- Want to increase their fanbase on Twitter and Instagram
- Want to enjoy live streaming with fans
■Official SNS accounts
-------------------------------------
○Twitter
@SHOWROOM_jp
https://twitter.com/SHOWROOM_jp
○note
https://note.com/showroom_note
○Instagram
http://instagram.com/showroom_official

bluejetty:00068884:ios.description:
The journey to cracking medical exams is overwhelming—but with PrepLadder, your preparation just got smarter, faster, and more focused.
Trusted by toppers and lakhs of medical aspirants, PrepLadder is one of India’s leading platforms for NEET PG, INI-CET, FMGE, NEET SS, and Residency exam preparation.
And now, introducing Version XI—our most advanced learning experience yet. Built on years of learner feedback and faculty expertise, Version XI is designed to help you study more efficiently, revise more effectively, and stay focused on what truly matters.
Backed by India’s top medical faculty, Version XI brings together powerful learning tools and high-yield content to maximize your exam readiness.
Why Choose PrepLadder?
With Version XI, you get access to a complete preparation ecosystem designed to improve learning outcomes and retention:
• Enhanced Video Lectures – Concept-focused learning with updated content, rich visuals, animations, and real clinical correlations for deeper understanding.
• Comprehensive QBank – 18,000+ high-yield MCQs, including image-based and clinically relevant questions, with detailed explanations to strengthen concepts.
• Audio QBank – Learn on the go with faculty-narrated explanations available in English and Hinglish.
• Structured Notes – Concise, exam-oriented notes aligned with video lectures and enriched with HD images, flowcharts, tables, and mind maps.
• Treasures – High-yield revision resources designed to simplify last-minute preparation and boost recall.
• Advanced Test Series – Simulate real exam environments, identify strengths and weaknesses, and track your performance with detailed analytics.
Beyond NEET PG & FMGE
PrepLadder isn't just for entrance exams. We also offer specialized preparation resources for Super Specialty and Residency examinations.
For NEET SS, we provide comprehensive learning resources across key specialties, helping you build strong conceptual understanding and clinical application skills.
For Residency preparation, our curriculum covers major branches including Radiology, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Psychiatry, and ENT, with structured content, real-world case discussions, and high-yield resources curated from standard textbooks and expert faculty guidance.
Your Success, Simplified
At PrepLadder, we believe preparation should be effective—not overwhelming.
No unnecessary clutter. No information overload. Just the right content, delivered in the right format, at the right time.
Join thousands of aspirants who trust PrepLadder to power their preparation journey and take the next step toward achieving their medical career goals.
Download PrepLadder and experience the power of Version XI today.

bluejetty:00121522:ios.description:
Kingdom Rush Frontiers is a whole new level of the furiously fast, enchantingly charming gameplay that made kingdom Rush an award-winning Tower Defense hit.
Defend exotic lands from dragons, man-eating plants, and ghastly denizens of the underworld -all with flashy towers, levels, heroes, and more goodies to help you crush your enemies to a pulp.
BUILD MIGHTY TOWERS!
• OVER 18 TOWER ABILITIES! Unleash Death Riders, pestilence clouds, or assassins that steal and kill your enemies!
• 8 SPECIALIZED TOWER UPGRADES! Slice, sizzle, and stomp your foes with Crossbow Forts, Mighty Templars, Necromancers, and even Earthquake Machines - hey, we told you we were shaking things up.
• UPGRADE SYSTEM allows you to min/max your towers towards your preferred strategy.
• Fortify the frontier in exotic news lands - hold the line in deserts, jungles, and even the underworld!
TRAIN LEGENDARY HEROES
• 16 LEGENDARY HEROES. Choose among mighty champions and train their abilities! Each has unique specialties that fit different play styles and strategies!
• Special units and features on every stage! Watch out for the Black Dragon!
DEFEAT THEM ALL
• OVER 40 ENEMIES with unique abilities! Stay on your toes as you fight through desert sandworms, tribal shamans, nomad tribes, and underground terrors. Action like you have never seen before!
• MERCILESS BOSS FIGHTS! Hey, we told you to get those upgrades...
MORE MIND-BOGGLING CONTENT
• Hours of army with OVER 80 ACHIEVEMENTS! what can you expect from Ironhide Games, the creators of Kingdom rush? You will be hooked for hours searching for Easter eggs and achievements!
• IN-GAME ENCYCLOPEDIA! learn all about your enemies and you will be able to plan the best strategy to defeat them. Study up!
• CLASSIC, IRON, AND HEROIC GAME MODES to challenge your tactical skills!
• 3 DIFFICULTY MODES! Are you up for a real challenge? Go with Hard mode!
• PLAY IT OFFLINE! No internet? No problem! You will be able to jump into real action even offline!
-----------------------------------------------------

Feel the thrill before each picture and share the hilarious moments that occur with the pictures of your friends and family!
In Photo Roulette, you and your friends team up and engage in a highly social game on your phones. In each round of Photo Roulette a random photo is chosen from one players’ photo library and briefly showed to all of the players. The players compete in quickly guessing whose photo it is, receiving a score based on time and accuracy of their answer. After 15 pictures, the Photo Roulette champion is crowned!
Photo Roulette features:
- 3-10 players in a super fun and social PARTY GAME
- Try an awesome round of VIDEO Roulette!
- Plant a funny photo or show your photos again
- Get to know your friends and family through their photos
- Relive amazing moments with photos you had forgotten
- Highscore list after each round and game end

bluejetty:00128295:ios.description:
MrReceipt makes everyday shopping easier - from planning your shopping lists and finding the best deals, to storing receipts and deposit slips, managing your household budget, and tracking daily expenses. Everything related to your shopping is always within reach.
See how MrReceipt helps you every day:
Plan Your Shopping
Browse deals, explore store flyers, create shopping lists, and use exclusive coupons. Plan your purchases more effectively, reduce impulse spending, and quickly find the best prices.
While You Shop
Keep everything you need in one place - from shopping lists that help you stay on track, to loyalty cards and deposit slips stored conveniently on your phone. No more carrying a bulky wallet or searching for paper slips at the checkout.
Receipts & e-Receipts
Scan and store your receipts in the app so your proof of purchase is always at hand - securely, conveniently, and without digging through drawers. Whether you need a receipt for a return, warranty claim, or complaint, you can find it in seconds.
Household Budget
Get a clearer picture of your everyday spending with easy-to-read statistics. Create your own expense categories and manage your budget the way that works best for you. Set monthly spending limits, receive alerts, and see exactly where your money goes.
Product Insights
Check ingredients, nutritional values, calories, and product ratings before, during, or after shopping. Perfect when package labels are hard to read, you're tracking calories or dietary ingredients, or you simply want to make better purchasing decisions.
Safer Shopping
Receive notifications about recalled products and official food and consumer product safety alerts. Stay informed about important warnings and avoid potentially unsafe products.
Lotteries & Loyalty Programs
Based on the receipts you add, we'll let you know about current lotteries and loyalty programs you may be eligible for. Join, participate, and don't miss out on rewards and prizes
Unlock Extra Savings
In addition to regular coupons, you can support MrReceipt with a symbolic coffee and gain access to additional discounts for online shopping at selected stores - so you can keep more money in your pocket.
MrReceipt is your everyday shopping companion, helping you save money, organize your expenses, and stay in control of your purchases.

-Achievements and Rewards: Earn impressive achievements and collect rewards for your exceptional sorting expertise.

-Combo Bonuses: Form clever combinations and chain reactions to unleash fantastic bonus points and boost your score.
Match Goods: Triple Sort Game offers an addictive and rewarding gaming experience! Sharpen your sorting skills, embrace the challenge, and unravel the mysteries of matching goods in this thrilling puzzle quest. Are you ready to become the ultimate Match Goods Master?

bluejetty:00119424:ios.summary: Create gorgeous spreadsheets with Numbers on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Get started with Apple-designed templates for everything from a home budget to an invoice. Add tables, charts, text, and images anywhere on the flexible canvas. Animate your
bluejetty:00119424:ios.description:
Create gorgeous spreadsheets with Numbers on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Get started with Apple-designed templates for everything from a home budget to an invoice. Add tables, charts, text, and images anywhere on the flexible canvas. Animate your data with interactive charts, find patterns with pivot tables, and use hundreds of powerful functions.
Get Started Quickly
• Work from iPhone, iPad, Mac, or even a PC with iCloud.com
• Select from a wide variety of Apple-designed templates
• Calculate, visualize, and arrange your data with an intelligent assistant that knows your spreadsheet (Beta)*
• Add from a library of shapes, tables, and charts with pre-defined styles
• Import and edit Microsoft Excel and CSV files
Create Beautiful Spreadsheets
• Place tables, charts, text, and images anywhere on the flexible canvas
• Browse the Content Hub for a curated collection of videos, images, backgrounds, and more*
• Create images and custom, editable shapes from a text description*
• Create a form on iPhone or iPad to quickly enter data on the go
• Draw or write with Apple Pencil on iPad
Formulas for Everyone
• Choose from hundreds of powerful functions, including XLOOKUP and RegEx
• Search the integrated function browser for built-in help and sample formulas
• Easily add stock information to spreadsheets
• See results from a single formula across multiple cells using spilling arrays
Everything Adds Up Beautifully
• Use pivot tables and categories to see your data in a whole new way
• Quickly organize and summarize tables to gain new insights
• Insert gorgeous 2D and 3D charts, including bar, column, line, area, pie, donut, and radar charts
• Animate data with interactive column, bar, scatter, and bubble charts
• Easily filter through large tables for specific values, text, or duplicate entries
• Change values in cells using sliders, steppers, checkboxes, pop-ups, and star ratings
Share with Anyone
• Share your spreadsheet publicly or collaborate with specific people using iCloud or Box
• Make changes from any device and see a list of changes from others in real-time
• Export your spreadsheet in CSV, TSV, PDF, and Microsoft Excel
Apple Intelligence
• Use Writing Tools to proofread, rewrite, summarize, and compose text
• Create your own fun images with Image Playground based on a description
Numbers is now part of Apple Creator Studio, an amazing collection of Apple’s most powerful creative apps designed to help you bring your ideas to life. The suite includes Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, Pixelmator Pro, Motion, Compressor, and MainStage — plus premium content and intelligence features in Keynote, Pages, Numbers, and Freeform, all in one simple plan. Creating, viewing, and editing spreadsheets in Numbers, as well as collaborating in real time, does not require a subscription.
* Requires an Apple Creator Studio subscription.
Some features of Apple Creator Studio require an Apple Intelligence–capable device. For full system requirements and usage limits for Apple Creator Studio intelligence features, see Apple Support articles 125029 and 127888.

apple-macos:6759146516.name: Secure Redact
apple-macos:6759146516.description:
Stop sensitive data before it leaves your hands.
Instantly redact secrets, identities, and malicious or suspicious URLs — fully offline.
Secure Redact detects and removes passwords, API keys, credit cards, SSNs, IP addresses, malicious or suspicious URLs, and 20+ types of sensitive data from any text — all processed 100% offline on your device. No cloud. No tracking. No account required.
Protect logs, code snippets, emails, chat messages, Slack messages, support tickets, AI prompts, and any text before you share it.
WHY SECURE REDACT?
- Complete Privacy — All detection and redaction runs entirely on your device. No servers, no cloud storage, no tracking. Your data never leaves your device.
- 20+ Detection Types — Automatically detect credentials (API keys, JWTs, passwords, session IDs), identity data (emails, phone numbers, SSNs, device IDs), financial data (credit cards, IBANs, SWIFT codes, crypto addresses), and system identifiers (IPs, MAC addresses, UUIDs, file paths).
- Custom Threat Intelligence (BYOF) — Integrate your own threat feeds to detect malicious or suspicious URLs (phishing, malware, botnet domains). Import domain lists, IPs, or custom identifiers from any HTTP source. All feeds are stored and processed locally on your device.
- Audit Dashboard — Track redaction history with local analytics. View detection counts, signature types, and performance metrics — stored locally on your device.
- Flexible Redaction Modes — Choose full labels ([REDACTED], [IP_REDACTED]) or partial masking (192.168.*****) to preserve structure.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Paste text — logs, code, emails, chat messages, AI prompts, or any plain text
2. Select a redaction policy (Secrets, Balanced, Standard, or Enhanced)
3. Review detected sensitive data
4. Copy and share safely
REDACTION POLICIES
- Secrets — API keys, JWTs, session IDs, passwords, database strings, private keys
- Balanced — Secrets + emails, phone numbers, SSNs, device IDs
- Standard — Balanced + credit cards, IBANs, SWIFT codes, crypto addresses
- Enhanced — Standard + IPs, MAC addresses, UUIDs, URLs, file paths, VINs
PERFECT FOR
- Developers sharing logs or code snippets
- Security teams handling incident reports
- Support teams sanitizing tickets before escalation
- Teams sharing AI prompts containing sensitive data
- IT admins sanitizing configuration files
- Anyone protecting sensitive information before sharing
KEY FEATURES
- 100% offline — no internet required for redactions.
- Signature-based detection with contextual analysis
- Custom threat intelligence integration (Pro)
- Local audit logs with analytics
- Zero tracking or data collection
- Unlimited redaction operations
IMPORTANT NOTES
Secure Redact uses pattern-based detection to identify known data formats. While highly effective, it may not detect all sensitive data in non-standard formats or natural language. Always review redacted output before sharing.
This tool does not guarantee regulatory compliance (GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS). Additional controls and professional guidance may be required.
SUBSCRIPTION PLANS
- Free — Credentials and identity detection (passwords, API keys, emails, SSNs) with unlimited redactions.
- Pro — All 4 policies, financial detection, system identifiers, custom threat intelligence feeds, detailed analytics, and advanced controls. Includes a 7-day free trial.
SUPPORT

- Website: https://www.klexaroredact.com/
- Terms: https://www.klexaroredact.com/terms
- Privacy: https://www.klexaroredact.com/privacy

apple-macos:6801197127.name: PhotoBorder: White EXIF Frame
apple-macos:6801197127.description:
Give your photos a clean white border and print the shooting details underneath, so every shot looks like a finished print.
IPHONE, IPAD & MAC
• One app for iPhone, iPad and Mac: download it once and use it on all three
• Buy Pro once and use it on all three with the same Apple Account
• Templates sync via iCloud across your devices; deletions sync too
• Handoff: continue full-resolution photos & edits directly between iPhone, iPad and Mac
IN PHOTOS & THE SHARE MENU
• Edit a photo in Photos and choose PhotoBorder from the ⋯ menu: pick a border and filter, saved to that photo (revertible)
• Or choose it in the Share menu (or Finder on Mac) to save a bordered copy
CAMERA
• See the border, shooting info and filter live in the viewfinder, then shoot with the border already on; 0.5× to telephoto zoom
• Optionally save the original HEIC photo or RAW (DNG) alongside your shot, at 12MP or 48MP
FILTERS
• 14 film-style filters, from Sunlit and Golden Hour to Faded, Teal & Orange and three black & white looks
• Adjust the strength, and add film grain and a vignette
• Import your own .cube and Lightroom .xmp LUT filters, synced via iCloud and usable in extensions; free 1, Pro unlimited
PICTURE FRAMES
• 8 frames: Oak, Walnut, Dark Walnut, Matte Black, Matte White, Silver, Baroque Gold and French White, with adjustable width
• A mat with a bevel-cut edge and real shadows, your shooting info printed on it; free
INSTANT STYLE & TEMPLATES
• Instant style: cream or yellowed paper, a recessed photo edge and handwritten text, with adjustable paper color and grain
• 20+ fonts: handwritten, sans serif, serif and monospaced, each previewed in its own style
• My Fonts: add your own .ttf/.otf fonts, synced via iCloud; free includes one, Pro has no limit. Plus three Korean fonts
• Save your favorite settings as templates and apply them in one tap
WHITE BORDERS
• Canvas ratios: Original, 1:1, 4:5, 3:4, 2:3, 9:16, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9
• Adjust border width and the height of the bottom area
• Border color: handy presets or the color picker (HEX supported)
• Handmade Edges: uneven edge widths and slightly curved paper edges, like a hand-cut print, over a white, black or transparent backdrop
SHOOTING INFO
• Reads EXIF automatically: camera brand, model, lens, focal length, aperture, shutter speed, ISO, date and location
• Custom text: a place, signature or caption on its own line – or several lines with adjustable spacing and position
• Film scans and other photos without EXIF: enter the camera, lens and settings yourself (saving needs Pro)
LIGHT ADJUSTMENTS
• Live histogram: drag left or right on it to adjust that tonal range
• Exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites and blacks
• Auto Clarity in three strengths, fine-tunable on the sliders
PREVIEW & SAVE
• Exported photos keep their EXIF; GPS is kept only when Location is turned on
• Save as JPEG, HEIC or PNG (lossless, keeps a transparent backdrop); the export sheet shows the estimated file size
• Add photos from a folder or drag them in, and save to Photos or a folder
PRIVACY
• Everything happens on your device; photos are never uploaded
• The app only sees the photo you pick and only asks to add photos when saving
FREE & PRO
• Free: 3 exports per day and up to 3 templates
• Pro (monthly, yearly or a one-time lifetime purchase): unlimited exports
• Pro also batch exports with a template, up to 50 photos at once
• Monthly and yearly plans start with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers; you are charged only when the trial ends, and cancelling during the trial costs nothing
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://nicerhythm.net/PhotoBorder/privacy/
